We've tried other cooling pads that either got hair or other funk wrapped up in the fan and stopped working or were way too noisy (vibrations) unless you held the computer and cooling pad at the perfect angle. We love this cooling pad. His computer now stays cool all the time, he uses it every single time he uses the computer (he wasn't doing so before because of the noise issues). He's even packed it up to take with him on an overnight stay which he's never done before.

Our only complaint is that the cooling pad is too smooth and has nothing to help prevent the laptop from sliding about on the pad. If you lean back it slides right onto your lap and if you drop your legs for any reason it slides the opposite direction.

All in all, this is a wonderful cooler, it just needs something that would make the face of it not quite so smooth.

I wasn't too sure how well this speaker would work when I first requested it since every portable speaker we've ever gotten has had a sort of tingy sound to it, but this portable speaker rocks! The sound quality is even better than what we get on our home speakers and I love that you can feel the 'thumps' and hear some of the background sounds in the music that really weren't noticable before.

My husband's been wanting some way of listening to music out at the barn so we charged this little unit up and then headed out for the afternoon milking. We were easily able to hear the music over all the normal machinery racket - the whole time the hubby's giving me the thumbs up. He especially loves that once it's set up it will automatically connect to his bluetooth (though I could happily live without having to listen to his conversations!). It played the entire 4 hours we were out there and still had more battery life left!

UPDATE: This SOLEMATE finally died - and I mean it won't charge, won't pay, nothing... so we've bought another one to replace it and the new one did not come with a standard plug in charger for an outlet. It has to be charged with a computer (not real happy with that). It's still a great speaker but miss the freedom of being able to plug it into the wall and know it's charging without having to leave a computer running.

At first I couldn't figure out how to hook up the SOLEMATE to the computer, iPad or the iPod then the hubby pointed out that there's a cord underneath it that attaches to them so I'm good to go. The Bluetooth range is great as well. 33 feet I believe I read but I know my husband was able to walk the entire length of the milking parlor without having any disruption... oh and there's a convenient bag to put the SOLEMATE in so it's safe from sand and water (though I wouldn't recommend getting it wet or sandy on purpose). We had it in the bag and coveredd with paper towels.

My only complaint is that the instruction manuals really aren't very thick.. just basic information - and while I don't mind learning by doing it would be much simpler and less frustrating if there was someplace I could find answers - besides reading through other reviews.

The SOLEMATE works much better than I ever expected it to and I'm extremely impressed. Will definitely be using it instead of our home stereo system. It certainly sounds better!
Was half the price for a standard replacement but is equal in quality & performance!  Best Buy for your buck!

This Decibullz Listen Only Radio Headset is nice. I was skeptical at first but was happy that it works. The sound is excellent.

The pack comes with a headset. The headset has an earpiece on a tube, it is attached to a clip. The clip can be attached to a pocket, collar, or other parts of a shirt. There is also a cord that is put into the radio for connection to the headpiece. Also included is a replacement earpiece, and instructions.

I will be recommending this Decibullz Listen Only Radio Headset to family and friends.

This XIAOKOA Desktop Microphone for Computer works great. It comes with instructions that are easy to read and follow. It is solid and stands by itself with one button control.

This microphone has good clarity even at a distance. The base light can be turned off if you don't need it. One button activates the microphone. This works well for my tutorials. You can adjust the position of the microphone.

I will be recommending this XIAOKOA Desktop Microphone for Computer to family and friends.

At first I was going to send it back because it didn't seem to work. I wanted my old CRT TV to show the 16x9 ratio correctly. But there is a setting in Windows 7 I didn't know about. Right click on the extended display, select Properties. In the Intel HD Graphics Control Panel, choose Digital Television, and select Scale Full Screen. Then it works! Make sure you make it your default for audio too. I only give it 4 stars though since the 16x9 display isn't centered, it isn't quite, exactly right. But close enough for my enjoyment.

This is an excellent projector that's perfect for anything from work presentations to watching a movie in your back yard. It comes with a convenient tripod and a 100" screen. It also includes an HDMI cable, power cable, remote control, and an AV signal cord. The projector also has speakers.

I was able to pair this projector with my Samsung cell phone without difficulty. The manual is easy to follow and the controls are intuitive and easy to operate. The projector also has controls to adjust your picture so that it's straight and in focus.

The projector doesn't make much noise when it's turned on, and the overall design is sleek and compact. This an effective and efficient projector that is perfect for both entertainment and work.

This is a very nice little tablet. The touch screen is highly responsive and easy to operate. It comes with a type C charger and cable. I took it out of the box, signed in with my email, and was ready to go in only a few minutes. It's easy to change the settings for things like the volume of notifications, brightness level, and font size. It also features good video reproduction. I'm mainly going to use this as a digital reader and it works perfectly for that purpose. This is a good quality, affordable tablet.

These are a nice set of affordably priced headphones. The headphones are comfortable and the sound reproduction is very good. I got these for my daughter who prefers them to ear buds. The headband adjusts in two places which ensures you'll get a proper fit. The earcups swivel and feature a soft, leather pad. Finally, the headphones come with a long cord that is very convenient. The headphones come in an attractive box that make them a good gift idea. This is a nice product.

This is a nice portable DVD player that is very easy to use. All you have to do is put in the DVD and it starts playing automatically. There are convenient controls that will allow children to adjust volume without any difficulty.

The screen is very large making this portable player a good travel option. It has good battery life and it can play while it's recharging. The player includes several cables including a car charger.

The player is lightweight and folds down to the size of a standard laptop. Both the sound and the picture are of good quality. This is a nice item that will help keep your children entertained both at home and during car trips or airplane flights.

This is a nice little amp about the size of a car radio. It comes with a small remote control and an instruction booklet. It's very easy to hook up to a set of speakers and the controls are highly intuitive. It took a moment for the amp to scan the FM channels and then I was able to easily find all my local stations. I was also able to hook it up to my cellphone via Bluetooth without any problems. The device is listed as "Moukey MAMP3" on your phone's available Bluetooth connections. The item also features red and white audio connectors, but I got this to use mainly for Bluetooth.

The unit comes well protected in packing foam to ensure it will arrive to you in good working order. I like the size and the durable construction of this amp. This is a perfect piece of audio equipment for a small apartment, dorm room, or for under a television. This is a nice product and would make a thoughtful gift.

I like to listen to audiobooks as I go on long bike rides and this is the best speaker I've found for that purpose so far. I've used other speakers that sit in the water bottle cages, but the sound is muffled by my frame bag. Also, I prefer to ride with two bottles. This speaker rests on the handlebars, so it's closer to your ears and provides a superior listening experience.

The mount screws securely in place and there are plenty of spacers provided to ensure this will fit on a wide variety of bar diameters. The speaker screws into the mount in the same fashion that a camera can be affixed to a tripod. It's convenient to have both a light and a power bank mounted on your bicycle, and this speaker has a great battery life. It is highly water resistant and can handle less than ideal conditions. This is a terrific bicycle accessory.

I'm doing virtual learning with my children this school year and this laptop table helps convert any room into a classroom. The legs fold out on the bottom and provide you a stable writing space whether you're sitting on the floor or on a chair. This item even works great for road trips and it allows your kids to stay occupied with creative activities rather than be entertained by videos.

It's a lightweight table that my 6 year old can carry without any difficulty, but it's sturdy enough to support a computer. There is a storage tray that pulls out from the side where you can keep writing instruments. When you fold up the legs, it takes up minimal storage space. This is a very useful item to have around the house.

These speakers are compact, look great, and provide a high-quality sound that can fill up a room. The cabinet features an attractive looking wood grain that will perfectly complement your existing decor. The convenient wall mount bracket on the back makes it easy to hang these speakers for optimal sound coverage.

The speakers come with two speaker cables, or you can use your existing speaker cables. All you have to do is hook them up and enjoy. The sound quality is very high and these speakers are a great option for a home entertainment system. Whether you want to listen to your favorite recording artist, or watch the latest Hollywood release, these speakers will greatly enhance your audio experience.

I sometimes work as a tour guide for popular destinations in South America. On those occasions, I'll usually buy a few extra SD cards to give to clients in case they fill up their memory. There is nothing worse than seeing people get halfway through the trip of a lifetime only to have to start deleting photos because they don't have enough space left over to take pictures of the primary attraction.

This is a really good card that will allow you enough memory to take all the pictures you want. At 50 MB/s, this is a very fast card that is more than adequate for most situations. If you haven't upgraded your SD card lately, this product is an excellent choice.

This is a terrific backpack that is equally suitable to be used as a school bag as it is to be used as a professional briefcase. The shoulder straps fold into a compartment on the back of the bag, and there are handles both on the top and on the side. The bag has a zipper around the body that allows it to expand to a comfortably sized overnight bag. The inner compartment has a laptop sleeve as well as elastic straps to secure clothing.

The versatility of this bag makes it a perfect gift. It is suitable as an everyday bag and is also a perfect travel size. It is very durably constructed with an elegant appearance. This is a high quality product that will provide you with years of service.

This is a very nice sport watch that you can use to monitor your workouts. You have to attach the wrist bands to the watch face, but it comes with a small tool to make the job easier. The clasp on the wrist band can also be adjusted for sizing with the same tool.

The watch connects easily to your phone after you download the free "Link to Health" app. I found the app on the google play store and had no difficulty installing it on my Samsung Galaxy s7. The app automatically sets the watch time. The watch has no buttons and you operate it through the touch screen. You can select between several attractive themes.

This watch and band looks very nice and is equally appropriate out on the trail or at a formal gathering. It's easy to track your workout data, and this is a useful device to help you achieve your fitness goals.

This is a very nice Chromebook with a lot of good features. You sign in with your gmail account and you can access drive, search the internet, and watch videos. The computer can be used with multiple users. This is a perfect device for travel because the Chromebook is so compact that it can fit easily into a backpack or handbag. This would also be the perfect choice for taking notes at school.

My children are seven and nine and they use Chromebooks like this for their classes. It's intuitive enough for small children, but powerful enough for adults.

On one side of the computer there is an audio jack, USB port, HDMI port, and a USB-C port for charging. There are also two lights to indicate battery and power status. The other side has a MicroSD slot and another USB port. The keyboard is full-sized and easy to operate. The keys depress and it's easy to type quickly and accurately. There is also a touch pad that works like a mouse.

The computer is a pleasing weight and has an attractive overall design. The hinges on the back are durable and provide a smooth opening action. This is a good choice as a first computer for children, or as a secondary device for professionals on the go.

This is a durable cooler that has a Bluetooth speaker in the lid. To turn the speaker on, you open up a rubber flap. Beneath the flap is an on/off switch and a USB charging port. The cooler is well constructed with a carrying handle and a drink dispensing valve at the bottom. It is easy to connect your speaker to your cell phone or other digital device. The speaker produces high quality sound. This is a fun item for social gatherings or trips to the beach.

These DALI IO-6 headphones offer a superior listening experience. The sound quality is absolutely fantastic and allows you to pick up nuances in your music that you've never been able to hear before. The ear cups are large enough to fit completely over your ear and offer a nice seal. I like that there is space between the padding and the speaker which helps enhance air movement. I thought these headphones offered great replication for high, middle, and bass sounds.

The speakers charge with a USB-C cable that is included, and offer an astonishing 30 hours of battery life. The speakers also come with an audio cable, and they even have an attachment that allows you to plug the audio cable into the dual jack you find on airplanes. There is also a high quality carrying case that zips closed.

I liked that there is an actual switch on the side of the headphones to turn them off and on. I much prefer a physical switch to a button you have to press until a light shows the headphones have been activated. You can power these down after use without having to take them off and look at what you're doing. The instant power off switch also helps to preserve battery life because other headphone models stay on when connected to Bluetooth even when you aren't listening.

The right hand speaker has extremely sensitive push controls. You can push the center piece to stop, reverse, or advance your music, and you can push the top or bottom of the rim to adjust volume. I prefer the push controls to touch sensitive controls because they are more responsive. I found the push controls to be highly intuitive and easy to operate.

These headphones are comfortable to wear and offer superior sound quality. They connect instantly via Bluetooth, and have a stylish design. Even the packaging is very attractive and would make these headphones a much appreciated gift. If you're looking a superior set of headphones, these are a great choice.

I like to listen to audio books as I go on bike rides, so I've been looking for a product like this. When I run I use over the ear headphones, but I can't fit those on over or under my cycling helmet. These sunglasses are a great solution. There are speakers underneath the arms that broadcast music almost directly into your ears. The effect is an open ear speaker system that allows you to hear your music, but also lets you stay mindful of ambient noises.

The sunglasses have enough of a tint to be comfortable, but not so much that they are impractical in low light. The arms rest easily on your ears and the nose piece is a solid bit of plastic that does not pinch the bridge of your nose. The glasses are very light even with the battery and speaker system.

The sunglasses connect to your cell phone via Bluetooth without any issues. There is a large power button on the right arm that is easy to locate by touch. I preferred these for comfort and for sound quality to ear buds. The sound quality is about what you'd expect for tiny speakers mounted to the arms of sunglasses. It's not concert hall quality, but it gets the job done, and it's better than a lot of other speakers on the market.

These sunglasses are great for athletes who like to listen to music while they're out exercising. Also included is a case, a bag, a lens cloth, and a charging cable.

I've been using these headphones for a week and I can't get over the superior sound quality. They feature terrific high end frequency replication and offer a bass you can feel. I experimented briefly with the Bose music app, but I have enough apps on my phone already and this connects fine as a regular Bluetooth device. In the end, the comfort and sound quality are the most important and not the other features. Both are great on this product.

These headphones have a really nice, sleek design. The ear cups swivel and can be easily adjusted to fit your head. The ear cups have what seems to be a soft leather or imitation leather padding that is comfortable and helps create a seal that blocks out external noise. You can adjust the amount of noise cancellation, so these are ideal headphones for both travel and zoning out.

The headphones charge with a USB-C charging port. At this time most of my other devices require a USB Micro-B, but I'm seeing more of he C ports and cables. A charging cable is included along with an AUX cable. You also get a very nice plastic hard case that zips closed.

The headphones have a minimal design with only three buttons. The only button that's labeled is the Bluetooth button. One really cool feature is that the front half of the right ear cup can recognize taps and gestures. Instead of feeling around for a tiny button, you can just double tap the ear cup to play your music or answer a call. You can adjust volume by swiping down or swiping up. The 20 hour battery life means these are always ready to play.

I'm sure this set of headphones has more features than I'll ever use. The most important thing is that they are very comfortable, easily adjustable, and sound terrific. If you love music on the go, these headphones are a perfect choice.

It's hard to see just how small this drive is from the promotional pictures. I didn't believe them when they said it was the size of a credit card, but except for the thickness, this drive is actually even smaller. This solid 500 GB solid state drive is perfect for making a secure back up for your digital photo album. I'm old school, and I don't completely trust the cloud with my most precious memories. Old fashioned hard drives are delicate with an internal drive that can scratch or break. You still have to be careful with your solid state drive, but it will last a lot longer and is much less susceptible to breaking than other drives. This drive connects to your computer with a USB drive and has a USB micro B super speed connection that hooks into the drive itself. This is a tiny, high-capacity expansion drive that is perfect for ensuring you won't lose any data.

This is one of the best power strips I've ever seen. It is large, durable and has plenty of outlets for all your office equipment, tools or appliances. I like how the outlets are separated so that there is plenty of room for bulky plugs. This strip has convenient wall mounts so you can fix it in place and create a highly efficient work station. With all the electronic devices we have now, it seems like there are never enough outlets. If you are looking for a power strip so you can recharge the batteries on your power tools, or protect your computer from a lighting strike, this is the product to choose.

This is a terrific monitor that is going to make my work day a lot easier. First of all at 27 inches it is huge. I included a picture to show you how much bigger the monitor is than a typical laptop screen. Also, the monitor does not have the glare that is created by my laptop screen. It's like the difference between a matte finish and a glossy finish on a paperback. The glossy finish starts to tire your eyes at the end of the day, and the matte finish keeps you fresh. I'm finding I don't have to take as many eye breaks with this new monitor.

Installation is easy. The stand is solid and goes together without any tools. The TV also locks into the stand with no tools and has both a vertical and a tilt adjustment. There is a set of control keys along the side that allow you to make adjustments to the picture. I turned down the brightness to try to match the screen of my laptop. It came with a VGA cable, an audio cable, and a power cable. There is a HDMI plug in the back, but no HDMI cable was included with the purchase price.

Note that you have to use the button on the side of the monitor to turn it on, not the switch located next to the power cable. This is a very nice monitor.

These are nice, I've been trying to get earbuds to work with my kids, but they keep falling out of their ears. My kids (girls aged 5 and 3) were excited about these. They're fans of the Transformers, and these look like they're designed after Optimus Prime. Of course they fought over them at first (I was only offered one set), so I might have to get another one.

So far they've held up to kid wear and tear, which is considerable. I thought the sound was pretty good for them, but the big thing is that the kids are just willing to wear them. Works so far.

I received a free product in exchange for an honest review.

This is a neat little speaker. It claims to be waterproof, and I think it would handle a brief rain shower, but I doubt you'd want to throw it into a swimming pool. Still, for poolside entertainment this thing is great. The ports are covered up by a rubber cover, so I think it's about as water resistant as a speaker can be. Beneath the cover is also an on/off switch. It's a tactile switch, not a button so you don't have to sit there pressing it while counting to five or anything ridiculous.

The sound of the speaker is very good for such a little item. The speaker itself is about as wide as an old VHS tape just to give you an idea of scale. There's also a flashlight on one end, which makes this a nice camping item.

Recommended!

I received a free sample in exchange for an honest review.

These are what you'd expect them to be, it's essentially a neoprene chunk of fabric with a zipper down the side. Lately I've been doing everything I can to move away from cables of any kind. When the apocalypse happens, people will look at the rolling balls of useless cables and wonder just what was wrong with our society. But this cable wrap makes things a little bit better. I'm constantly swapping out an audio cable, so it's nice to have that cable bundled (because the darn thing gets lost otherwise). These are attractive and functional.

Good product. I received a free sample in exchange for an honest review.

I'd been using the same router that the cable company installed when I signed my contract back in 2009. I figured that any 2016 entry level router should be a noticeable upgrade. I've had movies stall in the middle of streaming, etc.

This was a quick and easy install and yes, i'm not getting as much movie stalling...but it still happens occasionally. So I'm satisfied, but not ecstatic. I was hoping to eliminate stalling completely. Still, it does seem to be better. Maybe I should have tossed in the next $50 for the better version...I'll keep that in mind for when 2022 rolls around and it's time to upgrade again.

Unit looks really cool.

For $19 this is a pretty solid deal when you consider that the voice recorder can also be used as a MP3 player. There is a little speaker down at the base, and when the volume is at full blast this little guy is surprisingly loud. My only issue is that the controls are a little tricky to work out. This is necessitated by the fact that this is a slim, tiny device (It's a little bigger than one of those old Kingston USB drives), so there's not that much space to put controls on the thing. For volume, you have a push a button, then wait for the volume indicator to flash, before toggling another button. While the MP3 player was playing at full blast, this was a little distressing...but I eventually figured it out.

The voice recorder works well too. In that case, the controls are easy, you just depress a switch above the power button and it starts to record. Playback is a little tougher, but when you plug this into your computer (USB cable included), it's easy to download the voice notes.

I had a little more trouble loading up MP3s as you couldn't put them in a folder. You have to copy and paste the actual MP3 files and paste them into the Proster folder that indicates the device.

When I played the voice notes stored on the device, there was a note from the factory in what I assume was China. It was just a few second sample of some ladies chatting in a work place, but I found that kind of interesting. This would be a good reorder to bring to meetings with people you don't trust as it records better than the voice recorder on your cell phone and it's easier to hide. Kind of a nice piece of equipment. I anticipate I'll use it running since I don't like earbuds and this blasts a lot of volume.

This is a very nice product. I spend a lot of my time listening to podcasts while I do a 1.5 hr drive to work. In the past, I used to just sit my telephone in a cradle and turn the volume up, but at freeway speeds the ambient noise was enough to make it hard to hear the sound coming from the phone's speaker.

This product charges in your cigarette lighter and allows you to connect your phone to the car radio via bluetooth. You then have to pick a radio station that is not carrying a broadcast and set the control on the bluetooth FM to the same station. All of this sounds like a lot while I'm typing it out, but it goes quickly. However, I do highly recommend that you make sure the radio is set up correctly before you start driving. There are enough accidents caused by texting, and this does represent another potential driving distraction. If you set this item up while parked, it is very useful, but if you try to do it on the roll, then it could be dangerous...fair warning.

Once you have your phone connected to your car speaker system you can listen to your own music, podcasts, etc. It is a little bit of a problem when somebody calls you, however, because the device doesn't automatically un-pair when there is a call. I found I usually had to call people back if I got a phone call. Not a huge issue really.

There is also a mini flash card slot on this device so you could play your music directly from that.

Really a good product. I received a complimentary sample in exchange for an honest review.

I got this for use at one of the few remaining drive-in theaters in the state of Wisconsin. I hook it up to a larger speaker that I connect to my cell phone with bluetooth. The radio works great, and this helps save money since I'm not using my data plan on my phone to access a radio station through an app.

The speaker on this radio is fairly effective for use in a very small room, but it works better if you hook it up to a larger speaker through the audio jack.

I've had great luck with Toshiba products and this one is no different. I used it to back up my hard drive. I don't subscribe to a cloud service, instead, I periodically purchase an external hard drive and do a back up, then I store the hard drive away from my computer. I don't like to keep my back up plugged into my computer because a power surge might blow out both the computer and the back up.

At the price, it's good for peace of mind to just buy one of these, back up your computer, and then store the item in a safe deposit box (that's probably cheaper than paying $7 a month for a cloud service). You have all the pictures of your kids throughout your life on your computer, and this is the solution that most appeals to me. Love that they're so cheap these days.

I have reviewed multiple name brand earbuds and wasn't impressed by a single one of them! I now have a pile of earbuds that I hate and never use. I came across these and figured I'd try them for some reason and instantly was blown away by the clarity of phone calls with it! I have a phone that costs over $1,000 and these headphones microphones and sound are many times better than my phones built in ones! I talked to someone about it and was truly impressed for the price point and they weren't surprised and poitned out that this is a legit company that makes a lot of high end electronics. They made a bunch of those expensive tape decks/ sound systems back in the day that cost thousands of dollars! Those things still work after all these years which is a testament to this company's quality.

I absolutely stand behind these earbuds and even told some friends they need to grab a set!

So for the shower- this things great! But outside the shower I'm just not impressed with this. I've reviewed several $20 ish price range bluetooth speakers and each of them has a little more bass and oomph than this one. It's pretty weak for what it is, even my Echo dot puts out more sound. That being said, this does get decently loud and is just fine for the shower! I used the attached suction and put it in my shower and it was great not having to reach outside the shower and touch my phone with wet hands to skip songs or commercials on youtoube.

Some things I've noticed on youtube though- I'll click the next button when it has a ad up and I can skip it. It'll then just send me to the next song as well and I'll have to hit the back button if I want to return to my original song. The ad will still be out of the way at this point so it WORKS for this, just kinda adds one more step. Just a minor annoyance but still so much better than having youtube take advantage of me being in the shower and cramming 2 to 3 ads at me at once since I often don't wanna reach outta the shower to hit skip every couople of minutes.

Battery lifes decent. For the price, it's not bad at all. Again, I'd really just use this for the shower. Maybe outside around a pool even... But if you're not using it for the waterproof feature, I'd skip it- the sound quality isn't impressive at all.

I have to kind of dig my nail into the volume key pretty much to get them to work as they're very flat. Other than that- the rest of the buttons work flawlessly and this is pretty much a clone of the original remote but with a few flatter buttons. The wheel and air mouse works perfectly. Didn't have to do any programming with my 70 inch LG 70UN7370PUC tv, it just paired with it after a couple tries and was ready to go! Considering the features on this remote, I think the price is pretty good. The volume buttons aren't a deal breaker, just could be a little more pronounced so they're easier to press is all.

I have a few of these little things around so I can have one in my workout room, one in my wood shop, kitchen, living room- I just put them everywhere so I always have a computer handy without lugging a laptop around. Might not make sense to some but that's my reason for loving these little things- it makes it affordable to put multiple computers in the house.

Functionality wise- this works really well and doesn't have any lag when streaming tv or anything like that. It's a great little computer for streaming/ surfing the net. It obviously doesn't have the requirements for hardcore online gaming but for other basic uses- it pretty much does it all! Love this little computer!

So it's cheaper and when you record audio- it's not going to be crystal clear and you'll hear some static probably. It's clear enough that you can make out what it's saying without difficulty though. For the price point, I honestly can't complain. The remote works perfectly, it was easy to record my own audio, and the sensor works well. Speaker gets plenty loud and has adjustable volume which is nice.

If you're planning on using this as a prank thing- FYI it has a little red light that stays on even when it's turned off. (that ones kind of dim though) But when it's tripped by motion- it has like four bright led lights on it that flash as the audio goes off so unless you knew how to open this up and remove those or you maybe painted the red face of this to cover the leds, it's gonna not work so well to be a hidden prank box.

SO this has an IPS monitor which gives you higher definition and clarity than an LED monitor. But also it uses more energy and these types of monitors are known for heating up and overheating which can cause premature failure. To further add to this issue, some genius put its heat fan pointed RIGHT at the front of the monitor. I've never seen this in a laptop and don't understand why they couldn't vent it out the side or even reposition the monitor slightly so they could vent the heat out the back. I'm really hoping that the heat blowing onto the monitor that's already known for heat issues isn't gonna be an issue. Within a few short minutes of regular browsing, its fan is blowing non-stop and the bottom part of the actual computer screen is getting hot because of the exhaust fan.

Other than the screen and heat issue, the laptop seems to be nicely made. It only took a couple of minutes to setup and streams videos/ surfs the net flawlessly when paired with my gigabit internet. It's not slow at all- loads programs quickly and loads web pages quickly.

I think it's a good computer overall and they're on the right track with this one. It looks really cool and runs great! The thing that I love about it's finish is it's not glossy- those always scratch up and look junky quickly. The finish on this one will stay looking great for years I'm sure!

This turned out to be a pretty decent turntable but you can absolutely find a higher quality one cheaper like an Audio Technica. But this one does the job and plays well still. Haven't had any problems at all with it playing records and I've had it play about 20 different ones now. Doesn't skip or have any crazy noise to it while running. I'm no turntable expert so don't know all the various things to look at but as a common person, I can tell you it's a decently made turntable and works great!

Great value, well made, works perfectly! It setup instantly and paired with my phone right away. Sound thru this is flawless like I have a cord hooked directly into my car stereo- highly recommend this bluetooth adapter!

Very impressed with all of it! The camera gives a very good clear image, the microphone picks up my voice very clearly, the speakers are very clear with no distortion, and the image quality of the monitor is fantastic! For what you get and the price point, this is actually pretty impressive! This saves a bunch of space and cleans up my area to have built in speakers, webcam, and microphone!

I used this on a zoom meeting and a skype call- worked perfectly for both of those! I'm no tech genius so don't know all of the various specs on this but I can say as a regular consumer, this thing is really nice and well built!

Put this on my dining room wall and it looks fantastic! Very good vivid image, very state of the art tv! Speakers are plenty loud- don't need a soundbar even! I can't tell you about all of the features on it but it has a ton of amazing cutting edge features and for the picture you get- the price point isn't bad at all! I highly recommend this one!

Easy to set up screen! Setup didn't take long at all and we were off to watching movies! We've used this multiple times now and love it! Very good quality item. Blower isn't too loud as you put it behind the screen away from you.

I've never had a gimbal so this has been a learning experience for me! Had to learn how to use it and set it up but once I did- this things great! It's very well made and is a complex amazing little device! It does exactly what it should and it's movements are insanely smooth, I'm truly impressed with this! Definitely worth the price they're asking for it! As with any fine tuned piece of equipment- handle it with kid gloves, it's well made but like cameras, very fragile feeling too!

These fit well and feel good on my head. I love that they're wireless and I am no longer bound to cords. They connect and stay connected to my computer's bluetooth, my phone, my tablet, and my tv with no problem. Audio is great for all of these devices from music to television, audio is all very clear! Noise cancellation works great on these, I love to put them on sometimes just to drown out any noise and clear my head. The bass on these is fair, it's not as booming as some more expensive headphones but it has a fair amount. Personally I don't want a lot of bass in my ears as too much of that can be bad for your hearing.

These are the most premium headphones I've owned and I love them! If you compare these to really high end headphones- you'll be disappointed all around. But if you look at the price point and what you get- you'll treasure these. For the price point you can't beat these in my opinion!

I've tested a few soundbars for Amazon and this by far is my favorite! I'm actually giving away my old ones and putting this one front and center with my 65" tv permanently! Very impressed!

For music- it definitely gets PLENTY loud. It has a little bit of a thump to it bass wise, about what you'd expect from a soundbar. Not going to vibrate your walls off but not extremely weak. You can feel the little speakers pumping air out if you put your hand in front of them which is pretty cool!

For tv- it had me put the headset thing on and move around the room to calibrate it. I did this and then watched a couple movies. VERY impressed with this for watching movies too!

Overall this is just a fantastic bar!! I don't want speakers all over my living room taking up space and junking up the place so I wanted one nice soundbar and this certainly fits the bill for that! It's a very sleek looking long soundbar that gets as loud as I'd ever need it to and gives me a good clear quality audio. My only room for improvement would be to offer a matte finish, I hate the glossy top as it'll show scratches later. My easy workaround? Just get a roll of good quality vinyl in your choice of color and carefully cut it to fit! We did this and now we have a neon green topped bose soundbar! Love it!

Definitely grab this soundbar and give it a try!

If comparing this to a $2,000 projector, no it won't match up to that of course. But if you're looking for a budget projector with really good picture- this is it! I gave it 5 stars not because it's as good as high end projectors but because it's an amazing budget projector with pretty good quality picture for the price! Very impressed with this for the price point!

Good quality projector that works really well, has built in speakers but as with any of them, I'd recommend using external speakers- you just really get a better experience. Don't have to be high end speakers, any will work. But the built in ones do a decent job if you're not needing louder audio for a group of people.

Overall I'm just really impressed with this for the price point and happy with all of it's functions and features! No problem setting it up and it works very well!

I have a 2012 Nissan Versa with a cd player and a AUX inplut is all... No bluetooth for the music and I'm tied down to using a cord. So when this came today I instantly plugged it into the car, pushed it's on button, paired it, and it works flawlessly! For the size and price I didn't know what to think but I'm genuinely surprised and very happy with this! I also plugged this into the AUX port of my jukebox and now I can play songs on my jukebox thru my phone and not have to leave the phone by the jukebox like I did before with a AUX cord! Definitely a game changer!

Sound quality is flawless, no static or anything. Battery life must be just fine- I haven't had it die after a day of playing with it! It does come with a charging cord and works while being charged so my advice to you is to make sure you have a wall plug or car charger for it (depending on where you're gonna use it) and have that ready for a backup so you can keep the music going or just charge it when it needs it!

SO no complaints at all here! This is just day one so if I have any problems in the future- I'll update this review. Hope you found this helpful!

I love that I can just hook this in the shower and listen to music in there! Volume gets PLENTY loud, clarity is good. Size is comparable to an echo dot.  Quality of this overall is great! Highly recommend this one!

Much better clarity than any bank surveillance you've ever seen- you can actually see faces and such on these! This system was very easy to setup and is very easy to use. Seems very well made and I'm very happy with it overall! No complaints at all!!

My jukebox has an AUX In so I hooked this to it and plugged it into the usb port to power it. Paired it with my phone and now I run music from my phone to the jukebox! Love it! Easy to setup and provides great quality audio! Highly recommend! Feels like a very sturdy well made product too, not cheap flimsy trash.
Got a new phone that only has the usb c port so I grabbed this to be able to plug it into my car for music and it works perfectly! Great audio quality! Well made and nice looking cord.

I love this tv, it is definitely a masterpiece! Very well made and fantastic quality. Deep blacks, vivid colors, natural skin tones...

Not the thinnest tv on the market but a great tv still! Easy to set up and get going. Slim feet that slide into place with no tools- only have ONE configuration. 2 USBs, 4 HDMIs, Ethernet, optical & headphone outputs, & a mini a/v input. Operating system is Google Tv which works smoothly and has lots of apps built in. Works with Google Home and Alexa.

Has some intrusive ads on the homepage. You can go into the settings/privacy/ ads to opt out of personalized ads though. You can use your remote microphone to do voice commands on the tv. It also has the nice shortcut buttons for Youtube, Netflix, Disney+, and Prime Video.

Sound has tweeters on the side. It upscales the audio to give you a surround sound effect. Acoustic auto calibration which when you go to your sitting area with the remote and start this- it sends these crazy alien laser blaster sounds out of the speakers for a couple seconds and your remote reads them so the tv can process the information and adjust your speakers accordingly. It will then adjust the speakers so it sends sound to where you're sitting to give you the best experience possible!

The cognitive processor in this puts more emphasis into the areas of the picture that you'll be focused on- definitely makes a noticeable difference!

XR TRILUMINOS PRO technology gives you better color accuracy and depth.

XR Contrast booster gives you better contrast.

Very deep blacks with very little light blooming (meaning it has very even brightness across the screen.) The screen has PLENTY of brightness, that is definitely not an issue with this tv!

Ambient optimization option which changes your screen based on the ambient lighting in the room. Controls brightness and color tones. There are settings to optimize the screen for Netflix, Imax, Cinema, Etc that are amazing!

Motion is great, it has 120 hertz which keeps up with the action very well! You can adjust the Motionflow settings to your custom settings or just set it to auto and let it do it's thing.

Comparing it to the other top Sony models:
If you're on a budget and this is on the higher end of that, you might look into the Sony X80J- it's also a 2021 model and is 4k Ultra HD. It's not quite as nice of a picture as this Full Array but it's still a great tv! Otherwise if you can swing it- this X90J Full Array is definitely a fantastic choice! If your budget can STILL swing more though, you might even look into the X90J OLED tv, it's picture pops even more than this Full Array. Whatever your choice, you'll love any of them! I have all 3 models and we absolutely love each and every one of them- the X80 and X90 line are just fantastic tvs at a really fair price point.

Beautiful true blacks and insanely lifelike vivid colors make the picture pop almost like it's 3D/ real life! Very impressive features jam packed into this! Sound is amazing- you won't need a soundbar at all. Super thin screen, the thickness of a folder. Screen has a nice metal edge which helps protect it. Setup was quick and easy. Very slim lightweight remote with nice shortcut buttons to all of your favorite streaming services. Apps load quickly and run smoothly in this tv.

Feet are easy to install, no tools or screws which is amazing. They can be attached to make your tv flat on the surface or raised so you can put a soundbar down. You can also put the feet closer together and further apart. Lots of options which is nice!

Some of the features I love on this are:
*The auto light sensor- it adjusts the screen brightness based on the lighting of the room. (this feature can be turned off of course)
*Acoustic auto calibration- you sit wherever (like on your couch) and it sends these loud sound blasts that sound like alien gun blasters. The blasts reach the mic in your remote where you are sitting and then the tv records the information and auto calibrates the sound so it reaches you better based on your room and where you're sitting.
*The speakers use vibration to turn the whole display into a loudspeaker- sending sound everywhere. Small subwoofers in the back to give it an extra bump of bass. You absolutely notice this technology working- the sound is amazing and PLENTY loud. You can always add surround sound if you have to have a deep boom of bass like in the movie theater though.
*XR Motion processing- means blur-free scenes. You can really notice this on things like watching sports from football to surfing.
*Upscaling is great. HDR is fantastic too- I really notice the differences in skin tones, they look a lot more natural on this tv. The XR processor really puts noticeable light into the highlights of the picture which really helps the image pop.

The bravia core seems more like a advertising gimmick, wasn't impressed with that at all.
That aside- this tv does definitely tout a lot of tech packed into one nice looking slim package! It has a TON of settings and customizations you can play with and set it up exactly like you want it! I've never seen so many different settings in a tv! No worries, if you don't want to customize, you certainly can just choose one of the standard programmed modes and the tv still produces a gorgeous picture!

CONS:
*The only ones I have noticed that might be a deal breaker are there is no functioning VRR and it only has two hdmi 2.1 ports which might mean that you won't want this if you're a gamer.
*Has a matte anti reflective coating which really doesn't do an amazing job at keeping reflections out of the tv like the coating they put on the 90J- that one does a better job. It doesn't make it unwatchable, it's just that sometimes you might notice a reflection in the tv in settings with windows nearby or a light fixture that shines near it.

Comparing this to the 90J I notice some other things:
The 80J doesn't have the heatsink in the back that the 90J does. This might become noticeable for gamers and is a letdown. The speakers are a little less powerful in this tv than the 90J, they sound good but don't have as much power. The 80J doesn't have the backlit Sony remote that the 80J has which is crazy and a replacement remote in case you're wondering costs a whopping $80!!

At $1300 less than the 90J, the decision for me is clear! I definitely say go with this 80J because the small improvements aren't worth paying the $1300 more. BUT if price isn't an issue- go for the 90J. I can tell you for sure, you'll be happy with either that you choose, they're both fantastic devices that are well built and jam packed with the latest tech and features.

Very sleek looking amazing machine! Powers on very quickly and runs flawlessly smooth no matter what demanding tasks I'm doing.

Looking at the outer case you'll see a metal shell on the top and bottom with a diamond cut polished edge that results in a stunning sturdy feeling shell! On the inside you see a very classy looking carbon fiber palm rest. You'll also notice they took out the 10 key pad to make room for big speaker panels on each side of the keyboard. The panel is so large because it has a speaker on top and a subwoofer on the bottom which makes for very impressive sound! You definitely won't need to tote around external speakers with this! You can however get a 10 key pad that hooks into one of the 4 usb- c ports. Those ports are all thunderbolt 3 ports which support full native 8k resolution (this is the smallest workstation on the market that has this feature.)

The screen is a gorgeous 17" touch screen UHD+ display that has hardware enabled blue light filtering that doesn't cause that ugly dimming or yellowing that others do. This keeps your graphics looking good while reducing the strain on your eyes and you will absolutely notice the difference! It drastically helps your eyes when you have to work many hours at a time without a break.

Supports Windows Hello so you can use a pin number, fingerprint, or your face to login. The power button in the upper right is unmarked due to it doubling as the fingerprint reader. The facial recognition works thru the IR camera and it can be set to lock your computer the second you walk away from it and unlock it when you come back. Amazing for shared work spaces where you're constantly having to get up and leave your computer- never have to worry about whether you locked it or not! The camera and microphone built in are impressive- I've done Skype video calls and Zoom meetings and gotten flawless results without even needing an external microphone! The camera produces a very smooth video feed that isn't ever choppy as long as you have a good reliable internet that's high speed.

If you're wondering about the price tag, it's because this isn't a laptop- it's workstation. This is more made for things like high end video work, medical imaging, architectural work, 3D CAD, graphic design, animation, AI, and VR (this is also the smallest workstation on the market that is VR capable.) As for video editing- I'm VERY impressed. You get very smooth playback while editing 4k videos and can do it in much less time than other workstations- extremely impressive!

If you're worried about it overheating while you're running more demanding tasks and multitasking- it has metal and copper channels inside of it that help the dual output fans cool it and push hot air thru the system and out the back which keeps this thing running cool! I've yet to see mine begin to overheat while I'm running demanding programs and really pushing it.

Working from home and on the go- this is absolutely your perfect solution and the best workstation on the market in my opinion! I'm just blown away by this impressive powerhouse of a workstation! Dell really took my breath away with how well built this is and how jam packed with tech it is. I could tell you about the tech in it all day long but I'll leave the rest for you to research on your own. It suffices to say- this is a workstation that can handle quite the work load and not begin to get weighed down in the process, total game changer!! This is definitely the one you've been looking for!

I have had several low end projectors and figured this was just another one that was basically a $70 range projector but without even knowing the price point I would say this could easily retail for $150-$200! I was very surprised with the features on it and the picture quality is really good!

It was very easy to set up the screen mirror from my phone and I started streaming youtube from my phone to the projector within like 2 minutes of turning the projector on the for the first time! Very good picture and it has built in speakers that are decent. It doesn't get LOUD but it's build in speakers are usable without hooking up any external speakers. If you're doing an outdoor movie for a crowd- you'd wanna set up some sort of external speakers though, it's not loud enough for a big area.

Picture is very clear, color is decent. It's color doesn't "pop" like a higher end projector would (It's slightly washed out) But in the lower end projectors you really can't get a solid crisp color with any of them so at a lower price point, I wouldn't be complaining as when you turn the lens and focus the image, it provides a sharp picture with usable color.

Overall I say yes this is a great starter projector! If you're just getting it for kids, there are ones in the $70 range that might also work for your needs but if you want to use it for movie night or whatever, this works great too! Just don't get it expecting the same results of a more expensive projector. If you need high definition in video, you always have to pay the price!

We've been using this on a 150" outdoor movie screen and it looks amazing even at that size! The picture is very clear, colors are vivid, just an overall amazing picture! The sound in the speakers is great but if you need it louder you can hook up your own external speaker(s) via Bluetooth or a 3.5mm audio cable. We use Bluetooth to hook it up to a tailgating speaker so we can have sound as loud as it is at the theater.

Setup was extremely easy and the size is very portable. If anyone is wondering, sure this COULD replace a tv. Personally, I wouldn't as these look best in the dark. But if you had a dark room or got darkening curtains then sure you could replace your tv with this. This won't replace a fancy ultra HD tv of course but the picture quality is fantastic still. From what I've seen, for every inch you have it away from the wall you're projecting on, you'll have nearly that in screen size. So for a 100" screen, you'll need to space the projector back about 100" (give or take a few inches.)

I've reviewed several smaller projectors and this one is by far my favorite! You won't regret buying it! If this is the price range you're looking for- grab it!!

I sit this way off to the side of my computer and when a friend calls on skype, I'll use this microphone while multitasking and they can hear me just fine no matter where I am in the room. Very nice microphone with very clear sound. NO complaints at all, very fair price, made very well!

SO first and foremost, they have the size clearly listed- it's on me for not looking at the dimensions. I honestly had no idea they had Bluetooth pieces this big though! It's genuinely bulkier than any headset I've used in the several call centers I've worked in and the only way to be able to semi comfortably use this is to use the piece that goes over your head and makes it a headset. Great for people on the road a lot/ truckers! But for the common person, this is wayyy too bulky and goofy looking.

Bulk aside- the sound quality is great. Cancellation of background noise works really well! Battery life is great. It's an amazing Bluetooth piece if you can get past the humongous size!

Pairing my phone to this- absolutely makes for some quality audio! I love to use it while cleaning around the house and playing music as it's loud enough I can hear it throughout the house clearly. The sound clarity and quality is just fantastic! I might grab a 2nd one for my home gym out in my garage it's so great.

Not a good replacement for the factory speakers on my 70" tv though... With my tv, it's either factory speakers or the external surround sound or speaker bar. So I just paired this to the tv via Bluetooth and used it to watch tv with it and it was very one-directional for what it was. The audio from my tv does a better job at spreading itself out thru the room. NOW that being said, for a smaller tv this would work perfectly I think. Even if it doesn't work out for your tv, you have a fantastic soundbar for music!

I was skeptical at first when I got these and saw their size but I plugged them in and paired them to my phone and played a few music videos and was blown away by the audio quality and also how loud these can get! For the price point, this is a STEAL and you absolutely won't find any better wireless speakers in this price range so definitely grab these, you'll love them!!!

We tried all of the features on the speakers and remote and everything works flawlessly. These speakers are well built and look really classy on my kitchen counter. This is easily one of my favorite items I've reviewed and I absolutely am in love with them! The sound quality is fantastic and everything is crisp and clear! I could not ask for more.

Decent little basic speakers, clear enough audio. Not amazing for music honestly, audio is kind of bad for that even if you aren't an audiophile. I don't expect the quality of high end speakers for this price point but it still should be noted that the audio from this isn't anything great.

The lights are neat but not sound reactive so they just slowly cycle thru the colors. I love that you can switch the lights off when you don't want to see them and love the volume control on the wire. Overall I liked these well enough, just not happy with them for playing music.

I love this Acer so much! To anyone thinking the specs are wimpy, I'd say to them no for the price you're not getting a super gaming machine- you have to spend big bucks for that. But for the common person to play some average games and definitely for people just wanting to surf the net, watch youtube or Netflix- YES!

I use mine for surfing the web pretty much and I've never had a solid-state drive, the things are 100 % silent. The computer has a very smooth and quiet fan located on its main board that sometimes will kick on and if the room is dead silent you can hear it barely. So sound-wise it's fantastic. From the moment I push the power button, the computer turns on as quick as my monitor does! I feel like there's a sorcerer inside of my computer who turns it on so fast because in all my many years of owning computers, never have I ever seen one boot so fast! And in a busy world, slow booting computers is NOT something I have time to play with!

So beyond the lightning-fast bootup, it runs flawlessly! I hooked up a wireless mouse and keyboard set to it instead of the nice-looking wired set that comes with it. It handles the keyboard and mouse flawlessly. Honestly, I cannot think of a single bad thing to say about this pc! My last pc cost about $1,000 and had much crazier specs than this one but for the price point of this, I wish they would have had this Acer when I got my last desktop! Definitely get it, you will not regret it! I'm thinking of purchasing a 2nd one for my garage gym now so I can have access to all my music and everything easily. For the price point, why not?

SO I have large dogs that trip over and destroy my keyboard cords- I HAVE to use wireless keyboards. Thru the years I've been thru many many different models mainly from one big-name brand competitor who's seemingly cornered the market in wireless keyboards. So how does this one compare to the big name ones?  A breath of fresh air in the wireless keyboard world let me tell ya!  This thing is plug n play and it stays connected, unlike my other keyboard sets that quite often froze up and missed keys I pressed. The keys are all easy to press and are smooth/ quiet when you press them. The mouse works flawlessly as well. Overall I say this set is many times better than the overpriced competition! I did get this keyboard for free in exchange for a review but for an unbiased opinion and my unbiased opinion is I really love this set and have been using it daily since I got it. I literally threw out my name brand set because I got tired of it locking up.  Give it a shot- you'll love it.

Nice looking frame. Sadly the speaker is lacking, you can barely hear any audio. It does have a headphone jack though so you could run that to an external speaker or stereo system. The whole package altogether is very nice looking, I love the presentation as well as the product!

The downside was it was hard to figure out how to connect the picture frame to the app! You simply give it a name and then it creates an email based on that. Then you can connect it to the app. The app doesn't see Google photos on Android and Google photos doesn't let me drag photos to a folder the app can see SO I'm left with using a SD card and saving them there or connecting the frame via the USB cord.

But once you get the hang of the picture frame, it's a good quality product! I just wish they'd make the app easier to use- setup shouldn't be this difficult.
Easy to install, amazing clarity and download speed!

This product is as described. The sound is startling and loud. The end of the keychain does not pull out too easily, where you may accidentally pull it. I like the SOS button feature as well as the pull option. I bought one for myself and my teen daughter.

These filters are awesome.  PLEASE NOTE, YOU CAN NOT FOCUS ON PHOTOS CLOSE UP WITH THE 10X FILTER using the 18-55 lens.  However, ALL of the filters are great.  Quality made, durable and do exactly as advertised.  I even stacked the 2X and 4X and the clarity (focus) was magnificent.  And this was with a Canon T7.  You cannot go wrong with these filters especially for the price.

I use these for work, 8 hours a day in a work from home call center. I have a large head and am a big guy. The sound is fantastic for voice communication, I would never use these for gaming, music or multimedia. The audio range is not good enough for those applications, it is great for voice. The microphone works beautifully and others can hear me clearly and crisply.

To say that these are "passive" noise cancelling is laughable. There is really no such thing as passive noise cancelling, it's just how much noise is blocked out by wearing the headphone. Do not take that into consideration when buying headphones, unless they totally cover the ear. You can hear everything going on around you.

The ear pads are pretty comfortable, much more than a foam ear pad on standard headphones. I do need to pull these away from my ears every now and then to restore circulation and reduce soreness. Durability of the pad itself is in question, but I have not had these long enough to figure that out. First impression is the pad might last 6-12 months using 5 days a week for work. To me the pads seem to be a weak spot durability speaking.

Overall a great headphone for work. If these had active noise cancelling and a more comfortable/durable ear pad, they would be perfect. I have no experience with microphone filtering yet.

We originally purchased a first generation Alexa when they came out. It is a great device that we still use in another part of the house now that we have this newer generation version. Aside from it being a little shorter and more stout, it's otherwise no different whatsoever from the first generation. The one exception to that is the sound. The bass is just slightly better on the new device, but not a lot to make an impact. Sound is still dull, with no defining highs or lows, just more a blaring mid range sound. If they can fix this or offer a device with much better audio, we'd get that. Is it with the money to upgrade from a Gen1? I'd say no, not yet.

To mention right off the bat, I am not even an amateur radio operator, just someone who enjoys radio. I find radio to be far more romantic and compelling than modern methods of broadcasting. Staying up late in the night and turning the dial with the soft glow of the tuner, the sound of static and mystery that can sometimes accompany radio broadcasts offers something truly genuine that you can't get anywhere else today. That feeling is priceless and not duplicable (If that was even a word).

Anyway, this radio is good quality and contains the capability needed to reach further than most others. If you enjoy radio as I do, a clock radio, ghetto blaster or home stereo won't cut it. If you know what I am talking about, then this radio is for you. I've stayed up many nights listening to Coast to Coast AM on the internet, but it lacked the feeling something like this radio will bring you. I was unable to pick up a station on my home stereo to listen to CTC and was forced to use the internet. The internet provided a clear, stereo sounding broadcast and was very clear.

The CC Radio has been spoken about on the program for many years. I finally picked one up and am very pleased with it's performance. I can now pick up the radio broadcast of Coast to Coast AM and with all the nuances I expect of a a late night radio broadcast. When interesting speakers talk about compelling topics, a crystal clear internet broadcast does not move you inside. However, using the CC Radio, the slight static, the slight fading in and out and all other fantastic experiences you can only receive using a real radio, it has the ability to make you feel and even send chills up your spine. There is just something a good solid radio can do for you that nothing else can and the CC Radio delivers on that 100%.

You will not be disappointed and I really need to get my license.
Packaged well and easy to connect. Sound quality is not bad for the price. I just got these and will update more as I use them.

I was a little nervous to use this because of the heat aspect plus all of the inner booklets/instructions have no English translation on them. It was super straight forward to use.

One click on, each subsequent click gets hotter until it’s off.

I only used the first heat setting and it was more than enough to curl my lashes. I’m not sure I’ll be using the hotter ones until I get better with it as I don’t want to risk burns.

My curl lasted about 6 hours before I really noticed it had gone down. That might have been largely because of the mascara I was using but I will experiment with others.

Very pretty “lash lift” type of effect.

You do have to put on mascara first, then use this curler so make sure you clean it well after each use. It comes with a little clear cover for the end which is nice for keeping it in my makeup case.

I have always fallin asleep to the tv on. I wore the wired ear buds but had to only wear 1 as It hurt to lay on your side wearing it. And you had the wire you get tangled in when I rolled over and I had to switch ears and locate the other bud to fit properly thus disturbing my sleep longer. This is so comfortable to wear. Blacks out light completely. I am able to open my eyes and look around while wearing them. There is a velvet roll fir the nose you can adjust for the gaps there completely blocking al light. My ears do not hurt in the morning and I am getting better quality of sleep. I started sleeping to brown noise rather than a tv show as it is constant not up and down loud noises. My only downside I could find was the placement on the ears. I must have a big head as it does not fit perfectly over my ear as I would like but not enough to hate them. Thet last all night 9-10 hours and I recharge them every morning when I get up so they are ready.

Great for listening to stories and lectures, this little portable battery-operated cassette player is easy to use and puts out surprising volume. I wouldn't say the sound quality is great for music, but what do you expect? I use it to listen to audiobooks in my studio.

I needed a CD player for my studio, which has no electricity at the moment. This works great. The sound quality is what you'd expect from a smallish portable unit, but it's good enough for what I need. It has a carrying handle which would make it great for picnics or camping. It's not tiny. It's about the size of a loaf of rye bread, which makes the speakers better than the phone-sized units. It's pretty sturdy. I'm ashamed to say it fell out of the box onto the floor when I was unpacking it, but it's fine. (I wouldn't recommend doing that, but just sayin'.) In addition to the CD player, there is an AM/FM radio. All of the controls are easy to use. Perfect.

It charges, shares the screen with HDMI, has an audio connector, and makes sharing files much easier with two card readers and a USB3 port. I found out you can't use the transfer media while you are using the charging port. If you have trouble seeing your thumb drive, unplug the charging cord. Maybe it's just me, but it's no big deal anyway. It works! I like it.

If you remember the old game unit switches that allowed you to use multiple devices on one television set, this is like that, only for two computers sharing one monitor, keyboard, mouse, and other peripherals. The simple switch box connects to your monitor ("console") via the kind of cord with plugs on both ends you currently use to connect your monitor to your computer. (You will need an extra cord like this for the the purpose--not included. If you don't have a spare lying around, you should order one with the unit.) You will need the cords you are currently using for each of the two computers to connect them to the box. There are four USB sockets in the "console" section of the box. You plug your keyboard, mouse, and anything else you want to share between the two computers into those. (By the way, KVM stands for Keyboard, Video,Mouse.) The unit is powered, and offers multiple plug styles for international use. There is a place to plug in speakers and a mike for each computer. This switch has made it possible for me to streamline my office space considerably. Previously, I had two monitors, two keyboards, and two mice. It was very awkward. A warning to first time users, you may experience the microphone picking up background noise. It's very sensitive. Be prepared to set-up an area for recording if you are wanting to get clean audio. The VIMVIP USB Condenser Microphone came in a fairly plain box with a large hard foam protective insert. This microphone seems to be a great starting point for anyone interested in a higher quality microphone. I can whole heartedly recommend it.

The VIMVIP USB Condenser Microphone is a USB interface microphone that is a large step-up in quality to those used to the basic microphones that come with many web cameras. It provides a higher sensitivity to sounds; enabling both a greater ability to pick up lower volume noises and the ability to comprehend higher volume ones.

The lower volumes it was able to obtain included whispering, including the mouth noises associated with ASMR videos, and keystrokes from a non-mechanical keyboard roughly 6 feet away [With it's recording volume turned down to 50%]. On the higher end of volume it is able to accommodate singing, yelling, and screaming; by not topping out what it able to accommodate this allowed for wide arrays of vocals and would assist with those wanting to record instruments. I did many different experiments to test the range at home on different days.

The VIMVIP USB Condenser Microphone came with a short stand and pop filter that is attached to the stand by goose neck. The stand and metallic goose neck are both adjustable to assist with angling, but it is not vertically adjustable. The microphone, when pointing directly up, is about 26 cm / 10 in in height to the top of the microphone. It has a rubber ball footed desktop tripod for stability. The microphone can also detach from the included stand and be mounted to a standard size tripod or any other compatible stand, making the pop filter necessary depending on setup.

I had a great experience using VIMVIP USB Condenser Microphone to audition for a voice acting role organized by fellow fans of an animated series. The VIMVIP USB Condenser Microphone certainly made me sound much better than my webcam microphone is able to do. I have been using this for cooperative game-play online as well. This is a great value, especially at the price point.

I'm getting used to it but they are touch sensitive and there is a correct spot and amount of pressure that works best. I'm still getting a feel for it and there is a slight delay, so it's very easy to double-tap. The included booklet has been helpful to learn to use these straight out of the package.

Sometimes I get down on the floor at the gym to use the foam rollers and stretches, other times I'm using them in the car to take calls. I've tried them at work as well. Every scenario has worked well for me. I really do wish I've had these before. Sometimes while getting my breaks at work, I would want to listen to things from my phone, but didn't want to risk disturbing my co-workers with some of the news and hobby related videos I enjoy. I asked a few co-workers if they could hear my earbud noise, they could not.

The case is very easy to use as well and fits easily into my pockets. I'm a lady, so my pockets are not always very generously sized. It charges very quickly, and I've not found myself running out of charge. I cannot speak on the long-term durability for this as they are new. If/when I experience any issues with the charge, I will be sure to post an update.

In summary, these would be better for users that need to hear their surroundings for safety. For those that want extreme high volume, they may not be as happy. They stay on my ears securely and the case works very well. I'm pleasantly surprised how well I like these and hope that they are durable since they are working so well for me.

Thanks for reading my review. I hope you found it helpful.

This is a whole lot bigger than portable battery powered ones in the same price range that sound the same (I've got several of those), so I don't think I would purchase this myself. I used about 90 feet of cat-6 cable to connect this.  Some of the cable is cat-6a, connected to cat-6 in the middle, so cat-6 is the standard I can count on.  It works for 4k@30, but not 4k@60 and not 3d.  I put cables in the wall when the room was being built, and didn't know that 50' HDMI cables that say they work don't always.  So I'm upset, but this helped fix the problem because I ran ethernet to both locations and a few extra cables too.  If this did 3d, I would be 100% happy.  Since it doesn't, I may have to put the blu-ray player up with the projector and figure out a way to return the audio instead of using this for it.  But this will work for the cable box and computer that are also connected.  So, in summary, if you want 3d and have Cat-6 cable, this doesn't work.  If 4k@30 is enough without 3d, then this is what you need and it works great!  In case you are curious, I tested using two HDMI switches too, and the 4k@30 survived going through both switches and this pair too!

This little computer is very small considering what it packs in... It's sort of like a Raspberry Pi, but with less of the DIY angle. This computer has the processing power you need to run a home VPN, or a file share (using an external drive), or a gaming PC for old games (think retro-pi operating system), or a home movie box (store all your discs on a hard drive attached, or over the network, and use VLC or XBMC to watch them on your projector). Overall, I love this computer at this price point. There are plenty of others out there that sound similar, and I haven't tried them all, but I can tell you that this one stands up to the test.

While solar-powered cameras are convenient, I've found that they have too many compromises when it comes to functionality. In order to save on battery power, the software usually shuts down the camera when there is no activity. Usually, that means nothing gets recorded until the motion detector is set off. In addition, a couple of my solar cameras actually had firmware updates that made them almost unusable because the app can no longer wake the cameras up. This means that the only time I'm actually able to view the cameras are when there is actually motion to set it off.

This Reolink camera doesn't have those problems. It can be powered by a power adapter or power over ethernet. While this makes installing the camera more troublesome, it is worth it because I don't have problems like what I mentioned above.

In addition to solving this basic issue for me, I found that the Reolink camera is much more well-built than the solar cameras that I had previously. The camera mount is made of metal and the camera swivel mechanism is made of high-quality plastic.

The camera is pretty annoying during setup because it has a loud speaker that talks and talks until you finally pair it with your phone app but once done, the app runs like any other app that you might have used. It has controls for the pan, tilt, and zoom functions and it will show both of the built in cameras simultaneously.

This is a high-quality camera that justifies its price.
