I have been working with photos for a business situation, so I have managed to acquire some equipment for different uses for products. When I saw this, my partner wanted to put this to good use, so we decided to try it out. This review will be somewhat in depth.

RING SIZE
The ring itself is large sized which makes it nice for doing personal videos like makeup, and even just discussions and research, but it also is nice for doing larger product photos.

RING ROCKER SWITCH
The controls are a bit finicky. The on off rocker switch is kind of temperamental which is why it took me so long to get this review out. When turning on the rocker switch, the light sometimes will turn on and then off quickly. It takes a few times to get it to stay on which is frustrating.

PLUG
The plug insert is just under the switch. It goes in pretty solid.

CORD
The cord is about 10 ft long- I measured it. The plug is 2 prong. It has a pretty good fit into an outlet and is not loose.

DIALS
The two dials determine the brightness of the light and also the temperature. They are infinite settings so you can fine tune them pretty well.

LIGHT QUALITY
The light quality of this ring is solid. It does provide a lot of light and it does help to get a nice atmosphere for photos or video. The brightness can go pretty high and you can get it lower but one problem is that it will flicker as you get it on the lower settings.

CAMERA
The other issue I have with this is the camera. There is a screw that you can supposedly put a camera on, but that will not allow me to screw on the camera tightly so that it faces the same direction as the light. Then there is the issue of the camera holder. So, when I screw the camera onto that- it is a ball joint holder- I can screw it into the ring, but for some reason, once the attachment is in place, the ball won't tighten completely and the camera has some play in it.

I can tighten it and it stays put off the tripod,, but when the weight of the camera is on the ball joint, it does not like to lock tight for some reason.

WHAT TYPE OF CAMERA DO I HAVE?
I have a Canon G12 camera which is not that heavy or large, so this issue is not due to me trying to use a camera that is way too big.

PHONE
There is a phone holder so you can use your phone on this ring as well.

TRIPOD
The quality of the tripod seems solid. It can be set up to compensate for uneven ground and does seem to perform reasonably well when I have used it. I think it is fair to say that I do most of my photos indoors on even floors, so I have not put it to tough testing in that department. I love how it folds away to fit in the case.

CAN YOU USE THIS RING WITH OTHER TRIPODS?
I was able to screw this into a taller tripod that I have to use it if I wanted to, which I don't.

CASE
The case is part of the charm of this light. It is padded and fits the ring nicely. The tripod folds up perfectly compact into the back holder and pocket, and the front pocket with a zipper holds the attachments. It is fabulously designed.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This light ring is nice. It has great light, nice temperature settings, and is easy to use once you get it set up. Problems with attaching the camera and getting it stable, and occasional blinking of the light make this four instead of five stars, but I still work with it until I can figure out a solution.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. I like this set. It is perfect for taking on location filming or shooting photos, and it works well when I work past the frustrations.

MY PHOTOS
I took 3 photos for you of the exact same thing at the same time so you can see the difference in lighting and color perception. They are labeled for ease of understanding which is which.

I have waited a while to review this because I got it for my daughter who was very interested to have it, but after a while, she lost interest so it was back to me. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes in a box with a cord for recharging. It has a type C connector. There are also earbuds in the box. Insturctions? Well, not so much.

TOUCHSCREEN
That is kind of deceptive. This has a touch screen on bottom, but the top is not - where you see the photo of the album playing, the play button or other information.

MUSIC QUALITY
The music quality of this is fabulous. It is better using bluetooth headphones than the speaker or the cheap buds that come with this.

EAR BUD JACK
The problem with this player is that the jack is very touchy. If you move just right it will disconnect either ear and that is totally annoying when using this.

MUSIC SEQUENCE
That is another odd feature of this player. This will play in order when I have albums in it and so far they play in alphabetical order which is rather strange. I can not get it to play any other way than this way, so if you are using this and want to hear what YOU want to hear in a certain order, plan to play around with this a lot.

RECORDING BUTTON
This has some storage on it, so you can record with the little red recording button. That can come in handy if you need it, but I don't use it much. It works.

SPEAKER
This has its own little speaker on it which is handy for using the auto alarm function if you are camping or something and don't want to use your phone for that.

AUTO ALARM FUNCTION
This will wake you up if you want it to.

FM RADIO
This works pretty good, but again, the jack is toast, which is part of the antenna grounding the signal, so in my case, it is good but not WOW.

INSTRUCTIONS
This really is frustrating. This should have extensive instructions in it. This thing is really frustrating despite it being almost user friendly in some ways. In others it is downright frustrating.

BATTERY LIFE
The battery life on this is great. If not in use for a long period, it will keep the charge nicely, a feature I appreciate.

TOUCHY TOUCH SCREEN
This bottom half with the touch screen is very touchy. If I have it in my pocket and it hits my body just right, it will change to another song. Sometimes it will go to another direction if I put my hand in my pocket which is frustrating. That part is also difficult.

BLUETOOTH
This is a great feature. I had no problems hooking this up to my bluetooth headphones at all. It was easy and stayed connected, but I am at home when I use this and not around other wireless items, so I am not sure how well this would work when around other devices.

WHO MIGHT LIKE THIS?
If you are in need of some music and don't want your phone handy and feel like it does not matter what songs you hear in what order, then this might be a good mindless device for running, or working around cleaning, etc. It also might be nice for a young person who is not supposed to be using their phone and you want to give them something else to play music with.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For the price, the music quality is fantastic, the bluetooth connection is also very easy and one of the best I have used. As for other things like the music order, lack of instructions, and super touchy controls, this takes the fun out of using it.

MY RATING
I am between 3 and 4 stars for this. I am going with FOUR STARS. It is BARELY four stars though. The bluetooth and music quality are excellent. The screen is also decent too. The price is right. However, the other frustrations and lack of instructions frustrate me a bit. I am sure there are ways to put the music on there, but I just don't have the time to mess with it. Kids would probably have a lot of fun messing with this and making it do all sorts of amazing things.

For me, it is good when I need a quick set of music to drag along with me (I refuse to wear my phone out by overuse for music), so I put up with it.

Our daughter works at night often and has been wanting to have some devices to help in case of a problem with unwanted approach of animals or people. This seemed like a perfect solution. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is about the size of small cell phone. It is a bright pink color so easy to find. It comes with a holster

WHAT IS THE HOLSTER LIKE?
The holster clips onto pants waistband or belt with a heavy metal clip. It does not have a slot to feed it onto a belt, however. It is a black holster and has a velcro closure. The pink will still show when this is in the holster.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
There is an on/off button. This turned on still needs for you to press and hold a button to make it work. If you leave the button on, then there is a possibility of accidental noise if you hit the other button just right. If you leave it off, you will have to push the button to the on side then press the other button. Not hard to do, as the buttons are close together.

WHAT DOES IT SOUND LIKE?
This sounds like a VERY LOUD taser gun. It is NOT a taser, but it sounds like one. At the same time the sound goes off, a light flashes. It does hurt the ears, and it does scare off animals or people at first.

RECHARGABLE?
This took a couple of hours to charge and it was ready. Since our daughter has not used it regularly as she does not like to throw the general population into cardiac arrest, it is hard to tell how much use you get out of it prior to needing it recharged. I can say it has not needed to be recharged after several months of being charged but barely used.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a handy device for either animals while hiking, or if you happen to need to work at night and want some protection to scare off attackers. It is only noise, however, so you need to think fast in addition to using it.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. It is handy to have and seems to work well every time our daughter has had to use it which has only been a couple of times (wild dogs).

Our family goes through headphones like no one's business. I got these for my daughter who is kind of rough on headphones. LEt's take a look.

BUTTONS

FOLDING
These will fold up for easier storage. Be aware that they click rather loudly. At first my daughter thought she broke them and was panicked, but we realized that is a feature of the heaphones.

The sound is pretty muffled on these headphones. It is not as clear as the Oye model from Santana.

BATTERY LIFE

When you first power on, it will go to card mode if you have the card in it. I was looking for some replacement headphones for two sets in my family when I had the opportunity to try out some of the new Carlos Santana line of headphones. Let's see what happened.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These headphones come in a great box which will appeal to fans of Carlose. It is well decorated and presentation is done so well, it would make a great gift. These are the black ones, and there is also another set available in white under a different listing.

ARE THESE REAL LEATHER?
According to the case,t these are leather padded ear cups and the lower half of the headband. I am still not sure about this. It is possibly bonded leather. Bonded leather is made from leather scraps chopped up and blended with binders. Sheets made of this mixture are printed with leather look imprinting. Technically it can be called leather, but it really is not leather as I define it..

EAR CUSHIONS AND HEADBAND
These black headphones are comfortable. I can wear these headphones longer than many others I have used. My daughter who ended up with these, uses them constantly and raves about them. These can be worn for several hours without a problem. She has sweaty ears and these are not nearly as frustrating for her as many others.

CORD FOR CORDED LISTENING
This comes with a cord which is only 38 inches long. That is a bit short for me. I find it is annoying and not quite as long as I would prefer, but my daughter does not use it so I guess it is not a problem for her or if you are like her, you won't mind either.

HOW DO THESE SOUND?
We are all surprised at how really good these sound. The bass is well defined and clear/strong, and the mids and highs are definitely clear and not muddy. The bass is not overwhelming either, which is a problem with some headphones.

HEADPHONE CONTROLS
The controls can be a bit difficult to read, but once you know where they are, you can figure it out pretty quickly. The +/- and play/pause buttons are separated by the noise cancellation button which is good.

HOW ARE THESE ADJUSTABLE?
These adapt to all sorts of comfortable positions.. They go longer, tilt in and out and rotate from side to side.

ARE THESE ABLE TO FOLD TO BE COMPACT?
These do fold flat and compact if you need to travel with them or store them in a smaller storage area.

CASE?
This did not come with a case.

SOUND CANCELLATION PERFORMANCE
The noise cancellation is awful. It hardly works. When noise cancellation is turned on, the sound gets pretty compromised. It becomes almost muffled in a way and the base definitely goes down.

OTHER FEATURES WITH THESE HEADPHONES
The ability to know how much power is left on the headphones while using the phone is nice, but it does not help if you are using these some other bluetooth device and not a phone. During phone calls, people hear just fine and we can hear them too (several of us tried this feature with our phones)

THE BOTTOM LINE
At this price point, these headphones are a step up from what I usually get when getting headphones for this price range. The sound is well defined and well balanced. Compactness for storage is great, and the comfort is also very good. The only disappointments are noise cancellation, short cord for corded listening, and buttons being a bit difficult to read.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. With better performance from noise cancellation, these would be really really good. As they are, they are still pretty great. They are a great gift to yourself or someone else and are some of the nicer headphones I have used in my journey through headphones of all sorts as well as those the family has obtained. They are not B&O or Turtle Beach, but they still are pretty good.

Two members of the family just told me that they had broken their headphones with this product came up to get. I decided it was worth a try, despite some previous experiences not being too great with cheaper headphones. Let's see what happened.

WHAT ARE THESE LIKE?
These headphones make some claims. They come in a great box who for Carlos fans will be a thrill. It is well decorated and presentation is fabulous. That means they would be a nice gift in that respect.

LEATHER?

EAR CUPS AND HEADBAND
Having said that, these white headphones are comfortable. I can wear them longer than some others that I have had which are a bit rough after only an hour. These can be worn for several hours without a problem.

CORD

SOUND
The sound of these is surprisingly great. The bass is really good, and the mids and highs are definitely clear and not muddy.

CONTROLS
The controls on the white pair are awful in that they are nearly impossible to read. The buttons are white and the markings are just very thin raised white on the buttons. It should really be colored with marker- which I took care of. Using a very fine permanent marker I colored just the raised areas. The up/down and play pause buttons are separated by the noise cancellation button which is good.

ADJUSTABILITY
These are very adjustable. They go longer, tilt in and out and rotate from side to side.

COMPACT?
These do fold flat and compact if you need to travel with them or store them in a smaller place.

SOUND CANCELLATION
THAT is where we part ways with these headphones. The noise cancellation is awful. It barely works. When it is turned on, the sound gets really compromised too. It becomes almost muffled in a way.

OTHER FEATURES
The ability to know how much power is left on the headphones while using the phone is nice, but it does not help if you are not using it with a phone and some other bluetooth device. Calling, people hear just fine and we can hear them too (several of us tried this feature with our phones)

THE BOTTOM LINE
For the price, these headphones are a step up from what I usually get when I try them. Our family is a bunch of speaker and ear phone fanatics. Everyone has different likes and I tend to like a well balanced music. Muffled really bugs me.

I wanted to have a nice balanced speaker that no one will take so I decided to get this one for ME. It has a nice solid housing and I figured it was worth getting since my favorite speaker seems to get misplaced a lot. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a very solid speaker. It is heavy duty and it has metal housing. The sides are not as fragile as others I have used which sound this good. It comes in a beautiful gift box which has cushioning and the typical Santana design to it. The speaker itself is pretty heavy so it is not something you toss in your backpack and run off with. It needs a bit more care than that.

CHARGING
This has a USB charger that will take about 4 hours to charge it up with. There is also a connection where you can get a FAST charger from the company, but you have to contact them for it. The charging cable comes with it just need a USB outlet. The directions warn to only use the original cable that comes with this to charge or there might be damage to the speaker. The voltage must be 5V with current rated at 115A.

CAN THIS RUN WHILE CHARGING?
I do not see in the instructions warnings against this, and it does work while plugged in.

PLAY TIME
This speaker runs out of juice pretty quickly. If you want it to last the entire time of 10 hours, I highly suggest you not put the volume up past 30%. Any higher and the battery time runs down pretty quickly. At 60% you are at the edge of running this down pretty quickly- as in 4 or 5 hours play time only.

PAIRING
I have had no issues pairing this with tablets or phones using Android. Just like when you turn the power on, it says PAIRING in a very loud voice so you will know when it is in pairing mode.

VOLUME
The volume button on this is tricky. If you are not thinking and just quickly press the volume once, instead of it getting slightly louder, you will skip a track. You have to press the volume down and not let up if you want the sound to go up or down depending on the button you press meaning +/-.

CARD SLOT
This speaker can also work off of a TF card (also known as a microSD card). You just have to change from bluetooth mode to card mode using the MODE button.

IS THERE AUX CAPABILITY?
I have an old MP3 player that has higher quality recordings than anything new I have. That only uses AUX and it works great with this.

PAUSE / PLAY
You can pause or play music with this using the MFB button

HOW DOES THIS PERFORM?
Let me tell you, this thing ROCKS. I mean it. This speaker is fabulous. Not only does it work great out of the box (after being fully charged) but it sounds better and better as you break it in. It fills the house with music that is great quality and does not have interference or any lag issues either.

WHAT ABOUT BASS, MIDS AND HIGHS?
I have to say that this speaker is one of the few that I have used which does a beautiful job of intense bass, balanced clear highs but the mids are not muffled at all. It is impressive and what I thought a speaker always should be.

CAN YOU USE TWO TOGETHER?
This allows you to add one other speaker to the system so you can have them in two places. I do not have another Europa speaker at the moment I can test that with.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Although this blows any other wireless speaker I have had out of the water, it does blow through power rather quickly unless the volume is pretty low. It is not only amazing out of the box (After charging) but it gets better with more use. This baby ROCKS.

MY RATING
Finding a speaker which does not overwhelm you with out of whack bass, piercing highs, or muffled middles is not always easy. This speaker seems to divide it all out very well. It is one of the nicest speakers I have used (wireless) to date. FIVE STARS!

Not only do I love this, but would definitely consider a second one along with the fast charger in the future to round out the whole system.

ANOTHER THING
This product has a notification on it that some of the proceeds from this product will go to help underprivileged children through the MILAGRO foundation (miracle) that Carlos Santana and his family started in 1998.

I have had a need for an additional storage solution for my laptop which will enable me to back up files, and transfer between desktop (my workstation) and my laptop when necessary. My goal is to have it as an alternative mini hard drive, so to speak. Let's take a Look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a tiny Jumpdrive, for those who have never used one, it is similar in appearance to a dongle that you use for wireless keyboard or mouse in the USB port. It does not have a case and the packaging is rather difficult to open.

WHAT IS THIS FOR?
This is designed not to carry with you all of the time like some of the flash drives, but to use almost as a mini hard drive and keep it in your laptop or even desktop if desired. It will keep your files handy, has a pretty fast transfer rate, and has a decent amount of storage, depending on what kind of files you plan to store on it.

WHAT ELSE CAN YOU USE THESE FOR?
This can also be theoretically used to keep in the car as a way to play music on your sound system via USB port. I have not been able to do that yet as I have had some issues setting up the right format. I am not sure how security will interact with that..

DOES THIS HAVE SECURITY ON IT?
This drive has a program called ENCDataVault Lite. That will allow you to encrypt your files and have them accessed with a password you set up in case you lose your drive at least your files will be somewhat protected unless it is a hacker who finds it.

HOW IS TRANSFER RATE?
I have used this in a USB3.0 as well as USB2.0 port and both worked well.

DOES THIS FIT TYPE C CONNECTION?
You can not use this in a type C port so please check your laptop or desktop prior to purchase to be sure you have an actual USB port to use this in that is not already being used.

WHAT I DON'T LIKE ABOUT THIS
This drive should come with a tiny case on a keychain or with at least a loop handle on it so that you can put it somewhere safe and not lose it. It does not come with that. Something this small needs to have a colorful case to make it harder to lose. I know that the idea is to have it stay in the unit you use it on mostly, but sometimes you have to take it out and it needs a case.

THE BOTTOM LINE
This is a tiny drive. It is meant to use in either a car sound system (USB port), on a laptop or desktop that you plan to use it on regularly, and not be moved around constantly. It does not come with any kind of case at all to store it in when not in a port. It does have encryption which is a big plus to theoretically protect files in case of loss.

MY RATING
FOUR STARS. The performance is top notch. The fact that this does not come with a case is worth removing a star. Ideally it would not be a problem most of the time, but I still think that it needs protective COLORFUl case for those times you need to remove it from a port and take it from one place to another.

When I wanted to get this suitcase, my family thought I was nuts. We all are doing some traveling from one time to another, and my kids are planning to do some serious traveling sometime in the future. This is perfect. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is a fabulous suitcase. You can see from all of the photos, and the video what this is like, so I won't go into great detail describing what you already can see from the photos and video. I will give a rundown of what I am most impressed with about this.

STRAP ON THE BACK
I know this is going to sound silly, but one of my biggest concerns was if I wanted to put this on my back and suddenly decided I had to carry it like luggage, would the straps trip me from the backpack? Well, much to my surprise, the one thing I did not see mentioned was that there is a strap on the back of the case which hooks into place. If you want to keep the backpack straps out of the way, you unhook the strap and rehook it over the backpack straps. It works GREAT.

When it is time to backpack it again, it is easy to restore it to that mode.

BACK PADDING
Not only was the back strap a pleasant surprise, but the padding on the back was too. There is padding on the back where the shoulder blades hit the bag and there is padding over the secret zipper pocket that would rest near the lower back when you wear this too. Both carry handles are padded nicely as well as the backpack straps too.

TSA FRIENDLY OPENING
That is a wonderful feature too. It is nice to be able to zip open the bag without all of my stuff coming out to check for electronics, etc.

NETTED POUCH ON THE SIDE
I also love the little feature that has the netted pouch on the side for a can of drink or bottle of water that can be used, but when you are NOT using it, it zips shut tight to the case. Beautifully creative.

BACK PANEL
I also love the back panel where you zip it open (this is the top part that faces out if you wear it backpack style). It has great places for pencils, papers, small stuff you might want to store but it is easy to access without going through the entire suitcase full of packed stuff.

DOES IT HOLD A LOT OF STUFF?
I am also very amazed at how much stuff I can pack in this for clothing and use on a weekend, and if planned well, an entire week. This really DOES hold a lot of stuff, and if you practice the ROLLING form of packing where you roll your clothes like a sleeping bag idea, you can definitely fit in all you would need for a weekend or week, except if it was winter where you will be, then it will be probably too small. You will need additional packing room most likely unless you have very thin warm clothing you can wear repeatedly.

DOES IT FIT UNDER A PLANE SEAT?
I have not taken this on a flight yet. I hope to remember to update in the future if one of us ends up doing that to let you know about the seat thing.

THE BOTTOM LINE
All in all the features described in the listing, in other reviews and some of the highlights I am especially impressed with all make this one of my favorite pieces of luggage we have. It enables me to get rid of a piece of small luggage which really has not been that convenient and substitute this instead. I really love this thing.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is brilliantly designed, is completely handy to have, and adapts to any sort of travel or transport you might need to do with it from backpack to sliding on with larger luggage on a carrier handle. I really do love this and despite the price, I really do think it is worth it.

i have avoided using mice for years now because I could not hold my hand in the position required for working a mouse. It really bothered my wrists. I saw this one and grabbed it hoping perhaps I could use this one. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS MOUSE LIKE?
Like in the photo, this mouse is upright. It has the ability to go forward and backward using the thumb and two buttons. It has the usual buttons where the finger tips rest. In between the fingertip buttons (right and left mouse buttons) there is a scroll bar.

RECHARGEABLE
This is rechargeable. It comes with a USB to mini USB port cord for charging. Once charged, I get many hours of use before it has to be charged again. It does not run down really fast.

DONGLE
This has a dongle which stores in the mouse. THAT is handy. It plugs into the USB port of whatever computer I want to use it with- desktop or laptop- and it works well on just about any surface within reason.

IS IT COMFORTABLE?
I have been so long without using a mouse, it feels weird to be able to use one without issues. I can use this for a while without discomfort, although i am so used to a touch pad, it is still an adjustment. It is WAY more comfortable than using a traditional mouse, however.

GAMING?
I do not play action games with this mouse. It is mostly for either working, or adventure style gaming. For those things it has worked fine for me. Action gaming might be another story.

DOES IT TRACK WELL?
For me it has tracked well so far. The scroll wheel works pretty well and the response of the mouse is good.

FIVE STARS so far. I will update if anything changes. It is hard to get a mouse to discharge fast, but if it starts to give me issues, I hope to remember to update this review.

With everything becoming smaller, more streamlined, and less footprint to its size, there is a two edged sword. Let's take a look.

This is a pretty straightforward drive. It plugs into the USB port, has fabulous transfer time and I have had no issues with errors. It is quite small, very slick metal, and no color or markings on it other than very tiny etched writing on it.

IS THIS BACKWARD COMPATIBLE?
Yes, this has worked in all of my USB ports from very old to very new - all speeds.

DOES IT READ ON VARIOUS DEVICES
I have had no issues moving this between desktop to laptops.

DOES THIS WORK WITH WINDOWS 7?
I have had no issues with Windows 7 and this drive.

The one issue I have with this drive is that there is no case at all for it. That means that it is very easy to lose. It does have a hole where you can attach a lanyard to it or some kind of ribbon. Despite the current trend to listen to all radio via internet, people who live in rural areas know the value of having radios that pick up stations and emergency lighting in times of power outages, and even internet outages which are not as uncommon as you might think. Let's take a look at this radio.

WHAT IS IT LIKE?
First of all this radio is quite small. That means it is easy to store and put in small places to listen to. It has the ability to listen to AM/FM/NOAA stations so if you need to know what is going on during times of outages, you can. There are various methods of charging this. The radio has a nice feel to it- it is not rubbery, nor is it slick. Somewhere in between is what I would say with this, which means it is easy to hold on to.

AAA BATTERIES
This can take 3 AAA batteries which is great if you have them on hand. Remember to take them out when you don't plan to use the radio over a period of time in case they explode.

HAND CRANK (AND WEIRD INSTRUCTIONS)
This enables you to turn the crank for 1 minute for 10-15 minute increments of radio listening or 20 minutes of light if you are using the light. The instructions have a rather hilarious recommendation that if you turn the crank at 130-150 MPH it will be charged in 4 hours. I don't know about you, but I don't know anyone with a bionic arm that could even turn the crank that fast, or bicycle, or .. Well you get it.

SOLAR
If you put this in direct sunlight, you can get a charge as well. I have left this on the window and it works some, but I did this with another item that has a similar plastic finish, and the sun disintegrated the finish leaving it sticky. This radio has a similar rubbery plastic finish, so I don't tend to leave it in the light more than when I am using it.

DOES THIS CHARGE THE BATTERY WELL BY HAND OR SOLAR?
Well, it does charge the battery, but the times vary as to how much listening time I get from it. It can go from the said 15 minutes to a half hour at times for one minute of hand cranking.

SOUND
The AM sound is like an old radio from back in the day called transistors. It is not a full round sound, but it is not that bad to listen to. FM is a bit nicer, but again, this is not for luxury listening, it is for occasional use when other radios etc are not practical or possible to use. WARNING- if you happen to use a TV remote or other devices near this, it will interfere with the sound a bit. It is no big deal though.

READING LIGHT
This has a really cool reading light on it if you wanted to use it in power outages. It pulls out and bends over so you can see.

FLASHLIGHT
This flashlight is very bright and will enable some nice usage during power outages.

CHARGING PORT
You can even use this with a USB charging unit to charge it up instead of batteries or cranking, etc. It takes over 4 hours to full charge the battery. You can also use this to charge up a cell phone, but only for emergencies, not as a power bank.

QUALITY
This radio is of decent quality but again, it is not luxurious listening or using- it is for those times when you don't have other options. The reading light is great if you have to read the phone instructions for reporting outages, or other things when the power goes out. It is VERY handy to have both a reading and flashlight handy.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Despite this being okay quality of listening, there are SO many options with this radio that I am really liking having it handy. We have used it quite a bit and it has worked so far. I really love the options and that it seems to run dependably so far. I love that it has USB options to charge it with too. The size makes it perfect to keep on hand. It does not take up much room but has decent sound.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. I love this. The size is perfect and versatility is fantastic.

Boy, talk about a frustration. I got a foreign language course and then realized that that microphone integrated with my headphones would not work with my computer no matter what I did. I had to try to find a mic. Let's see what happened.

I got this set of headphones to go with our panasonic phone system in your house for our landline. Many times we get power failures so we still keep a landline. So far the voice works well with these when I use them on the phone.

I have gotten so many pair of earbuds that have disappeared in the house, that I finally decided to get a pair I could use for me. I got these and was very excited to test them out. The problem is, they were stolen, like A BAZILLION TIMES.

These come in a great box that is perfect for gift giving.

I got this for my daughter who is involved in a business situation where a camera, laptop, and tripod (plus accessories) are required for product photos, posting, and keeping track of inventory. She is always misplacing things. I wanted this to be in one place for her. Let's take a look.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This is true to the photos with the listing. The case is padded, has a velcro flap on it which has a zipper in the front flap for flat things like our flat flash which we keep in a padded box, or cords, etc. The case itself has plenty of padding in it and non-abrasive soft fabrics.

CAMERA CASE
The camera storage has two adjustable velcro type walls in it so that you can make it bigger or smaller. The other two compartments are for storing lenses etc, and one of them has a flap, but the flap is not something you can fasten down. The camera that goes in here is a Fuji Finepix S1. The front lens sticks out quite a bit but it is stored on its back and is plenty protected by all of the padding.

ZIPPER ACCESS
There is a top zipper access so that if you have the flap down but need a quick access, you can quickly zip open the top and remove the camera.

LAPTOP POCKET
We have a laptop that I was sure would fit in there, but it is just about a 1/4 inch too long for the pocket. I thought it was a 14 inch, but it turned out to be 15 inch instead. A 14 inch laptop or tablet will fit in here perfectly. A 15 will not.

STRAPS
The straps on the bottom are adjustable to hold a tripod which is great to help keep all of this in order. When I want to make it easier to store, I remove the tripod and stand it next to this bag until it is time to use again.

SIDE MESH POCKET
This has a side pocket appropriate for a water bottle or can of coconut water, etc.

HANDLES
There is a single carry handle and a shoulder strap. The carry handle makes this a bit awkward, so we tend to use the shoulder strap except when we need to move the bag quickly.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Even though I wish this were slightly bigger to fit the laptop, it is my error, not the bag company, so I have to say other than that, this bag is well designed and does the job. It is a great way to keep all of the camera gear handy for the jewelry business it is needed for.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. It is not fair to remove a star for the misunderstood measurement, but this is not as handy for my needs as I had hoped. I am leaving this at five stars, because it is still handy to keep everything together for taking photos for the business it is intended for.

WARNING- this is an IN DEPTH REVIEW for those who are serious about making a purchase of this laptop. All sections are marked for easier reference to find out information you might be looking for.

If you prefer a simple summary, see section marked THE BOTTOM LINE
----------------------------------------------------------------------
For one of the top new computers out there, this laptop is amazing and frustrating at the same time. Is it worth getting? YES. Are there warnings to be had? YES. This started out as a nightmare, but Dell stepped up to the plate.. Let’s take a closer look.

WHAT IS THIS LAPTOP LIKE?
SCREEN
The screen is large, easy to see, with clean colors and no pixel problems. This screen rivals the IPS screen in appearance. Gaming vid appears smooth. All games have performed well with no lag or problem on the screen.

HARD DRIVE
Start up is very short, and performance is FAST. This loads really quickly and performs well so far.

TOUCHPAD
The touchpad is responsive. The left and right mouse button are built into the bottom of the mousepad instead of individual buttons. It’s not our favorite set up, but it isn’t bad. When playing a game that uses keyboard, we have to turn off the touchpad because it is bigger than many other touchpads in laptops.

KEYBOARD
Not only is the keyboard FUN with the light show it has(as well as being RGB enabled), but the keys are quiet and the touch is good. It is a full keyboard-there have not been any complaints about it. It is easy to type on without fingers slipping off easily. Although this is used primarily for gaming and video editing, it performs fine for typing too.

ALIEN CONTROL CENTER
Using the alien control center, you can independently change all of the key values and colors. You can change the backlighting of the back edge of the spine of the laptop. You can change the color of the alien logo on the cover too which stays lit when in use.

You can also set individual profiles for each game in the Alien Control center including changing color of keys of you have an alien mouse, it will integrate into that setting as well so you can change the mouse and macro for each game. You can also in the profiles add overclocking to specific games. You can launch the games from the command center, or if you don’t, it will still activate the profile.

The only complaint about the control center-needs a simpler layout to change the button configuration on the Alienware mouse. You are supposed to be able to change the coloring of the Alien power button, but that does not work.

OVERCLOCKING AND FAN CONTROLS
The overclocking does work, but it has a tendency to run the CPU extremely hot. Also you can get settings in the command center for fan speed as well as overclocking. By default, they put you on quiet mode. The GPU and CPU have a tendency to run very hot and it has to manually be set to a different setting. We prefer the COOL setting. Anything less than that, it is not enough to keep components cool during overclocking or ANY operation.

ALIEN FUSION
You also have quick settings for power & battery to set them. You can also make adjustments to sound and playback. There is bass boost, treble enhancer, voice clarity, smart loudness, and also reverb. This is particularly handy for games. You can also turn on or off Alienware virtual surround sound.

ALIEN VIRTUAL SURROUND SOUND
The virtual surround sound works very well. Without headphones in, using just the speakers, it is easy to forget that you do not have the headphones on. It is very realistic sounding.

It also has audio profiles to choose from modes like movie, game, music etc.

GPUs AND CPU AND PERFORMANCE
The GPU is a Nvidia GeForce RTX 2070 Max-Q Design. The 2nd one is the Intel UHD Graphics 630. The CPU is an Intel Core i7-9750H@2.60GHz with turbo of 4.6. The GPU has DDR-6GB. Every game we have thrown at it runs smooth without any hitches at all having to do with the GPU, even tested with overclocking and it still worked great.

The CPU handles everything thrown at it, but the number 1 complaint is that while the GPU stays reasonably cool around 70C-80C, the CPU runs very HOT. It is between 90-100C. This is due to the fact that the 9th gen intel chip has a much wider turbo spread than previous generations. This causes it to heat up more than any other chip I have used to date for the i7.

With using a cooling board under the laptop it does help reduce the heat from 3-6degrees C.

CHARGING, BATTERY AND WARNING
This comes with a 180W charging brick. It charges fine, and in normal desktop operation, it runs off of the charger fine. As soon as you enter into anything graphics intensive, it starts not only drawing from the brick, but it also takes power from the battery. It does not matter how old of a game it is, it still draws from the battery, while plugged in.

This computer can not be used on battery alone when playing ANY kind of graphic oriented game. It MUST be used while being attached to charging cable. There is an upgrade option for a 240w brick, which we will try in the future to see if this resolves the situation.

WARNING
I would like to add that this is just under NORMAL operation without ANY devices attached by USB or anything wireless. Adding devices makes it drain even worse, again this is all while plugged in.

BRICK GETS HOT
When running a game on this laptop, one thing that is a bit off putting is that the brick will get very HOT. It would seem that a higher watt brick would be a better choice for this laptop, which is why we are looking into upgrading in the future to see if that will help.

SHUT OFFS
I have not had it shut off on us while gaming yet, but it does require to be charged once you are done gaming because if you intend to use this while gaming, you will need the battery charged AND keep it plugged in. You can not let the battery go dead with this and run it off of plug only.

PORTS
This has a headphone/mic combo jack that works fine. The ethernet jack unlike the problems that others have complained about being stuck gave us no trouble. We just are sure to press completely to remove it. The 3 USB 3.1 jacks has one with a power designation. There is a lightning port on the spine/back edge of the laptop. It works well as it is supposed to.

There is also an HDMI and mini display port on the back. They have worked well.

GAMES TESTED
Two Worlds 2 (CPU heavy game)
Kingdom Come Deliverance (GPU heavy game)
Arma 3 (Balanced draw on both)
Tom Clancy Rainbow Six Seige (CPU and GPU heavy game)
Pixel Junk Monsters (Light Game)
Age of Empires 3 (Light Game)
Various other lighter games..

All games work well. We have heavier hitting games we want to test in the future, such as Metal Gear Solid 5 but we have not had the chance. We will update if anything changes.

TOBII EXPERIENCE
This is where the experience gets frustrating. We started this whole laptop experience with such a horrible frustration that it has left us with a few loose ends that still are not working well. We have used this with Kingdom Come Deliverance which is TOBII enabled. You are supposed to be able to use the TOBII with the camera to be able to navigate and click on things, but for some reason it just won’t work. Due to the horrible beginning with this computer, it seems that this feature still has not worked right since it was wiped clean once already.

OUR NIGHTMARE LAPTOP EXPERIENCE
Now we are going to enter into a place no one wants to go when they get a new laptop. The DYSFUNCTIONAL LAPTOP. Let’s see how DELL handled what we went through.

THE FIRST DAY
I opened our computer I was all excited to get this up and running. I have done a lot of computer building over the years and tend to be pretty good at putting systems together and trouble shooting. I figured it would be an easy experience. BOY was I WRONG. When I opened the laptop, I entered all of the information to get it started up and it was fine until it suddenly started to update itself (without my permission) and then it went nuts.

PANIC!
The computer rebooted itself and then began to re-write the BIOS. I could not intervene and about an hour later, instead of powering down, the laptop was getting hotter and hotter and the system was dark. I was unable to get it to turn off. I unplugged it and tried pressing the power button until my finger was numb. NOTHING would turn this thing off.

We were approaching the hour and a half mark and I called for the technical support line’s help. This was NUTS. I waited and waited, and then suddenly while my finger had become one with the button, the tech support rep got on the phone and BAM it worked.
IS THAT FIRE I SMELL?
I thought all was well. Then the trouble started. The charging cable was not lighting up. There is a light on it. Perhaps it was dead, right? Nope. When trying to start the laptop up with another one of us, it suddenly made a weird noise, and smelled like it was BURNING. It was dead. I mean DEAD.

We called tech support about this and got the nicest person who was very patient, knowledgeable and helpful. Not only did we get an immediate return label, but a box was shipped out to us FAST for us to retun it to Dell.

We had our laptop back within a week and it had been wiped clean. The motherboard had a short in it and the charging cable was fried. They had to wipe out the laptop harddrive to get it to start again so as a result some of the programs which worked well at first for the few hours we had the laptop working have been messed up since.

DOES IT WORK NOW?
This laptop works now very well. It has been running fine. The wiping of the hard drive has led us to some software problems that did not get synced right when trying to replace them again and it is frustrating like the TOBII.

THE BOTTOM LINE
Our beginning experience with this laptop was awful. The nightmare was made better as Dell treated us with respect, importance and took care of us right away. They repaired the system and although some software does not work right yet, the hardware is doing all right and that is a relief. This laptop is a great performer despite some cautions. It is a great gaming system and high performance for graphics too.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS although I will say that with caution. Our initial experience was frustrating and took some serious time to get fixed, but Dell was excellent and treated us very well. We have a system that works except for the software which we have not been able to straighten out yet. I hope we can get it fixed soon and running as it should.

SUGGESTION
DON'T UPDATE THE BIOS UNLESS YOU ARE SURE THERE IS NO PROBLEM WITH IT. Do your research first if the laptop does not do it for you first, of course!

PHOTOS
The first three photos are the 3 benchmark stats for the games, the other 3 are in game screen shots with stats.

I have been wanting a new MP3 player for a while now. I refuse to waste my phone with cluttered songs and use. I have watched everyone else I know blow through phones from constant use. I wanted to have a dedicated MP3 player. Let's see how this worked out.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This comes in a nice box- great for gift giving. It has a cord with it for charging and attaching to computer if you want to download songs to it. This does NOT have any internal memory, however. All songs have to be stored on a microSD card. There is port for headphones, mini USB, and line out port.

HOW TO OPERATE
ON/OFF
The power button is on the top of the unit. It has to be held in for a moment before it kicks in. There is an issue with the power button being on the top pressed down easily. The design of this has a raised edge of the case so that it is harder to press on the power button accidentally.

MENU
The menu button is easy to operate. It takes you around the menus using the forward and backward arrow buttons.

VOLUME
The volume buttons are on the outside edge on the right as you look at the case. The + and - buttons are separate.

BACK BUTTON
This takes you back through the menu and you can replay songs too.

PLAY PAUSE
Is on the front of the case and it is easy to access and see.

SCREEN
This is not a full color screen. It is simple and easy to read, however, without graphic clutter.

BLUETOOTH?
I had a heck of a time with this at first. I was not having it work well with my bluetooth headphones and it frustrated me to no end. I was about ready to give this an awful review when I suddenly realized- it was not the player, it was both sets of headphones that were not working correctly! Once I got the headphones working, the sound is BEAUTIFUL on this.

I have also used this with a few bluetooth speakers with great results. I like the solid feeling of the body- it stays put but does not take up too much room.

SOUND

READ OUT

STORAGE
Remember, this stores all of the songs on the microSD card. There is not any internal storage in this otherwise.

Once I got the problems worked out, I have to say I really like this. It is not as intuitive as some items, but it is really nice to have and I love to play it. I like shuffler or single CD artist choices, etc.

This is a really nice MP3 player. It is a bit more rustic than some might be used to with smart phones, but it really works nicely and the sound is great.

FIVE STARS. It does what it says, although I would prefer it to have some internal storage as well as microSD, but that is just me. For what this is- it is very nice. I like it and am pleased with the performance.

It is important to have graphics tablets in our house. We have several people in the house who work with graphics so this is a helpful item to have a few of. Let's take a look at this pad.

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This tablet is a nice red color. It comes with a red cord that plugs into the computer USB port. It has a propretary end on it that goes into the tablet, so you don't want to lose it. It has a pen with multiple nibs that it comes with. There is not a stand with the pen. There is an adequate very simple instruction manual included.

There are four press button spots on the top of the tablet. One is zoom in and zoom out, and the others are programmable.

PEN PRESSURE
This has a pressure sensitivity to it, so if you are using a painting program that is set up for pressure, it will work with this pen. It says 8000 levels, which is plenty for most projects.

BATTERIES?
There are not any batteries in this pen. It works off of the power in the tablet.

WEIGHT AND FEEL
The weight of it is nice- not too lightweight- feels hefty but not too much.

SIZE
This is excellent for travel. The cost is not too much so if it gets lost or broken, you can easily replace it.

EDITED
Well, sure enough as soon as I posted this review, I made a discovery. The touchpad was driving me crazy but I found a work around. By using two fingers instead of the other settings, I have made peace with my touchpad. I am revising this rating to FIVE STARS because honestly, I love this little Chromebook. The touchpad was my only big frustration with it. Now that I have the work around with two finger scrolling and moving around, I am much happier. It is not what I am used to but it works great now. I just wanted to let you all know BEFORE reading my original review.
----------------------------
HERE IS THE ORIGINAL REVIEW
------------------------
I have always wanted to have a Chromebook. I have laptops, tablets, a screaming desktop for my high powered applications, but sometimes I just want a small laptop touchscreen hybrid just to surf the net now and then without all of the other bells and whistles. Let's take a look..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
I am going to review this in sections.

SIZE
The size of this is fantastic. I LOVE it. It is sleek, easy to use, and handy.

WEIGHT
This is the perfect weight for what it is. I find it to be just right for what I want.

KEYBOARD
This is a bit hard to see during the day in certain light, but I find that I am a touch typist for the most part, so as long as my hands are in the correct places, I am not too overwhelmed with it. The click and pressure of the keys is surprisingly good with this. I have an easier time typing with this than I do with my laptop which is larger. I typiecally work best on a split keyboard (ergonomic) so the fact that I can type on this so easily surprises me- well SHOCK actually.

TOUCHSCREEN
This is the part that I expected to be frustrated with, but it works BEAUTIFULLY. I have had no problems with it. In fact, if it were not for the touchscreen, this little Chromebook would probably have been thrown right out the window - probably without opening the window first. That leads me to my next section..

TOUCHPAD
OMG. If there was ever a touch pad that would drive a person to insanity, this is it. The touchpad itself is all sealed with the two mouse buttons encased under the covering. That means there is not a separate button, but you have to press on the lower corners of the touchpad to get then to work. That is not the problem.

The touchpad can be set and reset, but OMG, it is so annoying that I have literally almost thrown the thing across the room on several occasions until I remembered it had touchscreen so I could override my choices by pressing right on the screen,, even though the keyboard was still engaged. If it were not for THAT feature, forget it.

The side scroll bars are my biggest annoyance. If you try to get them to surface, then press on them, it takes so long that when you finally get it to engage, you think it will work. It doesn't. The pointer will not seem to engage with the scrolling button and it takes forever. Touching it onscreen works better.

CHARGING
This takes a few hours to charge.

BATTERY LIFE
I get about 4 or 5 hours out of this depending on what I am doing.

POWER BUTTON
You can simply shut the Chromebook to turn it off in pause mode, or you can physically press the power button to turn it OFF. The thing is, however, when you open the book, it turns itself right on with no power button necessary. I rather like that feature.

USB AND JACK
The USB and Jack ports work great. No problems there.

RECHARGE CORD
The cord is plenty long enough and the transformer at the end of the cord is a slim one with a non-polarized plug so you can turn it either way in an outlet.

VOLUME
The volume buttons are wonderful- right on keyboard and easy to use. Volume is decent and no vibrating until it is way too loud anyway.

SCREEN QUALITY
Other than being in love with the touchscreen, I love the quality of the screen images too. The colors are good, and the clarity is nice as well. Is it as nice as the high level Samsung tablet? Not quite, but it is a decent runner up to it.

EASE OF USE
I find that the set up of this Chromebook is really nice. I have had no problems with lag and the set up is intuitive for those who are not great at finding and reading instructions. I have had no problems running basic apps on here, as well as using other browsers. I have not experimented with the Linux side of things at this point.

PURPOSE?
This makes a great notebook to bring to classes, coffee shops. for quick browsing of the web, and in my case to help manage online websites and a small business when I can not access my desktop or laptop and my tablet is not big enough for what I want to do. This is perfect for that.

THE BOTTOM LINE
I have to say that I REALLY love this thing Despite my fury at the ever frustrating touch pad, I love so much more about this Chromebook that I am willing to overlook the touch pad idiocy- well until it acts up again. I love the touchscreen overriding ability and that saves the whole thing for me. This is great to travel with me when I need basic access to internet packed in a perfect sized "laptop".

MY RATING
I want to give this five stars, but honestly, the touchpad is so ridiculous that I had to knock a star off for that. The touchscreen overrides it easily without having to flip the keyboard back and I have to say that placates me every time I get frustrated. This is a great little unit to have and I really like how fast it loads and performs. It is way nicer than I expected and is perfect for what I want to use it for.

When I got this keyboard, I figured it would be a nice backup for my very old keyboard. I really prefer a split keyboard, so I figured that one of my kids would get this. Then I used it.and the fights started..

WHAT IS THIS LIKE?
This keyboard is really cool. It has a brushed metallic background with highly raised keys. The keys have a great spring and are well spaced. You can use it on one color or set various color settings when you are using it. It also comes with a mouse which has the same color capabilities.

HOW IS THE KEYBOARD TO USE?
This keyboard is really nice. It has an excellent spring to it. They keys to make a bit of noise, but not too much. The keys are easy to press and the excellent spring makes it pretty good to type on. If this was a split keyboard, it would be absolutely PERFECT.

GAMING
My kids play with this for gaming and they like it a lot. It has worked well and seems accurate, so all are happy on the gaming front.

MOUSE?
The mouse is surprisingly comfortable. I have used it several times when my regular mouse was acting up. I enjoyed it a lot. It seems to be accurate and works well. I did not find anything I did not like about it.

THE BOTTOM LINE

My family uses a lot of backpacks. We use them for travel, storage, camping, hiking, and transporting a lot of things wherever we need to go. Let's see how this one measures up..

CAPACITY
This has great pockets and storage. It expands a lot to hold many things. The inside back has padding to keep things from poking through to the back. The main compartment is large enough to hold a LOT of books or other things. It has a small zipper compartment to hold keys, change, cards, etc.

The front compartments are very nice and large. The first one is quite deep and will hold small notebooks, pads, and other smaller things- but it is fairly deep so it will hold a lot.

SIDES
The sides have elastic pockets on them which will hold bottled water or other things you might need to stick in there.

LOOPS
There is a band of loops which you can use to put things through or hook them to.

SIDE BANDS
There are bands on the side which are adjustable that you can use to pull in the backpack if it is not full so it does not stick out so far.

SHOULDER STRAPS
The shoulder straps are padded and comfortable.

WAIST STRAP
The waist strap has pockets on each side which are shaped like fanny packs. They zip shut and hold many things too.

ROLL STRAPS
At the top of the shoulder straps are two straps that are adjustable that you can use to put a bedroll or other similar object. We have also used it for a tripod for camera.

ZIPPER QUALITY

Having outdoor safe speakers is essential for my household. Not only do I have audiophiles who are addicted to headphones and speakers, I have a husband who insists on taking his speakers to outdoor jobs. that is fine except when the job turns out to have a sudden rainstorm or high dust going on. Before giving it to him, I had our daughter put it through the grind at work (food prep) and in town events. Let's see how this speaker performs..

WHAT IS THIS SPEAKER LIKE?
This speaker is gray in color. The housing is very rubbery in consistency. The right side of the speaker has sealed controls under a rubberized pad over top of the buttons. The speaker stays put and is heavier than expected.

ON/OFF BUTTON/PAIRING
Holding down for over a second powers up the speaker. Next to the power button is the PAIRING button. This is not for pairing the speaker to a device but it is for pairing with another speaker just like it. A coworker with my daughter has this speaker and they tested it out- works GREAT so you now get two synced speakers.

CALLS BUTTON
You can send and receive calls with this button. You can also access your voice commands on your phone with this button.

VOLUME BUTTON
This is plus or minus sound controls. You can also skip by holding down- + is forward, - is backward.

PAUSE/PLAY
You can control pausing and playing with this button.

DOCKING
USB for charging, mini USB port (to use to charge a device if need be), and auxiliary outlet for like an old MP3 player or other device that does not have Bluetooth capability.

CHARGING INDICATOR LIGHT
Red when charging and turns white when fully charged. Will indicate when the power is running low so you will know.

SOUND QUALITY
Sound quality with this is very good. My daughter has a coworker with the same speaker so they both have had a chance to experiment with their speakers. So far it has been a great speaker. The balance of the recording of course affects the speaker, but so far it has not been overly muffled, out of balance, etc. Where you put the speaker affects how it sounds too.

When put on the floor, it really does sound better than on, say top of a box, or couch, etc. A very hard surface seems to really make it sound best.

VOLUME
When using the volume controls on the speaker, the sound is better than when you use the volume controls on the device (tablet, phone, etc).

DURABILITY
This speaker was taken to a huge town chicken and biscuit dinner and was dropped and still is working perfectly.

BATTERY
Two 10 hour shifts at full volume, and this speaker kicked through it all before needing to be recharged.

THE BOTTOM LINE
For a really nice durable speaker that is dustproof, shock proof, and supposedly water proof, this is a good choice. It is solid, has decent sound , and even can be synced with another speaker if you get two of these for coverage around a room.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS. This is a decent speaker, and I feel more comfortable having my husband use this on his jobs than the other really nice speaker he was beating up.

There is always a run on headphones in our house. Not only are they being lost or dying, but everyone is on a constant quest for the best design and sound they can find in a bluetooth headphone. Let's see how these measure up.

WHAT ARE THESE HEADPHONES LIKE?
These headphones have a long sturdy neck band which means they will fit a variety of neck sizes. Each ear piece has a magnet on it so that when you are not using them, they will close in front of you so you won't lose them. The controls are at the end of the neck band on the right side.

ON/OFF BUTTON
Play, pause, on/off, pair can be done with this button.

VOLUME
The minus and plus of volume control is also used for skipping songs- + skip forward, - skip backward.

ANC
There is an ANC button on the right side directly behind the negative volume button which makes it easy to press them both at the same time. It does do noise canceling, but it is frustrating because it is easy to press the ANC button by mistake when also pressing the middle button.

CHARGING PORT
Charging port is on the edge of the control button area.

AI INDICATOR VOICE
The automatic voice is very dysfunctional. It only says part of words, and seems to be a bit mean sounding which makes my daughter say it feels creepy.

NOISE CANCELING
The noise canceling works beautifully on these headphones.

SOUND QUALITY
The sound quality is awesome. Highs and mids are where they should be. Bass is very good. It is not overdone but it is in balance and does not distract from the music. There are not any breakups in sound unless you walk away from the device.

BLUETOOTH RANGE
The bluetooth range seems to be good up to about 35 feet or so.

PHONE CALL QUALITY
The calls go through very well and people can hear just fine on phone calls.

BATTERY PERCENTAGE
There is no physical light indicator to tell you how much battery power you have left.
