These fit kind of near the top of the ears and it's amazing how something that doesn't cover or go in your ears can produce such clear sound and no one else can hear it unless they get very, very close.
My only complaint about these headphones is the battery life is not great. The sound and comfort are excellent. They just need to be charged a lot.

Basic headphones. Perfect for a classroom or computer lab. Works well for spoken audio like lectures, audiobooks or YouTube. Not a great range for listening to music or movies. At less that $6 a headphone, you do get what you pay for.
These headphones are very comfortable. The sound is good as is the noise cancelling. The bluetooth is very nice. The battery life is amazing. The earbuds being magnetic makes them easy to put away.
This laptop runs fast. It does everything I want it to. The touch screen is very responsive and accurate. The battery life is adequate.
The noise level for this fan isn't too bad. It installed easily for us. It runs well.

If you need headphones for kids, these are a great option. For the price they are good. The sound quality is slightly better than the speakers on an iPad. They fit comfortably and don't hurt or pinch ears.

I plugged this speaker/microphone in and it immediately worked. The sound coming out of it is very clear and much louder than what my laptop speakers give me.  The microphone also gives clear, loud sound according to people on the other end. It's easy to operate to increase/decrease the volume or to mute/unmute. It's very sturdy.

This fan puts out so incredibly much air. It's very impressive how much air it puts out given the size of the fan. The blades spin very smoothly. It operates quietly as lower speeds (which put out plenty of air). It gets noisy when it gets very fast (at that point you're talking blowing your hair straight back and needing to blink level of air movement).
You get a lot of airflow with this fan. It runs quietly. The price is great. All in all a great gadget.
This is easy to get going. The sound quality is very good.
This little computer works just fine. It's decently fast and runs quiet.

It's not a really powerful computer, but for watching videos and basic applications it works great. It is small and quiet. It's easy to hide behind a monitor so you don't even notice you have a desktop computer.
This power inverter is nice and small and quiet. It gives plenty of power and charges fast.
These headphones are comfortable to wear. The sound quality is very good, particularly for the price. They fit over the ears well. They are great for kids on remote learning.

These are really great headphones for the price. The sound quality is not as good as more expensive headphones, but of course you get what you pay for. The microphone works very well. They have been excellent for use in remote learning plugged into an iPad. These are especially good for children who might not be as gently on their headphones are older kids and adults.

Amazing multi channel capture card. When in a 2x2 grid it downscales 1080P to 540p in order to show all 4 inputs. Multi layout is great. Only one audio source can be active at a time and selected by the remote.
Quiet fan. Even when on the lowest speed it moves a lot of air. On high it is almost silent. Removable grill covers make is easy to use in or outside of an enclosure
Comfortable. Sounds great. good battery life. I can use one headphone at a time for listening to music or making calls. Only issue is no battery indicator either in iOS or the charging/storage case.

Works well for streaming to Zoom or Youtube. Easy to use on Windows 10, no drivers needed. Just looks like a webcam and audio input. Video and audio quality is great on the capture. The double USB-A cable is odd, but most competing products do the same thing. Just be sure not to lose the cable.

This writing tablet is great for sticking in the diaper bag to carry along and entertain the kids. My son will sit and practice writing his letters, numbers, and sight words for a long time using this thing. I love that it has the stylus attached. Otherwise there is no chance it wouldn't be lost within minutes. If you don't want to lose what is written on it (it's pretty easy to accidentally press the clear button), there is a lock option to keep it on the screen until you are ready to erase it. The color is very nice. The weight of the stylus is excellent. It makes it easy to write with it and no scratching sounds or anything like that.

My kids think it is great fun to have a movie night with their favorite movies projected huge on the wall. The light does not need to be super dark to still get a clear picture. The sound is excellent. For playing video games, it's not too bad. The lag is minimal.
This projector works well to project movies on a big wall. It needs to be pretty dark in the room to get a picture that is easy to see. The sound is good. We're happy with it.
The clarity of the images projected from this machine is excellent. You can have an awesome movie night right in your own home. It's easy to hook up. The sound is great. It's super easy to operate.
Easy to install. No drivers were needed to be installed on Rasbian or Windows 10. Sound quality was great. Better than the integrated DAC in the Raspberry Pi.

We are very happy with this TV. The picture quality is absolutely amazing. It is just so sharp and the colors are very realistic. Even the cartoons my kids watch look better on the screen. The sound quality is excellent. The remote does everything you could want it to. My only complaint about the remote is it's a little too sensitive. Occasionally the TV loses connectivity with wifi, but it's easy and very fast to reboot it.

Our first unit was DOA. We had a faint checkerboard pattern on the screen, but nothing else. We called tech support (on a Sunday evening) and they agreed it was DOA and started the process to replace it. They asked for some pictures and by the end of the week the new unit was on its way to us. We received it a few days later and have been totally pleased with it ever since!

This speaker and microphone is amazing.  We plugged it into two different computers and it immediately worked perfectly, no drivers to install or anything.  The sound quality is excellent and according to the person we Skyped with, it was great on her end, too, so the microphone is just as good as the speaker.  It's WAY better than the built-in speaker and microphone on my computer so I am very happy with this.

If you are looking for higher end headphones, these are the ones for you.  The battery life is incredible.  I use it a lot and can go a week at a time before having to charge it.  The noise cancelling is the best I've ever used.  The ear muffs are very comfortable.  These are just really great headphones.
It is easy to pair and has good audio quality.  The controls work as expected.  I'm very happy with it.
These headphones are very comfortable. I’ve had no issues with wearing them for extended periods of time. The sound is pretty good. I wish it was a little more sturdy feeling though.

The voice assistant on these headphones is very poor quality.  The noise cancellation works relatively well, particularly combined with the fact that they go over the ears.  It's not as good as high end noise cancellation headphones, but that is to be expected at the price point.  Pairing was easy.  They are reasonably comfortable.  The buttons are a little bit awkward, but it's nice that it has physical buttons in the first place.  For the price, these are great headphones.
It was easy to set for splitting audio out of HDMI signal to go to external speakers.  The audio and video stay in sync.  The price is good.  Highly recommended.
This is easy to set up and works well.  It lets you use new technology seamlessly  on old hardware.  It doesn't require external power which is a big plus.  The price is good, too.

Perfect way to broadcast a presentation or video to a big TV or projector. Just plug the HDMI and USB (for power) to your PC or tablet. Wait for it to pair to the base, then press the button. Your content, including sound, is now sent wirelessly to the base.

There are no compatibility issue since it follows the HDMI standards on both ends. We even tried it with an Apple TV as the source, a USB power adapter, and it work perfectly.

With the two included adapters it is easy to swap back an forth as needed to change the active presenter. If needed you can have up-to 8 devices paired to the base for round table collaboration sessions.

This is the easiest way to send HDMI across the room, no long cables, no software, no connecting everyone to the same Wi-Fi networks. It just works.

I have been looking at Noise Canceling headphones trying to figure out which one to get. These are just about perfect.

The Active Noise Canceling works very well. I have tested it on the Plane, long car ride, next to a room AC unit, settling down to sleep. I was able to get some sleep on my last flight thanks to this headset.

They work best when there is something playing even softly. My previous headphones could not be turned down low enough in a very quiet environment or up enough in a very noisy one. The Jabra 85h can handle that range. The microphone quality on phone calls is comparable to my old Plantations Voyager v5200. I was much happier once I realized that the headphone can be adjusted for head size.

The shipping packaging was not enough to prevent some minor damage . Fortunately, it was just cosmetic dents on some of the corners. (see picture)
The mounting holes were 16 inches apart so perfect for lining up with the studs in my wall. I would have liked some better mounting hardware. I believe that it will hold the listed 88-pound max weight.
As with all wall mount racks the depth of the rack is limited. There is about an inch and half clearance from the front brackets and glass door. I would not want to use any CAT6 patch cables in patch panels or switches on the front brackets. The back has about three and half inches clearance.
It comes with punchouts at the rear of the rack on top and bottom. This provides plenty of cable access.
Air flow and heat buildup is my biggest concern. If you have anything that generates a large amount of heat you will need to add fans for the very limited air holes. I would have preferred a screen for the front door and many more holes in the top of the rack. I was easily able to remove both sides and the front door. This is going to be my solution as I add more equipment.
The lock on the front door and the rear hinge is there to keep honest people honest. After I started installing equipment in the rack I was hesitant to open the hinge to access the back.
I am happy with the value for the price. For a low heat installation or if you are willing to remove the sides, it makes a nice small office or home rack.

I have gone through multiple chargers throughout my life. I tend to not follow the advice of "Protect your phone's battery and your charger cable by not using your phone while it's charging!!" What can I say, I'm a rebel. Because of this, my chargers don't last very long. I've had about a week of consistent use for the 4ft version of this one and I am really enjoying it. I have a few pros and one con.
The positives:
-The cable feels incredibly sturdy in your hands. It would take a lot for it to start ripping or breaking.
-I tested the charging capacity with multiple reciprocals to see if it effected the charge. As expected, the charging capacity depends solely on the power it is provided with, which is great!
-The length is manageable without being too much. Anything 6ft or longer tends to be flaky. This 4ft is absolutely fantastic in my opinion.
-The lightning adapter plugs into my phone easier than the Apple branded one that came with my phone so that was a bonus! The ease of plugging in does not effect unplugging, it unplugs just like any other charger and does not fall out.
-The leather strap is personally useless for me since I typically never move my chargers and don't travel, but I still appreciate the accessory. The leather feels durable and the clasp is sturdy. If you are someone who travels frequently or transports your chargers, the strap will make it much more compact and easy.

The negative:
-I hate the visual design. The black with white speckles is supposed to be aesthetically pleasing, but instead it makes the charger look dirty.

All in all, I would say this is a fantastic charger with a great price point. This charger would last much longer than others at similar price points. I will continue to be using this product consistently.
Love this, perfect size for my home office desk! Already had 3 trials in my Florida home office...saved my work and protected equipment!

I have never bought an easier, user friendly TV to set up and start using!  I picked it up, removed from the box it was set up and working in 10 minutes...WiFi and Neflx...easy! 720 DPI looks great, wanted at least 1080 but on the 24 inch screen the picture is fab, straight on, sideways or up angle!  Wish all the others were so easy!  I am not an audiophile but to me the sound is great volume, clear and even from the kitchen location it is great to hear 2 rooms away. At 72 I am not the most tech savvy but this was so QUICK AND EASY!

I miss wearing a watch and seeing the time without always picking up my cellphone. I enjoy seeing the time as I turn over in bed. Asking for music before bed to turn itself off within alloted settings. As it responds to my request it makes me laugh, when it corrects me and "I called it a smart ass".
Exactly as requested
My grandson uses it daily, and the sound is very clear

I have a business that requires presentations. Now I can use my iPhone instead of being
required to have a tablet or laptop. Been looking for this for a while. Great!

Did help with my situation.  You do have to change at the unit when you need to go from one to the other.  I don't know if it is my cable or not but there was a cloud image in the background when on Amazon.  Only there on the darkest pictures of the video.  Didn't really distract.  Anyway, I am glad to have it!

I heard the rich sound while at an appointment. I inquired, then researched. I really like this speaker. I had connection problems with pc at first, but tech support was extremely helpful and patient as I whined.

Works for me.  I use on my kitchen counter with my phone.  Takes up very little space.  The bass isn't bad because I'm not trying to hear it throughout the house.  It replaced an IHome bluetooth radio which I moved to basement.  Tired of seeing 3 clocks in my kitchen (microwave, stove and radio.  :-)  This Oontz works great.

I like these!  I use daily on my commute for music, videos or audio bible.  Will order again. Bass isn't bad.  Got to replace Macaw wireless that snapped right at the flexi part.  Hopefully, these won't snap at the same place and I'm careful with them.

I really like this compact stereo.  It doesn't have really deep bass but that is okay, what it has is good enough for me for the money it cost. I get a kick out of the blue lights blinking when it is turned on. The only thing I cannot figure out, unless I am missing it in the instructions, is how to set the clock. But I don't keep it plugged in all the time so it doesn't really matter. Good investment.

I bought this for my office, which is both too warm and short on electric plugs.  I got two in fact, one for my office mate, also.  We both plugged them into our computers' USB ports and have found them to be ideal for what we need.  The fans are really quiet when running, have a dial for speed, a lever action base to adjust for direction.  It is small, concentrated, and really works.  My office mate just thanked me again this week for getting one for her.  They do have a lanyard and an arm band and can run on batteries, but I haven't used those items with it.  I bought it just for the office, but see that that the other uses would be handy.

I got a cheap mp3 player, that works well for me,  but the ear buds that came with it were too big and not flexible, really a pain to use.  So I looked for inexpensive alternatives, found these, and real pleased with results.  The ear insert is flexible, smaller, comfortable.  The sound is better than the pair that came free with the player.  I'm not saying these are the best ever made - but I'm saying they are worth what I paid for them.  Good product!

My husband loses everything.. before I bought this he would constantly lose his keys 3 times a week, wallet even more so! And right before he would go to work!! This tile has been a lifesaver! If he doesn’t know where his keys are he just clicks a button on the app and it makes a chime. The chime is loud enough to hear and will let you know if your keys or whatever you put the tile in is nearby. What would take an hour of stressful turning the house upside down to find things is now within minutes and hassle free. I would recommend this to anyone!!

These speakers have superb high quality sound. Great solid base. Portable. 8 hours on battery. If you want to stream music wirelessly from your iPhone or iPad purchase the Miccus BluBridge Mini-Jack RX: Bluetooth Music Receiver use with Bluetooth-Enabled Mobile Phones, Tablets, PCs and Apple (BBMR-02). Plug the mini bridge into the 3.5 headphone jack, pair with your iPhone or iPad and you have an all-in-one music system on the go.

Bought this based on other reviews. Works great. The only thing is that the audio sounds kinda distorted. Maybe it was the XviD quality of the DVD rip - not sure but the 5.1 audio output "was not happening".

Great router. Great price. That is if you plan to use your notebook in the same dwelling as your MR314. Once you go outside, the frequency is dispersed. Netgear really needs to allow a user to attach an external antenna. This would really help performance so you can "stay connected" especially with a lot of radio interferrence we have around us (microwaves, 2.4 ghz cordless phones, etc.) To my knowledge, Netgear is planning to come out with a unit where you can plug in an external antenna. This would be ideal. For now I think Lucent and Cisco are the only wireless routers that allow you to connect a booster antenna. Otherwise a good value if you do not need the extra coverage. Location: residential neighborhood.

I am a big fan of Amazon Echo Show and Amazon devices in general. I had an older Echo Show in my office and got this one for the living room. This one it's just awesome, the sound quality is great, it follows your voice while you are interacting with it. As always, super easy to set it up and get it working. I love it and totally recommend it.

For the price these headphones are surprisingly nice. Great for a class or for listening to music or an audio book while waiting for appointments. Each pair comes in a plastic bag. They are simple to use, just plug in. They adjust and should fit most heads. They are comfortable and the sound is pretty good. Not sure how long they will last but overall a pleasant surprise.

This is a basic set. Set up was quick and easy and I like the wireless convenience. The keyboard is small but usable. The mouse is simple. While not the most responsive it performs adequately. It requires AA batteries that are not included. Simple and easy.

This speaker is fun. Easy to set up and use it has decent sound. Not pro quality but fine for casual get togethers at hone or at the beach. It is,stable and has wheels .I could easily live without the lights but most people find them entertaining. They can be turned off. The included mike is cheap. It works but quality is far from impressive. Still a decent speaker for the price.

This is a good quality recorder. It feels solid. There are quite a few buttons and the markings are hard to read. Nevertheless it is simple enough to operate once you become familiar with them. Sound quality is quite good. It is,clear and understandable. The recorder is rechargeable via the included usb cord. Battery life is dependent on use but it seems better than average. No carrying case or oouch. But otherwise nice.

This,mini pc is terrific for a home office or basic functions like surfing the net. It is reasonably fast and quiet. Wouldn't use it for gaming but it is terrific as an office adjunct. Super light it is easy to set up and use. Comes equipped with Windows 11.

This mouse is very quiet and easy to use. It is basic but responsive. Works well with my Chrome book. It is coated with antimicrobial material. Not sure how effective it is but not a bad idea. This mouse is the perfect size for travel. I like it.

This is a nice quality recorder. It is rechargeable. Well built it is compact but not too heavy. It is easy to use. It records well. I use it for interviews and lectures. Playback is clear and the sound quality is good. Not the best battery life but overall a good device.

This is a simple way to improve quality of video calls and zoom conferences. It is easy to set up and has enough options to make a difference without being overwhelming. You have to play around with itva little bit to get the most flattering light. Workmanship is adequate though it feels a bit cheap. The battery life is very goid, almost four hours.

This product looks cool and is fairly easy to operate. Sound quality is about average. It is not superlative but not awful. Radio reception is okay. My mother uses this almost exclusively. She finds it easy to use and enjoys being able to listen to her favorite cds and catch the news and npr. It is fairly compact and lightweight. If you are a true audiophile you will be disappointed. The bc base is skimpy.But if you are just looking for some background music and prefer old school styling this is the ticket.

This mouse is very cute. It is small and compact. It is a basic model but performs adequately. It is ideal for travel. Love that they included the batteries. The graphic is fun and makes it stand out.

My brother likes this radio. It is not especially attractive. It looks and feels cheap. But it works and provides essential information. Sound quality is adequate. It can be run on batteries which is practical if you live in an area prone to black outs. Be sure to have plenty on hand because overall battery life is at best fair. Not bad. 3.5 stars

This is,a nice dvd player. The screen is large and picture quality is good. Sound, too, is clear . set up and use are simple though the instructions are bc appbarely adequate.  The rechargeable battery lasts roughly five hours. It cones with a remote but can be manually adjusted. Decent.

This is a cute starter camera. It is simple to set up and use. The controls are basic. Picture quality is not impressive but is adequate. It is an easy way for a kid to learn the basics. It can handle bumps and bangs and can be tucked in a glove compartment. Everyone has to start somewhere. 3.5 stars

This solar security camera is compact and unobtrusive. Installation was straightforward. So far it is performing well. The audio is adequate. Picture quality, including night vision is quite good. Too early to report on reliability. I use the card, which is not included, instead of the cloud. There are plenty of options including a beep that alerts people they are being filmed. It is easily shut off. So far I am satisfied.

This is a nice change from the standard black mice. It is cute, pink with RGB lights to add a touch of excitement. Rechargeable it features plug and play ease. There is a leaflet of instructions. Fairly basic it is quiet. I am using it with a chrome book and have encountered no issues. It is lightweight and perfect for travel. Fun.

This solar light is an excellent deterrent. Simple to install it can produce both light and sound. There are four modes and they are easy to adjust. I live in an isolated area. While it is still a thrill to see wildlife I would prefer it if they chose to dine on something other than my pets, chickens or garden. My primary concern is the chickens that seem to be the main attraction. This has pretty much eliminated excursions day and night. Just make sure to position it so the panel receives daily sun.

This small tablet is a basic beginner's model  Nothing wrong with that so long as you understand its limitations. It is fine for entertainments, watching videos and playing games. It does one thing at a time. Multi tasking causes crashes. The screen and sound are adequate but not impressive. It is slow and the screen isn't responsive. The camera gets the job done. It is good for kids, or as a back up. 3.5 stars
These cards are a good value. I have them in two basic point and shoot cameras and they perform well. They are not super fast but adequate. Have had no issues and am pleased overall.

I use this  mp3 player when walking the dogs. Set up was straightforward. The set includes the player, ear buds, a usb cord, audio cable and instructions. It is compact and lightweight. Sound quality is acceptable. It has other functions and can serve as a voice recorder, fm radio, e book reader and alarm clock. But my interest is music while walking. I have large energetic German Shepherds and we go for miles. This is small and easy to use. If broken it would cost a lot less to replace than my phone. Worth it.

When doing a conference call there is enough to worry about without having to fuss over your camera system. This one is ideal. Essentially plug and play, it is simple to set up and use. Sound and video quality are good. It works with zoom and other apps. I've use it with zoom and skype with no problems. Noise cancelling functions well too. Great device for the price.

This sleep mask is reasonably soft and comfortable. Light was effectively blocked. It was easy to set up and pair. Sound quality is decent especially for meditation tracks. The headphone portion is noticeable if you sleep on your side. The mask is adjustable and washable.

This is a good package. It contains just about everything you need with the exception of a memory card. It comes with two batteries.battery life is very good. It has a wide angle lens and wifi capabilities. Although I haven't captured a ghost, the night vision is pretty good. Overall picture and sound quality is decent. Won't blow you away but is more than acceptable. It is versatile. A nice starter camera.

I live in a mountainous area where cell service is sketchy at best. These radios are a great way to contact someone who is out in the garden, greenhouse, barn or woods. Set up was simple and they work very well. They each require three AAA batteries, not included. Run time is pretty good.  Very handy.

These are nice headphones. They look stylish and are comfortable. Sound quality is surprisingly good, both for music and calls. The noise cancelling is adequate. It does not block all or even most noise. Enough to make a difference but nothing to write hone about. Battery life is good. The talk through feature would be better if you did not have to manually reset after using. But all in all these are good headphones.

This is a nice keyboard mouse combo. Set up was simple. There is one dongle for both the keyboard and the mouse. The keyboard is quiet, comfortable and a good size. The mouse is responsive. Time will tell how long it lasts but for now I am pleased with its performance.

This top loading cd player has retro style and decent sound. I have quite a,collection of all cds and it is nice to be able to enjoy them. This player can run on batteries but they don't last long. The adaptor is more practical. Too bad it isn't rechargeable but not a,deal breaker. It is vompact, lightweight and portable. The radio is adequate. Fun blast from the past.

This portable boom box has tons of retro charm. Easy to set up and use it has decent sound quality. I still have a lot of cds. The sound from phones, tablets and other devices really doesn't hold a candle to stereos and even little boom boxes like these. The radio is okay. It is lightweight and portable.

Seems these days every one is vlogging. This is a terrific entry level camera. It is easy to use, simple enough that even kids and luddites can handle it with ease. It has pretty much all the features a novice would need including good night vision and come with a good assortment of accessories. The touch screen is responsive and intuitive. The camera does not look or feel cheap. Sound is adequate and the picture quality is good.

This compact printer works well. Set up was straightforward although it took some fiddling around to get other devices (phones and tablets) to connect. Print quality is fine for home and school use.  It does an excellent job with photos. It scans quickly. So far I am satisfied with this printer. It has worked reliably and does not require too much space.

I liked that this ring light was large enough and strong enough to accomodate devices other than a,cell phone. It will hold cameras and tablets. The light itself is top notch. It is easy to adjust  and has enough options to satisfy the pickiest. It includes a charging port and can be used with a cord or batteries (not included).  I did not have fhe required batteries but appreciate the option.  I wish it had a remote control.The included tripod is acceptable though not impressive. It is simple to set up and does the job. But the light is the show stopper here and justifies the expense.

At the outset I admit I am not a fan of ear buds. They are a necessary evil though for exercise.  I was looking for something that would work well for dog walking. I have large active dogs and we go miles morning and night. These fit the bill. They come with a charging case and have a pleasing contemporary appearance. The set include three sets of tips, a charging cable, instructions and safety information. Set up was simple and I had no problem pairing. The buds are on. They are not noise cancelling which is not an issue for my purposes. There is no on off button; they are on once removed from the case. More snniying there is no volume control. You have to adjust using the phone or other device. They fit as comfortablyvas phones of this style can and have performed satisfactorily. Battery life is good, about five hours on a single charge. A little pricey for what they are but I have been using them and am pleased with the overall performance.

If you are tired of dealing with tiny screens, poor sound and use limitations, this is the machine for you. It is large and in charge. The cherry red is gorgeous and it comes with a charger, car charger, cable, remote, and game console. Battery life is good and set up is simple. Versatile it does more than play dvds. The screen is large,clear with excellent resolution. Sound is surprisingly robust. Although touted for kids it is suitable for anyone, young or old. It appears well made and arrives securely packaged. Pleased.

This combo brings wireless convenience and reliable performance to the home or office. Truly plug and play set up was a snap. The keyboard is comfortable and responsive. There are four programmable keys. I would have been thrilled had it been backlit but at this price point that is not a feature you see. The mouse performs adequartely. I wouldn't say it was silent but it is not noisy either. It performs as expected and feels good when using. It comes with everything you need to get started. Mouse battery is estimated at 12 months; keyboard at 24. It is too early to report on longevity but so far I am pleased with the quality and performance.

This is a competent little speaker. Set up was simple and the sound is good, with definite bass. The speaker phone function is handy. It is resistant to water and can be used indoors or out. The coral red is a color that will work at a party or at the office. Battery life is good. Depending on use it does come close to the twelve hours. I wish it had greater volume. It seems subdued and fairly quiet. Overall nice, compact speaker.

This is a terrific set. Truly plug and play it sets up quickly and easily. The keyboard is comfortable and quiet. The mouse is lightweight but responsive. It is fine for ordinary tasks but not fast enough for serious gaming. The multi-media shortcuts are a welcome feature. It works with Macs and PCs, laptops and desktops. I wish it were backlit but not a deal breaker.  There are light indicators for cap lock and num lock. Batteries are inckyded. A nice, useful, affordable set.

This is a basic upgrade but one that is generally satisfactory. The package contains instructions, a subwoofer, soundbar, RCA audio cable. The instructions were straightforward and it was a trouble-free installation. The remote is simple and battery operated. The unit has a sleek appearance that should blend with most decors. The sound is good, realistic, rich and distortion-free. Pleased.

This bag is sturdy and professional. Briefcase style it is made from weather resistant material. There are handles as well as a detachable shoulder strap. Padding is adequate and there is a well designed port for charging on the go. I have a lenovo 15.6inch laptop and it just fit. Thus bag works better for smaller,slimmer devices but the 15.6 inch models are the max. Depending on the brand it may be a tight fit. Overalk, a handsome, light, practical bag.

This hub is small and portable. Plug and play it requires no software or drivers. it works well with my Lenovo laptop and my desktop. it transfers data adequately. I am pleased with this product. It does not come with any instructions but is very straightforward to use.

This speaker is awfully cute. it looks like a retro radio. Made of wood it is quite small and portable. There is an attached lanyard. It includes an FM radio. It connects via Bluetooth or you can use the included cable for aux input or a card. The battery is rechargeable and really does last. Alas, performance is less than stellar. The radio portion is second rate, staticy and inconsistent. The sound is acceptable but far from superb. It is fine for some background music but it really doesn't enhance the music. The cable used is the same one that charges the battery. So if you are looking for some sound while you work indoors or out, this is a very cute way to deliver it. But if you want to truly appreciate the music, look elsewhere. 3.5 stars

If you are accustomed to using Dragon software you will be more satisfied than if you are new to it. The recorder itself is fine if  a bit low on the volume. Set up and use are not intuitive and are unnecessarily cumbersome. They should be streamlined. A code with which to download the software is included. If you are looking for cinema quality images and easy use and set up, this projector is close to perfect.

This is a beautiful watch. its understated elegance makes it perfect for business or social occasions. One of the things I like best is that it is battery operated. I do't have to add one more thing to my pile of devices that need nightly charging. Replaceable, the battery is estimated to have a life of about six months. It also is easy to change the look by swapping out bands.

The included instructions are useless. Unless you have an interest in practicing your reading comprehension in 20 different languages, skip the books and access the quick start guide on the manufacturer's website. Essentially you download an app to your device and follow the instructions. It is pain free. Operate by using the three buttons on the watch. The top one is for the day, the middle one deals with your alarms, date and time zones and the last one is customizable. It can be used to control music, as a camera remote or to locate your phone.
The watch face contains a smaller dial on the left for notifications and activity. With the app you can select the notifications you want to receive and assign a color to them. This feature lets you know at a glance who or what is contacting you. The rest of the dial is essentially a progress meter for your activity or goals. As far as accuracy as a fitness tracker, it tends to give me roughly ten percent more activity than my fit bit..It is pretty even with my fit bit as far as sleep tracking goes. It does not work with all apps on your phone an is rather limited as to what is available. It may be my imagination but the app does seem to take a toll on my (Android) phone's battery

I love this watch's classic style. It is comfortable to wear. Although somewhat thicker than a regular watch it is not as bulky as many smart watches. the notifications are discreet and it isn't obvious you are tracking your activity (or sleep depending on your office). techies will probably be dissatisfied but this watch does handle the basic functions, notifications, music, and activity well. Although all the options and fancy doodads are cool, I certainly don't need them and probably wouldn't use them. If you are equally (or more) interested in sophisticated style than technological mastery, this watch delivers.fashion in spades with basic smart phone functionality.

I did not know how much I needed this device until I had it. It is simple to set up and use, no advanced engineering degree required. It works perfectly so far. I have been using it primarily to attach punters and scanners to different computers. The blue lights make it easy to see what you are connected to. In my busy office, simple is good.

This storage device is as reliable as it is handsome. I personally like the metal and matte case. Yes, the metallic portion does need the occasional wipe but it is a nice change from boring black. but ultimately the litmus test of nay storage device is its performance. And I am satisfied with this one. the box contains the device, a short cable and a fairly useless quick start guide. Just go to the website and download the complete owner's manual for your device. It is detailed, clearly written with illustration and contains just about everything you need to know about set up and use. It is efficient and reasonably fast. the 4 TB capacity is excellent and the 3 year limited warranty is generous. The auto back up has not failed once and I liked the ability to store from the cloud and social media. It is lightweight and portable and provides capacity and style. It seems durable and has thus far sustained no damage in my man travels. I do wish the cable was longer but that is merely a quibble. Overall, it delivers.

If you value portability over performance, this is the speaker for you. It is lightweight and easy to transport. Very sturdy, it withstands water,drops and other insults without damage. It charges via USB port and the cable is included. If found the connection iffy. In areas where there is not a strong signal connectivity was finicky and unreliable at best. where the signal was strong, it was fast and good. In many ways this reminds me of a contemporary version of a transistor radio. You can take it anywhere but the sound quality is far from impressive. fine to provide some background music at a barbecue or party or while lounging at the pool but not where music is the focus. It is decent with audio books and the speakerphone function is surprisingly good. While I can't say I'ms impressed by it, I do use it and its handiness can't be beat. If you can temper your musical expectations and appreciate its sturdiness and portability, you will find this speaker convenient.  3.5 stars

What I like best about this adapter is just how light and portable it is. So far it works as promised and seems decently constructed. Travel adds wear and tear to all accessories so time will tell how long this lasts.The color coded ports make it easy to distinguish mic from headphone.  For now, I am having no problems. I travel frequently for business and this makes working on the road easier.

I frequently have to work at different office sites so a universal docking station sounded ideal. Of course this isn't truly universal. Check to make sure it is compatible with your laptop. If it is, this is a serviceable device. It weighs less than a pound so it is easy enough to transport. It is simple to set up. data transfer is reasonably quick, not blazing fast but not bad. to date I've had no problems with it but it is still early. so far it has made my life easier and I am satisfied with its performance. I anticipate average durability.

whether you work in a noisy office, a call center or at home, these headphones will supply the features you need and want. for me comfort, performance and ease of use are paramount when it comes to headphones. If they aren't comfortable you will not use them or will be unable to use them for extended periods of time. the on ear headphones are padded with a faux leather. It is soft and doesn't cause the ears to become hot. the headband is similarly cushioned and doesn't bind or cut. although well made they do't feel heavy when wearing.

Set up was simple. The headset comes with a pre-paired dongle and charges via USB. An orange cable is included. It takes up to three hours to get a full charge. There is an indicator light to let you know when it is ready to go. the controls are simple to use and easy to get accustomed to. I especially like that you can hear an outside conversation without removing the headset. A light
indicates when you should not be disturbed. speech clarity is excellent, light years ahead of a speakerphone. The ANC effectively suppressed background noise and chatter. Not only can your hear, you don't have to scream to be heard.

I thought its performance playing music was good. The sound was well balanced but you can adjust it to your satisfaction. It works with both mac and Pc as well as Android and iphones. The set includes a nifty hard clamshell case, as well as a quick start guide. This is a high quality set, that is perfect for calls and music. It provides comfort and performance thereby enhancing your concentration and productivity.

I have a (Lenovo) laptop reserved for business use and frequently work from different locations. This device is a great way to set up a temporary work station. It is small and light enough to take with me. It has two 3.0 ports, two 2.0 ports and two reserved for charging things like  phones and tablets. Set up is quick and easy and so far it has been working well. Be sure to check for driver updates. It is a good way to enhance off site productivity.

a good gaming monitor can be the difference between victory and defeat. this one by Acer hits all the sweet spots. It is an attractive monitor with an adjustable stand. The stand is very cool and is unfussy to use. The resolution is superb with a clean, crisp picture. Even better the fast response rate eliminates ghosting and blur. I have yet to experience any screen stuttering and tearing. The variable refresh rate insures a smooth, seamless experience. the twenty four inch monitor is the perfect size. It does not  demand too much real estate.The speakers provide impressive sound. this is an excellent monitor that will give your game the edge.

Comfort and performance are paramount  in gaming headsets. This one is impressive and affordable. At first glance, they look like a headache in the making. but they are surprisingly lightweight and comfortable.  People game for hours, not a few minutes at a time. and uncomfortable headpiece is a deal breaker.Unlike some the headband does not feel like a vice.The ear cups are soft enough to cradle the ear while blocking out sound. The surround sound is impressive and contributes to an immersive experience. The controls are easy to use and function as expected.  The retractable mic is a pleasant surprise. To date I've experienced no crackling. these are wired headphones which are fine for those of us who game primarily on PCs. wireless are sexier, more expensive and have to be recharged.  They appear reasonably durable. If you are looking to up your game economically while enjoying ddddecent sound, this headset will not disappoint.

I live in a mountainous region where wild weather and power interruptions are all too frequent. This sleek tower helps protect my valuable, sensitive electronics from damage. The instructions seemed simple enough but it took some time to pry the cover off the battery compartment. It has generous capacity with five outlets for both backup and surge protection and five for surge protection only. There is an alarm that thankfully can be muted. I liked that it provides both backup and protection from fluctuating voltage. the LCD interface is clear and easy to read. The tower itself is not too large or clunky and has a pleasing modern aesthetic. So far this device has operated without problems. while I hope to never have another black out or suffer a surge it is reassuring to have reliable protection.

This sturdy turntable makes old school cool. If you have boxes of unused vinyl, you can put them to use. I was surprised at the size of this device. Assembly is required. There are people who enjoy assembly and tinkering. I am not one of them. I found the instruction inadequate and the manufacturer's YouTube videos only compounded the problem. There are other videos that helped but even after assembly it still needed adjustment. Belt driven means parts to replace eventually. It was not so onerous as to be a deal breaker but was a hassle I try to avoid. that being said, once assembled, up and running, it breathed new life into old vinyl. A true audiophile would probably not be impressed but the average person should be satisfied. So if you are into old school you will love the vintage look,and decent sound enough to deal with the annoying assembly.

This messenger bag has many features that make it ideal for travel. It is compact and has a fairly casual style. It has a sturdy look and feel. The shoulder strap is adjustable and removable. There is also a handle on the top. It attaches easily to luggage. The RFID pocket is a thoughtful touch and the placement of the pocket for small electronics provides easy access. The padded section does accommodate laptops up to 15.6 inches. The padding is adequate but not generous. There is one zippered pocket. The zipper is a bit stiff but works. One section has a velcro closure. It is a decent bag for travel or for everyday use. I do wish there was a contrasting lining, more padding  but overall this is an attractive and useful bag for the busy commuter or student.

What I liked best about this player is that is works with anything ( including DVDs, 3D Blu-rays , 4K Ultra HD discs, USB files, CD Audio, and more) on anything, 4K tv or not.My second favorite feature is that it can be used with Bluetooth headphones.  It packs some heft and I was surprised at how hefty it was. It is a bit larger than I expected but has a sleek appearance.the package includes an instructions, a remote control, batteries, warranty info and a registration card.  Set up was simple and hassle free. My home network can be skittish but I encountered no hiccups.  Load time was satisfactory. It varied depending on what was inserted but there were no lags. Currently there are four streaming apps: Netflix, Amazon, Opera TV and VUDU. I've only tried one, Netflix, and it worked well. Overall performance is satisfactory. the picture is great. I can't say that it was much improved but there is definitely some.  This player seems very well made and thus far has performed well. There are pricier models with more bells and whistles but this one has everything the average home user would need or want. A good product by a reliable company, it is not unduly complicated and provides superb performance without the need to rebuild your library.

When it comes to my expensive electronics, stands and risers better be sturdy and stable. This one delivers on both counts. An unobtrusive matte black, it does require assembly. I am not handy but it took me a little under a half hour to get this fully assembled.The instructions are clear.  I was pleased with how sturdy it is. wobble free it does not require clamping or screwing to the desk or stand.  It is adjustable without undo fuss. I liked that it is easy to move and reposition. Overall I am satisfied with thisriser.

It may not be a techie's delight, but if you are looking for a budget streaming device, this one fits the bill. First off it is quite small making it ideal for cramped or limited spaces like a vacation home or boat. It comes with a short, two foot long cable and a piece of two sided tape. It connects to your tv with the cable.Depending where you tv is located you might have to use a longer cable. I did and found that the tape is not just a nice idea, it is a necessity. the box is so small and most cables so rigid it flips the box off making it impossible to regulate with the infrared remote. Take time to position because while the tape adheres well it looses its stickiness after being removed and repositioned. The infrared remote must be in line of sight for it to work. The way around that is to use the app. The app works with both android and iOS. The app has a voice control which I found to be inconsistent and a private listening feature that lets you use your phone headphones and mute the TV.

Performance is mixed. navigating and launching is slow. Netflix in particular really dragged. but playing content was excellent with no lag or problems. the channel selection is good with pretty much everything you would want available.

This is not bad for a budget streamer. there are definitely downsides, the ir remote, the lack of speed, the need for a cable. but it does work and is small enough for travel. I am frequently on the road for business and this does expand the limited options of hotel televisions. If you are on a budget and don't need or want the features that are available on pricier models this low end streamer will get the job done.

This lock is small and sturdy. It is light enough to transport and certainly is sufficient to deter crimes of opportunity. I liked its versatility. It can be used for any number of devices, not just laptops. Be sure to register the lock so you can easily get a replacement key if you misplace  yours. Electronics are expensive and as a frequent traveller it pays to be careful. This is a simple step for security.

I love Mr. Beams. These two spotlights provide plenty of bright white light. They are easy to install, no wiring required. they run on D batteries (not included)  and come with the hardware necessary to affix. The motion detector is sensitive and activates the light. The dusk to dawn sensor and auto shut off ensure safety and economy. I have other Mr. Beams products and easily get year or more use from the batteries.

These are excellent security lights. Battery operated, they dispense with the need for fussy and pricey wiring. They are simple to install and require four D batteries. Life depends on usage and the quality of the batteries used. I have other Mr. Beams outdoor lights and the most active needed to be changed after about a year and a half. The motion detector is adequately sensitive and the light is surprisingly bright for battery operated LEDs. the heads adjust insuring the coverage you want. The lights stay lit for about thirty sections. Made from a heavy plastic, they are weatherproof and durable. I have been pleased with the other Mr. Beams products I won and expect that these lights will prove to be equally superb.

These are a good value for headphones. they are lightweight and comfortable. the sound quality is decent. I actually like the extra long cord. It provides versatility and you can connect to just about everything, phones, tv, stereo and computers. On the down side these do not block sound. You can hear what's going on outside and people outside can hear what you are playing. They are not especially portable. They do not fold nor are they notably compact. I've only had them a short time so can't speak to long term durability. I am using them in an office so the wear and tear is minimal. For my purposes they are fine. I don't know that someone who uses them daily on an active commute or a serious audiophile would be equally satisfied. If you are in the market for an affordable multi purpose headphone, these are worthy of your consideration.

this is a terrific little mouse. Set up is simple and everything you need, including the battery is included. The little dongle is easy to insert and can be stored in the mouse when travelling. there is a small on/off button on the base. The promised battery life is a generous one year. The scroll operates smoothly and the buttons function properly. The white color stands out making it easy to locate. this is a small compact device. Ideal for travel, it is a space saver. However, those with larger hands may find it uncomfortable for extended use. I travel frequently and am accustomed to using the smaller devices so the petite size does not bother me. This is a simple mouse with no bells and whistles. With plug and play simplicity, it is easy to use and thus far reliable.

This is a simple device that does what it promises We were recently having work done on the house and the workers accessed the house via a back door. this alerted me to their comings and goings. It is easy to install and requires three AAA batteries that are not included. I found that anoying as this is neither an expensive or especially complex. There are two functions, a chime which notifies when someone enters or exits and an ear piercing alarm. You have 30 second to input a four digit pin to deactivate the alarm. Since the work has been completed, I am thinking of moving it to a back shed door. It is effective and works well.While certainly not a complete security system in and of itself, it can be a useful device to notify and alert.

This is an inexpensive deterrent. It looks like a real dome camera. It comes with the hardware necessary for installation and requires 3AAA batteries to activate the flashing red light. The instructions are adequate. although I was tempted to forgo the installation and opt for tape, we do have extremes of temperature and I was concerned the tape wouldn't last. Once installed it seemed secure. The red flashing lights work well and give potential burglars/mischief makers notice that it is operational. Batteries last two to three months. be sure to place in a protected area as this item is not waterproof and is sensitive to extreme temperatures. It looks like the real thing and hopefully is enough to dissuade the ne'er do wells.

With the heroin epidemic making an incursion to my once sedate neighborhood, it seemed like an ounce of prevention would be worth a pound of cure. While my home is protected by the German shepherd security system, other buildings including a greenhouse, shed and detached garage are not. Silver and black, this product looks like the real thing, especially from a distance. It is easy to install and requires two AA batteries to activate the red light. the batteries should last up to 90 days. It should be placed in a sheltered area and the directions suggest removing in the event of extreme temperatures. I am assuming it is not waterproof which is unfortunate because my locale usually enjoys generous rain and snow. While we don't get extreme heat, it is not uncommon to experience below zero cold. that being said, it does provide peace of mind. From a distance it looks like an active surveillance camera and hopefully that will deter ne'er do wells with mischief on their mind.

These sturdy ties are good for indoor and outdoor use. The reusable plastic bag hold 100 eight inch ties. They are great for taming a mess of wires. I put them to work in our green house and also outside securing some solar lights. They are single use but doe hold securely. they are resistant to extremes in temperature, which is a big plus. I live in a mountainous area and in the winter temperatures frequently drop to zero and below. They sem well made and certainly do the job.

This clever device helps connect devices lacking an ethernet port to a wired network. I live in a mountainous area and WIFI is sketchy at best. The device itself is light and portable and fairly easy to use. However, the instructions are inadequate. I had to download a driver to get it to work and it is not compatible with my Fire tablet. That being it said, it does work well with compatible devices.

This is a perfectly adequate wireless Bluetooth speaker. a simple black box, it should blend with most decors. It comes with an easy to follow quick Start guide, warranty papers and an adapter. The rechargeable battery is built in and it promises up to five hours of music playback. There is also a microphone built in for phone calls.

I used this at a party. the Bluetooth streaming was flawless and it did play without issue for over four hours. I don't know that anyone was blown away by the sound quality, but it met expectations. This is a relatively uncomplicated device which is a definite selling point for me. It performed well. Serious audiophiles may differ but for my purposes (background music and occasional use as a speakerphone), it is satisfactory.

In a world of black cables this red one stands out. Three feet long, it has male to male connectors. Thus far it has performed adequately, with no problems. I can't say that I have noticed any difference in performance from any other similar cables I've used but then, again, I generally wouldn't unless it wasn't functioning properly. Mine is a genuine Belkin and there is a  limited lifetime warranty against defects in  design, assembly, workmanship and material.

Slim and trim, the keyboard has a sleek appearance and compact size. Ideal for travel, it features chiclet keys that are fairly quiet. It reminds me of a slightly larger laptop configuration. Set up was easy and I had no difficulty adjusting to it. However my brother who has large hands and chunky fingers found it uncomfortable and inaccurate. It is not back lit and does not have an indicator light for the Caps Lock button. The mouse is basic and functions although I have used many smoother and more responsive. However the auto off energy saving function is just annoying. It doesn't just go into a sleep mode, it shuts itself off after four hours of inactivity. It must be restarted by flipping over and pressing a button. While this doesn't seem like a big deal, it is irritating especially if you are accustomed to the other type. This may be helpful when travelling but if you are using with a desk top that is in use pretty much all day, it is irritating.

I do like the appearance of the keyboard. Its space saving design adds a modern touch. However, the mouse is limited and the power saving feature is just annoying. So I will be reserving this set for travel where its advantages will outweigh its limitations. 3.5 stars.

Although I much prefer over the ear headphones, there are times the portability and convenience of lightweight ear buds can't be beat. Unfortunately comfort and overall sound quality are usually issues. These inexpensive headphones address comfort concerns by including ear caps in three different sizes. The caps are made of silicone which is soft and does mold to the ear. I liked the white and gold. It made them bright and easy to find in a cluttered bag or backpack. Although the sound quality is far from philharmonic, it is more than adequate for headphones at this price point. It is crisp and clean with no overpowering bass. The inline mic works well  and contributes to the convenience factor. Overall I liked both the look and the performance of these affordable in ear headphones.

This sleek little device is a great upgrade of aging laptops or desktops. It is cheaper than a new computer and provides a performance boost that makes all the difference in the world. It is light, quiet and resistant to drops, bumps and other shocks. Measuring  2.75 x 3.96 x 0.28 inches, it seemed the answer to an older desktop I have sitting unused for the most part. There is nothing wrong with it. It is just slow. Installation was not difficult but this product does not come with cloning software or a mounting bracket. For the software, I used  EaseUS Todo. (for what it is worth,  an IT guy I know recommends Paragon Migrate OS to SSD.) The manufacturer also offers a kit to walk you through the process and it includes the cables, bracket, screws and cloning software:[[ASIN:B008ZIO1CW SanDisk SSD Conversion Kit - Step by Step Software and Hardware. Before beginning you probably want to backup your data if you are not already doing so and defrag your disk. Migration was uneventful and the computer  was significantly faster  afterwards. Overall, this product delivered, breathing new life into an old computer. There is a three year limited warranty.

The best headphones are the perfect combination of superb sound and comfort. But finding that balance is easier said than done. I've had many headphones from the inexpensive to the pricey that have failed to meet the mark.

These Koss headphones have a sleek appearance and come in a convenient carrying case. The D shape conforms to the ear and the graduated cushioning is comfortable. It is snug without being too tight and there is no slippage. Although not noise cancelling, they block much exterior noise. The sound quality is superb. Music is rich and full bodied with no muddy undertones. There is no bluetooth connectivity and I wish the headphone wire was longer. But these are not deal breakers, at least for me. Overall, an excellent choice for comfort and performance.

This is a terrific combo. Set up is super simple. It is a matter of inserting the nano receiver in the USB port. It connects both mouse and keyboard. The keyboard is comfortable to use, even for extended periods of time. I would not describe the keyboard as quiet but it is fine for home use. I do wish it had a caps lock indicator like my Logitech but that is not a deal breaker. The mouse is a tad small and a basic design. There are only three control buttons; left click, right click and scroll. I have purchased fancier versions but for the most part really just rely on the basic controls.

All in all, this is a serviceable set that will free you from the inconvenience of wires. Easy to set up and pleasant to use, it demonstrates that basic is good.

This speaker is impressive in size and sound. Weighing in at about sixty pounds, it has a sophisticated, sleek appearance. The black ash veneer is sophisticated and should complement any decor. But one doesn't acquire a speaker for appearance. The sound is everything and this one delivers. It is clear and clean with no distortion. I am not an audiophile but I do appreciate quality and this speaker delivers. Ideal for both the music lover and the movie aficionado, this speaker is sure to wow.

Lower and mid end earphones have generally been lacking in both quality and performance. Given my propensity to misplace them, I have been reluctant to invest in more expensive versions. But with increased reliance on mobile devices, it was most definitely time to upgrade.

My familiarity with Munitio was more from their urban chic style complete with bullet motif, Kevlar coated cord, "tactical" carrying case and "hollow point" ear cups. At the risk of looking more Duck dynasty than cool, I was eager to try them.

Designed for use with Apple devices, the phones come securely packaged in a black carrying case. The look is sleek and modern and the bronze color is appealing. These are also available in black and gray. There are three sets of ear cups in different sizes. They were comfortable and shut out outside noise. The cord is flat and tangle free with a heft that promises durability. The 3 button mic control is located on the upper left hand side of the earphone cable. I really couldn't see the buttons but quickly mastered them by touch. They provide full functionality for calls and music on iPods, iPods and iPhones and just music for other mp3 players and Android devices.

I encountered no difficulties in making or taking calls. I could hear the other party and they could hear me without difficulty. The mic is positioned close enough to the mouth and is sufficiently sensitive that I didn't have to scream or repeat things. I made calls from a fairly busy coffee shop and a mall and ambient noise did not impair the call quality.

I tried these earphones with my IPod and a cheap mp3 player of dubious lineage. The sound was clear, strong and enjoyable. I did not find the bass overwhelming and was generally pleased with the performance.

Bottom line, I liked these earphones. The case and the trio of ear cups are thoughtful touches. Although light, there is a sense of substance and quality. The controls are intuitive and easy to use. There is a two year limited warranty. Serving up generous doses of comfort, convenience and performance, these ear phones are right on target.

Having burnt through yet another pair of earbuds, I opted to try these pretty, inexpensive headphones. The sound quality is remarkable for a low end set. No these are not two hundred dollar headphones, but for every day use,they are fine, decent sound quality and no noise. Adjustable, they should fit pretty much anyone. The round phones fit snugly and seem firm, but all in all, they are quite comfortable. The Gumball Sunrise pattern was bright and cheerful, sure to appeal to the younger set and a nice change from my usual black. BTW I purchased these at Office Max for ten dollars less than what is listed here.  Recommended.

This is one sharp looking case. The red is lovely, strong and vibrant. It is bright enough to be eye catching but dark enough to hide dirt. The ipad mini fits securely and the design of the case does not intefere with use of the device. Thankfully you do not need a degree in engineering to insert (and remove) the tablet. The padding is sufficient to protect against everyday bumps and bangs and the stand is adequate.

This is an attractive case that will provide both protection and style. Recommended.

I was looking for a pair of decent over ear headphones to use with a portable dvd/cd player. I travel quite a bit and did not want to spend a tremendous amount of money but still wanted good quality and some degree of portabililty. Thesse fit the bill. The sound is far superior to any ear buds I have tried and other headphones in the under fifty dollar range. The sound was good and crisp. The leather ear phones are very comfortable and superb at blocking ambient noise. I have used them with both music and meditation cds and have been satisfied. They come with a striaght plug and a jack adaptor.

My sole complaint was with the band itself. Although some might disagree, I do not have a fat head. My skull is a normal size. The band itself is just a tad too loose and feels like it is going to slip. It also seems heavy. However, this one shortcoming does not outweigh the many positives. Recommended.

This is a terrific mouse. It is stylish, comfortable and wireless. The nano receiver is low profile. Just plug it in and you are good to go. It operates smoothly and is exceedingly comfortable to use. It is also ambidextorous so both lefties and righties will be able to use it with ease. The color is more of a metallic turquoise than an indigo. There is a pretty silver and true indigo design adding some elan. It comes with the required battery.

I especially appreciated the easy open package. Popping open those hard plastic clamshells can be a lnightmare but this one has easy open tabs on the back.

A mouse is a small thing in the general scheme of things. But the superior performance, comfort, attractive appearance and caring touches of this one enhance the computing experience and just make life easier.

As much as I love my netbook, I am frequently frustrated by its limitations. This little device expands the netbooks by providing an easy way to connect kperipherals. It is easy to use and has some thoughtful design features including a retractable cord. While not an object of beauty, it is small, light and functional.

While my netbook will never replace my laptop (or desktop) with this device, its usefullness is enhanced. I travel quite a bit and lugging my laptop is often inconvenient. This device does help.

I first became enamored of the garmin company after using the one with a rental car. The ease of use and accuracy was impressive. Unfortunately, that model is no longer in production so I opted for this unit.

In general I am pleased. Easy to set up, the unit features a bright, clear screen. It is a snap to use and the directions have been unfailing accurate. I drive alot and so far have used this unit throughout New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Maryland, DC and Virginia. I have had no problem with reception even while traversing mountainous regions. I appreciate the advance notice for turns and the voice command system is a convenience.

However, this unit is not flawless. The robotic voice often mispronounces street names and the voice command system seems a bit hard of hearing when it comes to addresses. I have had to pull over and type in the address. The unit does not like to deviate from its chosen route. For instance, one location I frequent in New York is accessible both by the thruway (toll road) and other non-toll main arteries. Both are about the same distance. When I want to avoid the toll route, the unit will recalculate directing that I turn around and follow the initial route multiple times before adjusting to the alternate route. A big deal, no,but annoying nonetheless. While I have not been terribly plagued by the pop ups, they are annoying and potentially unsafe. While the start up guide and manual are adequate, they are barely so. Whatever happened to detailed instructions? But my biggest gripe is the customer service. I called twice with questions and had ridicualously long waits of fifteen minutes and twenty-five minutes respectively. There is no round the clock service. The last time I called it wasnt even available all week, totally unacceptable.

So while I like this system,there is room for improvement.

I can watch TV anytime during the night while my wife is sleeping.  I turn on the TV, hit mute when it starts to come on, then push the on button on the headset and adjust the volume.  The sound is contained in the headset and no disturbance to my sleeping wife.

I had a wonder boom for many years. Easy to pair clear sound with all types of music. My sons speaker stopped working so he borrowed my wonder boom. He liked it so much he asked to keep it. So I let him keep it and went to Amazon and purchased a new one. Very happy With my wonder  boom.

The fire tv with Alexa is so much fun. My grand kids love how easy it is to watch their favorite shows snd they don't have to use the remote.  The fire tv still controls my Alexa compatible devices.the sound from prime music omes through the  tv speakers and the older kids love that the lyrics are on the screen.

I had placed it in a window which prohibited the motion device, so I ended up mounting it outside (and I do purchase the silicon skins to protect my devices) with the suggestion of Tech support and it works beautifully now (tech support wait time was less than 2 minutes on a Sunday afternoon/PST). At first, the camera appeared to have a glitch with a constant flashing, so I removed the battery and reinserted it and it was fine. Tech support was able to remote into my cameras to test whether it was getting Wifi, optimized settings, signals, etc. which was very helpful in figuring out where I was having my issue. In trying to set up my Pro, I watched a few Arlo videos which introduced me to the "MODE" tab option which then allowed me to access ALL my cameras in customizing my cameras better than just going straight into DEVICE tab. Not confirmed, but I think the MODE overrides any settings that you would do to your device if you go directly into DEVICE tab. Select MODE tab, then select your BASE, then click on your cameras individually & SAVE. Having accessed the MODE, ALL my cameras are now working much better. I get email alerts (which is set under MODE & can be turned off if you wish). I have had my Arlo system since 2016 and with my new addition, can't beat the price and reliability of the device. However, I do clean the lenses periodically for optimum motion detection. I do like that the Arlo Pro is rechargeable because my other 3 are not and it costs me about $40 in batteries every 3 months (those cameras take 4 batteries each).  If you find video you want to save, you can download it to your PC/Smart Phone for safe keeping; otherwise, Arlo Cloud clears your video library on the 7th day (which comes with the camera free with the option to subscribe to Arlo if you want a longer history). Bottom-line, you can purchase this system and grow it to meet your needs and upgrade cameras to which the base will support it. I can access https://arlo.netgear.com/#/login via PC or SmartPhone to view my LIBRARY. I do recommend updating your phone app periodically.

In 15 years, I have had 2 laptops crash. And 1 desktop crash in that amount of time. But - I have never lost information. I don't store my information on my desktop or laptop . . . I worked solely off of harddrives. I have used the WD Elements Hard Drives for over 15 years now. I had 1 4tb that I used over and over again to back up my laptop and personal files. As I got busier with work and life . . . fast forward 15 years and I now have 6 of these. I work daily off of 2 of these . . . one has personal files and the other has work files. No delay. That being said . . . my desktop has a top of the line processor, but I don't think that works to make the hard drive move any faster. But still . . . I work all day every day without any delays . . .

I have 2 backups of the original working harddrives - for work and for personal. I back up every single week like clockwork.

I then have 2 backups of the 1st backups. You don't want to be backing up your working harddrive (thereby putting into play your original harddrive and your 1st back up harddrive) . . . so you need a 2nd back up in the event something catastrophic occurs during the back up of your original harddrives. So I have 3 each for work (1 I work off of every day) and 3 each for personal (1 I work off of every day).

I know that I will always have a full set of my work files, my Outlook files and my accounting files.

Yep . . . it's a $600 investment for peace of mind and security of my files . . . and it's a system that works for me . . .

I was looking for a sling camera bag for ease of use when I am in action mode, e.g., hanging off the side of a jeep during safari, hanging over the railing of a boat while photographing breaching whales. I did not want the typical backpack or the shoulder bag (both of which I own) that would impede me from such movements and/or would need to be set down while I was shooting.

I like to leave my zoom lens on my camera. I attach a lens in the open as few times as possible for the obvious reasons, e.g., salt air, dust. I have a Nikon 200-500 lens attached to a D4 body. With that configuration, the camera/lens is 14.25" long, D4 body is 6" wide and lens at its widest is 5" and it fills this bag's length (including the unzipped 30% extra). That set up is also about 10-11 pounds of weight. However, in order to fit it . . . I had to remove the square cushioned "cube" that is affixed by velcro into one side of the bag. Once my cameras/lens was in the bag, there was about 3" of horizontal (lengthwise space) left and 3" of vertical space as well as small pockets of space around the camera/lens itself. I would not be able to fit my IPad. I could probably tuck my IPhone in somewhere. Extra batteries, battery charger and cords would be doubtful. One extra battery perhaps.

The zipper on the top can be zipped either way (which I like). There are cords on the zippers as well for easy grabbing. The "open" pockets on the outside are nice, and while they are 6" deep, there isn't much that has any value that I would store there . . . because the risk of it falling out would be too great. (At least for me . . . because I plan to sling the sling quite a bit). It is difficult to believe that the inside of this bag only has 2 very small pockets. Both pockets have flaps that velcro. One pocket is 4"d x 3"w and the other is 4"d x 2"w. While that seems like a lot . . . the pockets are sewn into the bag and some of that width is lost to the stitching. They are immediately adjacent to each other and immediately under the top zipper (not the most optimum place to be IMHO).

The strap is nice and sturdy and reminds me of my Nikon strap. What I also like is that instead of having the typical strap tightener (don't recall the technical term, but like a buckle), this strap has a cam lock buckle. It is a buckle clip that clips down with pressure on the strap. It will take you less time to adjust your strap, which might not be a big deal to some . . . if you don't adjust your strap very often. Loaded it down with approximately 12 pounds of equipment, slung it on my back and tested it by moving around for a while today . . . and it stayed put. Hopefully, it will do the same when in the field. Strap has 6" wide removable cushion that velcros into place. I will probably double that with another one to make it super comfy. I am 6'0" tall. With the strap over my left shoulder (and the bag sitting on my right hip) and the strap completely extended . . . the top of the bag (where it zips open), is approximately 25" vertically from my right shoulder.

Canvas feels heavyweight. It feels like it might be waxed (and therefore water resistant), but after a bit of due diligence, I cannot find anything that would confirm same. But, you could sling this over your shoulder under a rain jacket or poncho if necessary.

The color is just right for safari (bright colors, whites, greys and/or blacks are frowned upon). This is the main reason why I did not purchase the Passport II or III . . . no natural color choices.

I would describe myself as an intermediate amateur photographer and it has become my hobby in retirement. I live for nature action shots.

I am keeping this bag. I am going to cut off one side of the cushioned "cube" to make a cushioned "U". The open end of the "U" will face up. I will place the camera in the bag so that the cushioned U will cradle my large lens with my camera attached. While it doesn't hold as much as I would like . . . I liken it to a wristlet wallet. It holds exactly what I need at the time I need it. I will still have my camera backpack with me (to hold extra batteries, lenses and the like) and my hubby usually volunteers for carry duty - lucky me! I would like to have given it 5 stars . . . but I feel as though the design needs improvement (the II and III are about the same in size etc.). Unfortunately, this also seems to be the only true sling bag on the market. (My definition of sling is worn like a crossbody with the bag on your back instead of in front).

Look forward to breaking it in very soon.

You should see the device name pop up on your phone as Jabra Supreme, then a voice in your ear will say "connected" and you're set to go. Couldn't be simpler.
