I have to admit I am BEYOND impressed though I was skeptical at first. The speaker sits on a base for great acoustics and also charges quickly with USB. I now have the perfect speaker to carry with me when I am on the road and to enjoy when I am at home right in my bed! I cannot RECOMMEND this ENOUGH.

This speaker is so cool! It is aesthetically beautiful and adds a touch of elegance and zen to a space with ambient lighting and rich sound. I like to use it in my meditation room and love that I have a source of relaxing light from it that can be adjusted. The sound is 360 and fills the room beautifully. The bass is on the lighter side from what I've come to expect with Sony based on the other PARTY speakers I have, but I understand that this is for a more low-key vibe and I use it accordingly. I like to listen to chants, classical and jazz on it. I am very happy with the speaker though it is rather expensive. I recommend it but say wait for it to go on sale.

I am a big fan of the SRS series and this one is next level! The speaker is sort of heavy but when you hear the sound and that bass out of it you'll understand why. Superbly constructed and designed with a full sound that doesn't get distorted even at high volumes. It connects easily with Bluetooth and your devices and can absolutely be used as a sound bar in addition to a portable party with its lights and sound profiles! Something like this is an excellent buy because of the quality and longevity and you won't be disappointed at all!

This has made life much easier for me as I am able to use two monitors and connect everything to this one docking station. Super fast speeds with plenty of ports for monitors, projectors for presentations and flash drives, etc. Given the workload that has somehow increased for me, being able to stay connected and efficient makes the longer days run smoothly. This docking station is on the pricier side but it is a sound investment for your work and the return is instant!

This works very well and has impressive transfer speeds with lots of ports required to do serious home office computing at any level. The price is great for the amount of speed and power you get and it is simple to use - plug and play and PRODUCE!

I got these for my son, who wanted a pair that he can take out while doing outdoor activities and errand running for the times he doesn't want to use earburds, nor have a super expensive pair that he might lose. The sound quality is great and the battery life is wonderful too. The noise cancellation works very well and the headphones have a plush and comfortable fit. We put these up there with other well known name brands but at a great price!

This is my second pair of Jabras and definitely the most costly. But for their high end price, they have all of the features and qualities that make such a purchase a solid one instead of a regret. The fit is perfect with a soft cushion against the ears which also fills the canals with INCREDIBLE sound. I was startled by the sheer amount of bass! The noise cancellation is extremely effective and for such a small pair of buds they double as ear plugs because of it! Phone calls for that reason are extremely clear but adjust the background settings so outside noises aren't picked up. This is a true pair of sports earbuds and richly designed with all you need to get the most out of them. A great buy.

These ear buds are awesome! I usually don't like wearing earbuds because I prefer cans but of course I need something more subtle for awareness sake and for when I am making calls or in meetings. The sound quality is excellent for both music and phone calls with a surprising amount of bass and very clear audio. The setup and pairing was super easy and the noise cancellation is perfect. These are a very reasonably priced pair with all of the quality and function of pricier brands and with the colorful options, much more attractive too.

Each release gets better and we LOVE this system! Video is crystal clear as well as sound with much less lagging. Setup was extremely easy and we love the alerts that give us an extra sense of security even when we're not home. The local storage is especially convenient and we are very happy with it overall. Home security is priceless at times like this and you're getting more than your money's worth for peace of mind.

This is the best of them yet! I received a gold Darci watch and noticed how much faster it was to set up right away; the previous model took upwards of 15 minutes and this took less than three? The face is big and beautiful and I am a little worried about keeping it in its mint condition so I take it off when I get home so I don't ding it while carrying things around the house, etc. The display is dazzling and I like the way you can switch faces. The watch takes you through a tutorial after set up and you really won't need to use it again. My favorite new features are the improved and expanded health apps/widgets like Cardiogram and Google Fit, which now has a breathing exercise included! I felt it wonderful to be able to unwind WITH the watch before taking it off. I find those more useful than the GPay features, though contactless payments are also a bonus in these times.

The watch comes with a start guide, warranty info, and charging cable, all beautifully packaged. The audio is very clear and works well when making/taking calls within decent range of your phone. This is a beautiful gift or present to spoil yourself with!

Sennheiser has a wonderful range of headphones from studio-quality to sports, and these headphones have the same lush sound sound as a pair of their high-end cans but pared down to earbud size and for those on the go who don't want to skimp on quality.

The calls and pairing was simple, clear and crisp and nice bass as well. I like to wear these on my morning and afternoon runs and the price for these is excellent.

These are great for working out and they are very comfortable. The price is amazing for the quality of sound that you get and they are easy to set up and pair with excellent call clarity as well. Earbuds can cost upwards of several hundred dollars and these are an excellent entry level pair for someone who wants quality, great price and comfort.

If I were to trust a pair of headphones released by musician, Carlos Santana would definitely be at the top of that list and here we have an affordable pair that brings through all the necessary musical range of notes and sounds. They are beautifully designed, fit well and sound absolutely amazing. I like to wear these when I am out and about and get many compliments on them.

You really can't go wrong with Sony and their headphones; even their most budget pair has impressive sound and these are phenomenal with deep, rich bass and crystal clear mids and highs. The noise cancellation is excellent, as is the price. These pair easily and are very comfortable. No need to spend hundreds on a pair of cans, get these instead!

I love that this is a stand-alone unit and was so easy to set up. The picture quality is excellent as well as the audio and the motion detection/light works perfectly too. It is a VERY good idea to have some sort of security system in these times no matter how small your unit and we got this for our sister who lives alone in the city. It is cost-effective and worth every penny.

When I say I carried the XB41 everywhere, I do mean EVERYWHERE and my son would always try to take it. Now I have given him that one because this baby is even better, which is hard to believe. The bass is SO powerful and the sound overall is resonant and rich. Even if I'm watching a movie on my laptop, I pair it to this and it has a variety of uses - mediation for the more serene vibe, pounding house music for a party vibe. It does it all and all you have to do is take it out the box, pair it and get to rockin. It's on the bigger side but still remains very portable and it is the perfect gift for ANYONE, especially yourself!

Don't be fooled by the small size of this speaker for it packs quite a punch in sound from punch bass to crisp highs and mids. The brand is top quality and the same applies here. Phone calls are also super clear and the speaker itself is easy to pair and operate. It's the perfect outdoor companion or indoor booster to a zen space. I use it for both hiking and meditation and I love it!

Cause that's what it has felt like ever since we set this bad boy up, which was a cinch right out of the box with the Android apps. Upon unboxing, the first thing we marveled at was how slim yet massive the set was; the broad display but sleek and serious. The picture quality is transcendent and the sound is RICH! We have this set up with a Bang & Olufsen sound bar that adds to the cinematic experience. The little bit of gaming our son has done (he's not allowed to touch this, LOL) has been jaw-dropping with the graphics - it's like he is recreating the lost football and basketball games right at home with his favorites. This is the first time we've owned an OLED and we can see how that bumps up the price tag in a major way, but considering that we have been and will probably CONTINUE to be homebound for a least a few months, it is the best way to upgrade your living space, your entertainment and your LIFE!

Since it looks like many students will have to adjust to remote learning for at least the beginning of the school year next month, I got this for my nephew who is in the 8th grade. It is perfect for his needs (word processing, online assignments, some gaming here and there) and comes with all the apps he needs for education and entertainment. The speed is decent enough even with streaming and the storage is sufficient for the work he has to do that isn't stored in a data cloud. Battery life is nice and it has a good amount of ports for flash drives, etc. What is best about this laptop is the PRICE! If you have school-aged children, this is the laptop that is an excellent buy for them for its low cost but high performance and I definitely recommend it.

That's how I'm feeling after I just took of these headphones and came back down to earth. What a blissful experience, starting with the unboxing! I was surprised at how the headphones came in what looked like a hat box, then opened it up to reveal a beautiful round case and the headphones nestled gently inside, smelling so plush and looking and feeling even plusher. These are some BIG cans and they are very comfortable. They are for people who like to be immersed in sound and that is exactly the experience you will have.

There is a start-up guide tucked into the bottom of the box, and the charger, headphone jack and warranty/user info is inside the case and fastened with Velcro. Turning the headphones on, I was pleased to see they were already charged to 79% and they are ready to pair as soon as you turn them on.

I evaluated this several ways - I started off with the movie Angel Has Fallen because I LOVE the scoring on that film, especially the beginning; the rich orchestra and drums sounded magnificent in these. Then I turned to Aretha Franklin - live, singing "Mary, Don't You Weep" and had TEARS running down my eyes by the time the song was done. It felt like I was front and center at that church that morning and it was everything my spirit needed.

I switched things up even more by exploring the Amazon Music Re:Discover pages with 80's hip hop, Beyonce, and even 80's hair metal! I followed that by exploring Amazon's wonderfully curated lists of new artists in different categories and these headphones performed beautifully across all genres.

There is a Shure app that provides further EQ customization and the noise cancellation works SO well that I couldn't even hear the fan I had on at the highest speed during my testing. The bass is rich and punchy, the highs and mids supremely resonant. I'm telling you, you will be LOST in these and have to come back to yourself when you take them off. I am sooooo so happy with these and feel they are worth the price tag. The case is on the bigger side to be sure, but they are worth the space they take up in a backpack or briefcase, because you definitely want to keep these in the case - and take them with you everywhere.

INCREDIBLE.

This is a sizable and super affordable speaker from Altec Lansing that has truly wowed me. It is portable with a handle on top or you can make it stand. The outlet is protected in the back with a seal that you can open and close when using in or near water, but sitting it poolside is more than enough to me.

I tested it with just about every genre - hip hop, dance, classical, and even some Coltrane and the sound was crisp and clear with a punchy bass. I love speakers - I also have a Sony SRS-XB41 and this is right on that level, but even bigger and costs less, I think it can be compared to their party speaker. I love the lighting on this and the ways to play with it. The speaker also comes with decals and is neatly packaged with a start guide and power cord. I am truly going to enjoy using it this summer.

This is a great purchase for someone who doesn't want to spend TOO much on a bluetooth speaker but still wants quality sound, design and fun. Check it out!

I hadn't heard of this brand before, but loved the way they looked so I got them for hubby to try. He is very very happy with them! He usually has a pair of headphones for home and office and these have replaced his office pair because of the clear sound with phone calls that easily transfers to immersive sound with music. The headphones are controlled by touching the side of them and he likes that he doesn't have to fiddle with his phone or device in order to switch functions. Noise cancellation is excellent. These are phenomenally priced but rank right up there with more popular models that cost at least a hundred dollars more!

Out of the box, these speakers are so cool! I love that I can spread them through a room for the surround sound and immersive experience. They charge as a unit or separately and are really fun to experiment with. The concept is fun and the sound delivers in certain genres, but on bass-heavy genres like club or hip hop they leave a little more to be desired. That said, I like to use these in my meditation room for chants and mantras so they perform well for me.

Hubby has been wearing these nearly every day since quarantine began and is so impressed with them! Since we've been homebound for a few months, these have helped him enjoy running and long walks during quarantine and he can go a few days without having to recharge them. He says they are very comfortable and what he likes most is the BASS they provide for such a small earbud. As an old school hip hop and jazz fan, he loves that the size doesn't compromise the quality of the sound. These earbuds are an investment but a very much worthwhile one and the price is reasonable.

While these speakers are small, the sound they emit is startling! I have them in my home office and love being able to immerse myself in the rich bass of Village Vanguard jazz sets or soulful mantras as I power through my day. The speaker is lightweight and can be set up anywhere in a room to fill it with gorgeous sound. The wood gives it a classier appearance and that is part of its appeal to audiophiles - looks do matter here! To be so compact, they are nearly as powerful as the larger stack model and would be a wonderful enhancement to any room or sound system already in place.

These Sennheisers are an attractive pair of earbuds that are way more powerful than they look! The stark white design is a welcome change from the black that is everywhere, so they stand out in both appearance and function. I like to use these when I am working on documents and contracts but want some calm music playing. The earbuds fit comfortably and they sound clear on phone calls and lovely on any type of music, though obviously you want a pair of cans for solid bass performance. All in all, these are a wonderful pair at a great price.

Since we have been spending more time at home and out of the office, I kept this in my office at work just to make sure things were secure and I like that I can monitor it from my phone and interact with anyone in the room whether they are supposed to be there or not. I was able to have another broker gather the things I needed by pointing out exactly where they were as well, which was pretty funny. This is not a hidden camera set-up, so it works best if you live alone or WANT someone to know they're being recorded but hopefully reasons for use are benign. Whatever the reason, you will not be disappointed because the graphics, ease of use and audio clarity is excellent.

We have had such fun with this speaker since home entertainment is pretty much all we've been able to do. The sound is OUT of this world. For it to be such a relatively "small" speaker, the rich, thumping bass is up there with extremely high end brands that cost close to a thousand dollars. We love using this in the yard while cooking out or simply enjoying evening cocktails with something as elegant as jazz or classical music playing. The size is small enough to be portable but big enough to blow you away no matter which genre you play it on. It pairs and plays effortlessly and while geared toward a younger party crowd, anyone would absolutely love it. I've stolen it from my son and he is NOT getting it back. LOL

My husband wears these when he is in the den working on projects or lounging in the backyard and he says the ANC works wonderfully because he can't hear me calling for him. LOL Out of the box, the first thing you notice is the sleek design and they fit comfortably with lush padding. He says the sound is very rich and likes listening to jazz with them on for the range of depth they provide. I would compare these to the Sony WXH headphones in terms of quality and price and this is a solid pair for the audiophile who wants a beautiful pair of headphones that don't cost a fortune.

This Viewsonic projector has the features and quality of the ones that are upward of a thousand dollars, so let me start with that: the price enough is so attractive that you will be more than willing to give it a shot.

Since our family has been home for the past few months and it has been warmer out, we have set this up in the backyard for movie nights and begin adding neighbors when things calmed down a bit. It has truly helped us restore our sanity at such a difficult time.

We are using a 120-inch screen and the picture quality is stunning, true HD at 1080p. The audio coming out of such a small projector is VERY crisp, loud and clear and we were really surprised by that! It has plenty of ports for whatever format you are using and the remote is also very easy to use and get comfortable with. We love that we can bring the Firestick out to the backyard and relax, grill and have a few drinks before settling in for a movie of our choice. Setup is practically nonexistent it is so easy and the connection is always stable. The projector is light weight and very portable so it will be coming with us when we do some light travel within the US this summer at camp sites, etc just to get out of the house.

This is a beautiful speaker that fits well into any home decor; my son has it in his room and it is so loud that we often have to tell him to turn it down some at night. The wood combines with the speaker to give it a deep, warm sound and it has rumbling bass, and crisp highs and mids. The price is excellent for the quality of sound that you receive and setting it up is very easy. He loves it for gaming and movies since he's been stuck in his room these past few months.

My son has been using this to finish up his interrupted year at school, recording important parts of conference calls and lectures so he has the important parts of each session handy for reference. The audio quality is excellent and he likes that he can store them on his computer or transfer them to his phone. It has helped bridge the gap between video and in person education during this time and at the price, it is worth it. He will probably have to use it well into the fall and it is a worthy purchase for anyone who is dealing with this uncertainty or has regular interviews, etc to record and transcribe.

I use these for both entertainment and studio/voiceover work and they are amazing. They deliver rich, lush sound and clarity through all genres of music. They fit very comfortably and the battery life is phenomenal too - I can take these out with me for hours and barely lose a "bar". The ANC works very well as I can use these on a city street and still be immersed in sound with no distraction. These are truly high-end studio headphones but without the staggering price of most. I highly recommend them.

You know you're in for something special just by looking at the beautiful packaging of this product, which lays out its professional accolades and unparalleled features. I don't think I've seen headphones so beautifully packaged before and that needed its own compliment. But the buds themselves are extraordinary. Clearly designed for musicians and serious studio work, they are built for long sessions and deep listening but very comfortable and easy to adjust for the perfect fit. I was amazed by the levels of depth and clarity I was able to experience with such a tiny pair and use them all the time when I don't want to have my big cans on. For the price they are an excellent buy.

I also have the Bluesound Pulse and love that I can have music playing throughout my home, sounding heavenly, because of the quality of the speaker. This is one the smaller and but don't be fooled by its size. I am able to enjoy the array of clear highs and mids and an almost velvety smooth bass when I am listening to jazz, which ramps up to the punchier end when I am listening to house, R&B or hip hop. It connects easily and is simple to operate. The price has dropped some too which makes it even more of a great deal.

I wanted to try these because although I am a "big can" person, the smaller earbuds do have their appeal in different settings and circumstances. I really was impressed by the sound that came from these, clear with resonant bass, for them to be so small! The competitor's price for their new buds at $250 is just way too much to pay when something like these exist and work just as well. I highly recommend them.

Already a leader in the security business, Arlo gives parents peace of mind with this low-cost baby monitor that pairs to the rest of the devices in the home. My niece has this in her nursery and my brother really enjoys being able to monitor her without having to enter the room if she's sleeping or falling asleep (!) or calming her if she just needs to hear the sound of his voice to FALL asleep. The other features come in handy as well, especially being able to control everything from the app and even play lullabies. He experienced a bit of a delay at times but overall he says the monitor is a wonderful purchase for new parents.

I have a 5050 Epson UB in my living room that I love beyond words, so when this became available I was thrilled to be able to get it for my son so I could have my living room BACK. This is a perfectly priced model that delivers an impressive picture, resolution and sound without the serious investment of a bigger model like the 5050. It is also very portable, weighing in at just about ten pounds or so, so it can go from the living room to the backyard or to a party for movies, gaming and more. He loves the native apps like Netflix (when he's not gaming, he's watching that) and how he can quickly adjust it for viewing styles (aiming it toward the ceiling for lazy movie sessions), whereas ours in the living room is mounted. The picture quality is excellent and we're amazed that such big, booming sound comes out such a small unit. Had I not gotten the 5050, I certainly would have considered this as a suitable purchase for the family room and I love that such affordable and HIGH QUALITY alternatives exist. An EXCELLENT purchase.

My son likes to use this speaker a lot and carries it in his backpack so he can have his favorite music playing when he's working out outside. The audio quality is fantastic and he plays music off his phone. He listens to a lot of bass-heavy songs so I was wondering how that would measure up for him and we both found it to be very impressive for the price. This is a wonderfully affordable speaker that is worth having.

We are working on a docu-series and shot our pilot not too long ago. I noticed the camera guys had a hard yellow case for his equipment that seem cumbersome to lug around, so I got this for him and he has been delighted with it. There is plenty of storage and ways to arrange it specifically to what equipment you are using and it is all protected; the wheels make it easy to transport; the material is of top-notch quality and easy to keep clean even as it is hauled on flights. This is an excellent investment in your tools of the trade.

We used this on our vacation to Curacao where we spent most of our time in the water and this was used to document almost every second. The camera is soooo easy to use and while you worry about such an expensive piece of equipment in the water, it worked with NO problems. We didn't test the literal waters as far as depth range but it was perfect for snorkeling and jet skiing and we got footage that truly made us live our vacation all over again. That in itself is priceless, and I am going to order the pocket cam for my son so he has his own!

I haven't used BluRay because I do a lot of streaming and it hadn't really made sense to get a machine, but this has changed the game for me. We set this up in our bedroom, hooked up to a Panasonic receiver and have been absolutely wowed by the picture quality, ease of use and the sound that rings out in partnership with our system. The price cannot be beat as well; at the time of this review the price has dropped a hundred bucks so I can't think of a reason why one would NOT get it. I look forward to buying my favorite movies on BluRay now so I can enjoy them the way they're meant to be enjoyed once they leave the theater, fancy projectors aside. This is a marvelous addition to home entertainment.

I like to have this in the bathroom while I'm taking a nice, long soak and don't have to do anything but enjoy the nice classical music that fills the room. Sometimes we become too addicted to high tech gadgets that a return to simpler things like this radio are enough to buoy the spirit! The retro design is fun to look at and all you have to do is turn the dial to your preferred station and enjoy. The reception is great and so is the sound. Treat yourself or anyone else to this radio and you will love it for sure!

This looks so nice with my new Master & Dynamic headphones and give my home office studio a professional look with minimal space required. The construction is durable and most importantly, protects a very expensive piece of equipment by displaying them so elegantly! A must-have for audiophiles.

These are definitely the most attractive and all-around handsome pair of headphones I own; they LOOK as exquisite as they sound! I have several "high end" pairs and these are a new favorite because of the design and RICH sound that rings through your ears as soon as you put them on. I've found a few burn-in tracks on YouTube just so I can get the full resonance out of them quicker because I'm of the school that it really DOES make a difference. The cups are soft and super comfortable, plush padding and double as verrrry expensive earmuffs that bring music down from the heavens! The bass is punchy and deep; the mids and highs are also crystal clear, which is what you should expect for paying for a unit such as these. Phone calls are clear and pairing was tap and go. I think these will last for years and if you were to justify the expense by calculating the days worn (EVERY! ONE!) then you could change your life for just thirty cents a day. LOL What are you waiting for?!

I was so excited to receive this; the first mic I bought years ago (2012) was a Yeti that I still have and it still works, but these upgrades make the Yeti X ready for this next level of technology in podcasting, gaming, streaming, etc. Being able to control volume on the mic is worth the upgrade alone and the sound has also only gotten better. I use this for voice over work and podcasts and have not been disappointed yet!

This is my first pair of Shure headphones and boy was I ever impressed! I wore them on a three-hour plane ride and they are truly noise cancelling and fit me so well. For them to be in-ear, the bass is astonishing and I love how the buds truly mold with your ear for maximum comfort. Call quality and battery life is excellent. I will be using these on my trips from now on.

I have a few other Bluetooth speakers and this Sonos Move is the smallest but somehow it is almost the LOUDEST and the sound is soooo rich, deep and warm and ugh, SEDUCTIVE, that anything you play on it will sound like it is being performed right in front of you or like you are wrapped in a magical cloak whose fibers vibrate with music once you put it on. Yes, it is that serious. Because it is actually called MOVE, we wanted to test it in and out of the house and these nice days led to some awesome afternoon grilling sessions where we enjoyed every track we played from jazz to deep house. We haven't tested it in rain but there will be plenty of that this week. Setting this up is a cinch and Alexa works flawlessly. For this price point, you are going to be truly blown away by the quality and the sound so keep that volume respectable!

My son loves these! Since he listens to a lot of bass-heavy music, I thought these would be a good fit for him and they are. He says they fit comfortably, the bass is deep, rich and clear and they also look great. These are a good value and would be great for those who don't want or need to spend a lot of money on a decent pair.

I keep this in my briefcase when I am visiting the satellite offices because there is always more work to bring home. This hub is fast because of the data transfer speed, easy to set up and I can use most any office equipment with it. A must have in today's mobile work environment.

The face in question here is that of this beautiful new watch and what has finally happened is that it now has a SPEAKER!!!! Two years ago, I bought hubby the Michael Kors Grayson men's smart watch for his birthday and he loved to gloat about how he could answer calls and talk on his WATCH, watch videos with loud, clear audio, and then some and all I could do was pout and wonder when this same feature would be available for women.

That is THE BEST and most important part of this upgrade for the new fall line. The rest of features are present but I am going to yammer about this because I can't believe it took so long for them to add. Paying with your watch is true space-age pimping, and tracking your fitness is fun! Customized faces, settings, alarms, and menus truly make it your own and you can change it to style, whim and mood.

Besides the kick-ass speaker, there design of this watch is beautiful!!!! Both silver and rose gold make it stand out and this is a great casual watch, formal watch, a watch you can't live without!

It seems like the biggest issue our family has with getting out the door on time in the morning is finding keys and devices! You know how that goes - you come in from taking the garbage out, walking the dog, running an errand, etc and set your keys down with the rest of your stuff or absentmindedly put them in a drawer, etc and then forget where they are! I hadn't heard of Tile before receiving these but am so glad it exists. It was very easy to set up/pair them through the app, and my set came with the instructions to pair with the latest Pro version in the app. The range is excellent for somewhere within a home and the device is LOUD (!) so you will be able to find whatever you've waylaid instantly. I might have to order another set for the tablets!! For a pack of four this is a great value and more than enough for a small family to get the most use out of.

I gave this to my son who is in college and this lightweight notebook is perfect for him because it is inexpensive yet works very well. 64 GB is the perfect amount of space for someone who mainly uses word processing and other programs that don't gobble up storage and memory and the display is sharp and clear. I like that it comes with 365 but with the price you pay (so low!) for this notebook, it is worth purchasing the student edition so there are no mishaps with papers not being saved, etc.

This notebook is incredibly light and he really likes the cool black color that makes it stand out from the typical drab gray that notebooks usually come in. Because it is only 4 GB of RAM, it isn't the fastest machine in the world but for simple computing it is more than sufficient. A student would love this, so would a frequent traveler who can work from a cloud, etc that doesn't need all the bells and whistles. I am considering purchasing another for my nephew depending on how that first report card looks because it is that great of a deal!

I tried these out for the times when I am running around the city and don't want to wear my more expensive headphones. These work very well, the sound is clear and a nice deep bass for the price point.
This works perfectly for my a/v equipment whether I am using television or projector and is does not compromise the quality in any way. Highly recommend.

I gave these to my son because his other pair got stolen, and he really likes them and says they provide decent sound and comfort. They won't compare to the higher end headphones but the bass which he likes is decent and the remote and mic make it easier for him to operate them while on the go. These are a good pair of commuting headphones as well.

This is a pretty decent field monitor at this price and is best for beginners who don't and can't spend a lot of money on equipment as they learn the trade. I have been using it at the harbor to document fishing and boating events since those shots are more forgiving and have had much success with it after some trial and error.

That's pretty much what this speaker does the moment you turn it on. It sounds INCREDIBLE no matter what you play on it and I ran the whole gamut: The Heavyweight Champion by John Coltrane; Coachella Live by Beyonce; The Wall by Pink Floyd; Global Underground: London by Danny Tenaglia; and the Edith Piaf collection.

My music tastes run wide and no matter what I put on I felt like I was almost right on stage with the artist. The sound is so clear and heavenly! The two tweeters add that extra resonance and the bass is warm and low and DEEP. That said, because of its deceptively small size, you might not understand just what this baby is capable of until you try it out. And then you'll be amazed that you got away with paying THAT little for it!!!!

I finally reorganized my home office and set this up and am just amazed by how beautiful the large screen is, how stunning the resolution and clarity and how well it performs. I have a Lenovo desktop and I love having this size screen now because I am able to multi-task even better. It is easy to tinker with the settings and get contrast, brightness, etc just to your liking or adjust them as needed and I think the price is excellent for a monitor of this size. It's awesome for gaming too!

We used this in the pool and at the lake over the holiday weekend and we were surprised at how much sound this lil baby kicks out! I'm not used to electronics in water because it goes against everything we have previously been taught, but this speaker is a fun way to have the music going right beside you and not having to get out of the water to change the volume, etc. The speakers have a very nice sound for its purpose. This is a great accessory for summer fun!

My husband thinks these headphones are fantastic with impressive battery life, design, and sound. He wears them on a long shift and only has to recharge them during breaks. They fit well in his ears with no discomfort and he loves that they can fit right into his pants pocket and be discreetly removed during important conversations (except with me). For the price, this is a solid pair of headphones for any activity that will deliver on quality.

We installed this because as the weather breaks, a certain unsavory element tends to come out looking for trouble. My grandmother lives in a very nice neighborhood, and that may be part of the "problem", however we needed upgraded security for her and this camera system has done the job. We love that there is a two-way audio so she can communicate with people at the door, but the best feature is the sensor and spotlight that lets people KNOW that they are being watched so don't even bother. The installation was pretty smooth, though the camera itself, while giving great quality, was sometimes patchy. We have been experimenting with placement and connection to ensure a steady stream but otherwise this is a wonderful system for protecting the people you love the most.

Besides the great quality of the sound for a pair of in-ear headphones, the coolest thing about these is how easy the app is to use for customization. Because of this, you only have to slide these in your ears and go, and get yourself to optimal listening level without even breaking your stride.

These are probably the last words that come to mind when thinking of a laptop, but this Ultrabook earns its name and then some in every way, because anyone who sees you using this will be BESIDE themselves, and I mean SICK, with Envy. This thang is FIYAH!!!!!!!!!!

Let's start with the unboxing: it arrives in a sleek, black box with a beautiful photo of the laptop on its cover, and when you open it, you are awed by the pristine, silver gleaming contraption inside. When you pick it up and gently unwrap it from its plastic film, you are wowed by how both light and elegant it is in your hands; how something so small can contain your life, and then you can't wait to start filling it up with it. You open the lid and lift the mesh cover protecting the keys; you notice the setup leaflet and take out the power cord, plug her in and turn her on.

From there, Cortana takes over, guiding you through the setup! By voice command! Very Jason Bourne. You set up your fingerprint log in, sign in to your accounts and then once everything is registered, off into the wild wild web you go. The first thing you'll notice is how FAST this baby is, the gentle whir of the machine as she takes you off to the farthest reaches of the world if you check out the 4K resolution by looking at the Planet Earth series. It's enough to bring tears to your eyes. You'll be mesmerized by the rhythmic clicking of the keys as you go to your favorite websites and download/install your must-have apps and programs; you will find yourself looking down at the keyboard and smiling as if you've been enchanted by a new lover, and you HAVE!

I had been looking for a new computer because I've got this ollllld slooooooooow, 4GB RAM dinosaur of an 15" laptop that I bought used in a dire emergency because I accidentally cracked the screen on my Toshiba. The "Gorilla glass" on this is so beautiful that I don't even want to TOUCH it, even though the touch screen is flawless, like you are on a tablet.

The keyboard is perfectly sized and responsive; there is just so much here for me to continue to explore but I am damn near breathless as I write this review because it is simply that exceptional, stunning. I have had some graphic design programs that I wanted to use but was waiting until I got something new so it would have the capacity to rock out, and I can't wait to get started. Where this HAS been incredible for me is Traktor and music programs. No more worrying about lag and staticky mixing because of system overload. This has all the memory and SSD space that you will need, and its ports will more than accommodate any other gadgets you need to connect to it. The sound is exemplary, with the Bang & Olufsen speakers.

This is the Ultrabook that every entrepreneur or very lucky student should have; it is the answer and perhaps even a juggernaut to the Macbook. I've certainly learned that just one POWERFUL Ultrabook is WORTH the investment rather than having to replace a tired ass notebook every few years. I prefer large screens so 13 inches has never appealed to me, but this right here has ROCKED. MY. WORLD. I don't wanna go anywhere without it, not even the shower. LOL

You have just got to see for yourself.

For the price, this is a very nice projector that is good for outdoor movie night and gaming, etc on the simpler side; I have a high end model so there is a vast difference, which is why this is in the kids' room. The sound and picture quality is very good and overall this is a fine lil setup for basic activities that won't break the bank but entertain you quite well.

I was not expecting much from these little tiny earbuds aside from a way to listen to my music when I need to be more aware of my surroundings and just want to block out the idiots on the subway, but when I actually checked them out I was SHOCKED by how good and LOUD these lil babies are! Great bass, great depth and detail in the sound for such a low, low price. These will remain in my purse when I don't want to wear the big cans. I LOVE them.

I love these and my only wish is that they were a bit louder, otherwise they are AMAZING at this price point. I watched a documentary I'd seen several times before and was able to hear conversations I didn't know existed; the richness of the sound and extra bass are TRULY impressive. I am just glad that I can adjust the volume on my own through music software directly but these are AWESOME. I had them on all night without even realizing it and when I picked them up today, the battery was still almost full. You probably won't find a better pair of headphones at this price.

For starters, this is a gorgeous unit, but combined with its functionality it is in a league of its own. It is not the quietest, but it makes up for it in the amount of power and TIME you are able to freely commit to serious gaming. I have not seen anything like this before and my son has been going crazy over it! This is a great investment for gaming bliss.

I got these for my man because he works super long hours and compared to the other ones he has tried, these are his favorite. They fit comfortably and hold a TRUE long charge as advertised. He says the sound is clear with no distortion and he wears them for up to ten hours each day to make the time go by faster while working. He is really enjoying them!

Very happy happy with this docking station as I am using it for two laptops and a desktop at various times. Connection is simple and able to keep up with all my processing tasks. This is a sound investment for the techie or someone who has a lot of data to transfer and not a lot of time to waste!

For me it was 2012, December. Picture it: Amazon has the sexy red over-ear V-Moda Crossfades as deal of the day for only 80 bucks. I couldn't resist and have been a convert ever since. These are for the sporty type but they do not compromise on sound and especially not that bass! I like my head to rattle and while ear cans are best suited for that, these give such pleasurable sensation and sound while you're on the go and working that body! Lightweight, extremely portable and UNPARALLELED. V-Moda is and always will be my first love.

If you are a hardcore audiophile then you will find these a little too simplistic in sound for your liking, but will appreciate the sound QUALITY in terms of bass and the comfort of your music as it tunes out everything else. I would look at the headphones in the 50-60 dollar price range in that case. Otherwise, these are pretty good for your morning commute and workouts! They are comfortably worn over the ears and the noise cancellation is okay. With these, depending on what you're looking for you should either shop around and splurge or purchase these with its restrictions in mind.

These fit so comfortably in the ears and the sound quality is incredible. Phone calls are clear, music is booming with lots of bass. Did I mention how comfortable they are? Like a little suction or vacuum blocking the rest of the world out. They also deliver sound as much as you receive it; be careful on phone calls in noisy places because the person you are speaking to may have a hard time hearing you. Other than that, this is a quality set for a VERY good price!

My friend is really happy with this unit; I got it for him because is does quite a few delivery services like Door Dash, Uber, etc and needs the navigation on the road AND his phone to effectively do his job, plus he likes to use YouTube for music. With this awesome stereo, he can do all that and more! The video quality is wonderful and the sound is great too. It is not an easy install, but I keep the five stars because it is truly a valuable unit for all that it does. Get some help from a mechanic or car freak friend and you should have no problem; the additional parts you have to purchase for it are not expensive and take nothing away from all that you are being GIVEN! I have never heard of this brand and I am impressed more and more with these new electronics companies jumping into the game and making a splash. Nicely done!

I was a little skeptical about this item when it appeared in my queue until I saw the dozens of reviews attesting to its awesomeness, and I have to chime in and agree. Off-brand electronics can be hit or miss, but this one is a BANGER! It pairs quickly and easily when turned on and as a househead, my first test is the BASS. I threw on one of my favorite podcasts and was wowed by the range and clarity that this speaker emits with no distortion!

Also a HUGE plus is the rugged design and the handle, making it truly portable and lightweight. I won't be using this for camping, but it would be great in the outdoors and the design of the speakers themselves are really cool. I say worth it!!!!

Love this tripod and how I am able to use it with both my cellphone and camera! It is extremely durable and will protect your precious equipment, no matter which medium you use to capture your art and videos. I also like how flexible and sturdy it is without being cheaply constructed. Nature shots are a breeze, and this is perfect for the gorgeous fall foliage we are being blessed with. I don't have a GoPro so I can't speak on that but the other attachments are awesome. Excellent price point and value makes it a true must-have for those trying out new things with their cameras!

I really need to begin this review by stating that I am not much of a television watcher - up until this beast was delivered to me a few days ago, and I wanted to sit and experience it before I weighed in. There is not going to be a whole bunch of technical spiel simply because I don't know much about the mighty specs that make this thing cost a fortune, however, when I sit in front of it, I am TRANSFIXED.

I have to tear myself away from the stunning visuals, of which I tested from the mundane to my absolute favorites: regular television shows to the ones that make this a movie theater in your home - watching American Beauty WITH the commentary on so I can be ensorcelled by the teachable moments in cinematography, geeking out on Planet Earth, almost feeling the waves of water, the majestic mountains at your lap, the vivid plumage and wrinkles of parrots and elephants. The elegant clouds soaring through the sky, the dust whirling around in the desert. I am just blown away by how much these images are brought to life with the 4K HD capabilities, and for a TV at this price point the sound BETTER be amazing, which it is. Netflix and Chill will never be the same.

I come home, turn this thing on and feel like Red when he is gliding across the water to meet his dear Andy Dufresne in Shawshank Redemption. I feel like Shug Avery when her father finally welcomes her into the church with open arms. LOL!

There are smart TVs and in this case, this is a genius - once you take it out of the cocoon of careful packaging and set it up, all you have to do is enjoy your apps and Smart Home features like Alexa. Screen mirroring means you can play media right from your phone. Add the Firestick and access any show pretty much from the beginning of time. HDMI connection is a breeze. Football fans will be BLOWN AWAY by the picture quality too, as with any sport.

I don't have anything bad to say - only that I am sad that this thing is SO expensive. So to that end, WATCH OUT for generous discounts as the holidays approach. And even on sale, this TV is so damn incredible that you simply won't have to buy another one for years. Put that way, this is worth three dollars a day over the course of those years for something you will not ever experience elsewhere from Sony's top of the line. This Master's series is truly masterful.

I was fortunate enough in that this model worked perfectly for me right out of the box and was astonished to read about the other viewer's experience, and do hope that this review of a WORKING model will help. I'm looking at the cheaper Sony models for a television for my bedroom and will be watching those sales myself. I'm so thankful to have been able to receive this because I am turned on AND plugged in in a way that I really had no idea was possible!

How do you pronounce this name and where did this company come from? Neither will matter when you unbox and take a gander at the beautiful ebony wood grain sound bar with its classic, authentic VW panel inside. I am smitten by the design and enraptured by the sound.

Having a chance to evaluate these innovative and simply amazing products has truly given me lessons on branding because we go with what is familiar, and though this right here sounds CRAZY, the satisfaction you will get from this sound bar is even crazier. The craftsmanship. The beautiful bass. The clear reception and antique CD player. Contemporary bluetooth flow, phone calls, and sassy Siri. LOL People are prepared to drop a few hundred dollars more on a Bose or thousands more on a Bang, but this system BANGS and incredibly exceeds all expectations. Set up is simple and the remote means you don't have to lift more than a finger to switch things up. If you are looking to upgrade your audio system AND home theater, this is a sure bet. Kudos to this company for creating something truly priceless!

This is a phenomenal security system and the resolution/clarity is damn near movie-quality, if watching deer in your backyard is your thing. Admittedly, it is a bit of a painstaking process to set up, but if you follow the steps and take your time, it will all go well. The three cameras are perfect for the front, back and side of your home or business and the alerts you receive will make you feel like most of the work is being done for you once they're installed. The night quality is impressive too!

These days, there are few homes or businesses without some sort of security system, and that's a good thing. If you are looking for one that isn't going to cost a fortune but has stellar quality, this is where you want to place your confidence. No extra bills with a contract, plenty of storage space on the hard drive, and able to check in on your most prized asset from anywhere on your phone.

This is a security system that truly lives up to its name!

Is that what AKG stands for? If not then it should? I'll admit, this is another brand that I was not familiar with before I saw these and decided to check them out, but I'm glad that I did. Everything from the packaging and construction - right down to the exact measurements to where and how they fit on your head - to the sound is truly well designed and beautiful. They feel soooo good on the ears and are so damn pretty to behold!

They paired right with my iPod and phone and I like the fact that they pause when you take them off. No fumbling around with the buttons on the headphones to try to remember exactly where to push and press. You can forward your tracks with a gentle nudge, pause with a slight touch, switch them off with a slide. Walking alone late at night but still want the company of your music? Change it to ambient setting by pressing a discreet button on the right.

I wanted to looooooooove them, and I pretty much do, but I was sort of underwhelmed by the volume. I am the sort that becomes FURIOUS when reminded by my stupid phone that "listening to music at loud levels impairs hearing". I KNOW THAT, TURN IT UP TO 15!!!!!!!!!! LOL

I desperately went through my settings, wondering if there was something I was doing wrong, but no - perhaps in the interest of knowing just the right level needed to enjoy it WITHOUT damaging the eardrum, these beautiful headphones max out right below my preference. However, maybe that's not such a bad thing. The bass still comes through - POWERFULLY. You know who to listen to for a total experience of the sound these have to offer? M.I.A. !!! With her wild vibe and multicultural, interdimensional flavor, you will hear all the notes and instruments this world has to offer, and hear it beautifully.

All in all, these are gorgeous. You can't beat the style. The case, the easy handling and storage. These are for the dignified listeners, not maniacs like me who don't mind going deaf because they need their house music loud enough to make the jaw vibrate.

I will DEFINITELY use and enjoy them, but I need a pair that covers the ears like cans for that total forget the world immersion. These are the Sunday best and I ain't mad at all.

Where have I been that I did not know about this brand and its head-rockin quality? First, let's start off with the innocuous vintage design. It looks like something that might be on diner countertop from the 50's but when you turn that baby on and UP? Space age indeed. True audiophiles will love the ability to tweak the settings exactly to their liking and pairing and app setup takes all of minutes. This speaker is not only a wonderful conversation piece, it is a masterpiece.

Speaking of conversations, let's move on to Alexa. This is native to this new edition and all you have to do is sign in and and off you go! Given the recently curious publicity about Alexa cackling into the night or calling folks and snitching (LOL), I was rather wary about this feature but quickly grew on me when I saw not only how easy it is to use, but how QUICKLY you can turn it off. There are lights that indicate whether or not this feature is enabled, thank goodness!

This is such a remarkable speaker. It fits just about anywhere yet delivers a sound that will rattle the walls. Maaaaayunnnn, I am in LOVE. *fifty billion heart eye emojis* It looks so, SO cool - because it is - and yet, the price is hot! Do your smart home a favor, wisen up and check this out.

I was never a watch and certainly not a smartwatch person, but Fossil changed that for me because of their wonderful designs, ability to change up the bands and style, and their true affordability. Watches are made that fit every type of person and style imaginable, and this classy new Q Venture for is definitely the cream of the crop. I'm a little perplexed by the negative reviews when it states outright what the watch comes with and what it does/does not do. Everyone surely has a USB charger to plug the watch charger into and not having a speaker is what keeps the price point so fantastic.

I love using Android Wear because it pairs to your phone so effortlessly, and is set up within minutes. All you have to do is have fun in the app store so you can choose hundreds of different faces to suit each mood and outfit! Receive notifications from every app you have on your phone. Answer the phone from the watch and take the call on the phone. Reply to emails and text messages. Check your fitness, the step counter has been instrumental in making sure I receive lots of exercise each day. Receive calendar alerts so nothing ever slips your mind again!

How did we survive without these watches? We have everything right at our wrists and fingertips these days, and this watch is a necessity and a pleasure. Don't pay for a "brand", pay for a GAME-CHANGER. And this is it.

I received this awesome little projector this morning and in 20 minutes I was already enjoying it immensely by catching up on some of my favorite shows. It is packaged so securely that you don't have to worry about damage during shipping, and for the price, it simply cannot be beat! You can use it with the Fire Stick with no problems, and hook it up to external audio, though the speaker that is built in is exceptional. The resolution is perfectly clear. The images are vivid and adjustable. This is a mighty fine and affordable home theater solution that you will not regret!

This speaker is absolutely perfect for carrying with you for any every purpose - having your own personal sound system, having music for meditation; listening to podcasts and inspiration as you work, without being too disruptive to others. However, for a speaker this tiny and adorable, it certainly delivers that BASS too!

I have the biggest model of this speaker - the SRS-XB41 - and I am in LOVE with that thang. LOL But because it is so expensive (and heavy!), I don't really want to carry it around all the time. This is absolutely PERFECT. I am loving these amazing personal sound systems. Keep 'em coming, Sony!

My love affair with V-Moda began six years ago when I luck up on a pair of the V-Moda Crossfades on cyber Monday in a jazzy snazzy red. I was amazed by the construction, blown away by the bass and stellar all around get down sound! These are a smaller pair to use while on the go, but the quality is not compromised at all. From opening the gorgeous packaging to putting these babies in your ears, comfort is still a top priority and the sound is BOOMING even for a pair so small.

I love the details in this brand and the way the wireless bar buzzes when a phone call comes in, because they can be easily missed if your buds aren't in your ears. They charge quickly and are super portable in their case, and are a great investment just like their big brothers!!!! Love this brand. Love these babies.

I will preface this by saying that I am not a HARDCORE audiophile, but I do love crisp, clean and transporting sound so this more than does the job at this price point. A more economical option compared to other systems on the market, yet with the modern bells and whistles such as wifi and bluetooth with native apps that made it a great buy. Set up was easy for someone who is also not a techie, and my newly improved home theater sounds fantastic!

These are great and affordable headphones by JVC that are truly wireless and have crisp, clean sound. They are excellent for listening to music but be careful on phone calls as the person you are calling will be hearing all of the background noise. Perhaps this is a setting that can be adjusted but otherwise a great pair and buy!

Sony has pretty much always been my go-to brand for quality sound and value, and these earbuds are no exception. For such tiny devices, they fit in the ears comfortably and have excellent noise canceling capability. The extra bass sounds incredible and phone calls are clear and crisp. They stay put during strenuous activity and are easy to pair and use! This is a great buy for a lasting quality and a terrific addition to any audiophile's equipment stash.

A premium, high end and high tech but low cost solution for your computing needs. This combo is quick to set up and a true pleasure to use! The keys are backlit and can be used in a dark, quiet room and the design of the keyboard is comfortable. The mouse is speedy with no lagging and this pairing is the perfect completion to your desktop computer. Highly recommended!

This is a wonderful new projector by Epson, and I have been using it in my home and home office to prepare slides, presentations, and watch movies. Crisp, clear images on a screen or wall and while you cannot hook up an external speaker, the one built in is more than adequate for medium sized rooms, conference rooms and living rooms. I was wary about the sound quality based on other reviews but it is perfect. The clarity of each slide/movie is amazing and I am very happy with this product!

BRUH. This speaker is absolutely INCREDIBLE. I can't stop looking at it, listening to it, it is like having a party at ANY given time what with the bass heavy sound and spectacular lighting system. It was designed for househeads in mind and is the BEST for getting that vibe and uplift whenever you need it! It is also LOUD. Do yourself a big favor and cop this, and be prepared for the most delicious eargasms Sony has ever produced. I prefer the regular sound over live so the bass remains solid, but that too sounds good. Pair your phone or MP3 player, load up your favorite tunes and sets and GET. YOUR. LIFE

This is a SPECTACULAR home desktop and I am just in love! All I had to do is plug in a monitor as it came with the keyboard and mouse, and turn it on. Like another reviewer said, it is impressively quiet and beyond the initial whoosh of the start up, you will forget that it is even there. This is a brand new machine so it has all of the bells and whistles - graphics, hard drive, ram, gigs, etc and the fact that you can upgrade it to your own liking over the years means it is a very sound investment that will keep you and your home office/schooling needs met and beyond for years to come. It comes with Windows 10 and a trial of office, so you are ready to go out the gate, and the option to use 365 online means that your software costs are also at a minimum along with protection with McAfee.

Love, love, LOVE this computer!

WOW. Is all I can say. I received a different model of this item, the BeoSound 2, and was truly blown away by the crisp, clean sound. The price point will scare away a lot of perspective buyers, but the thing to note here is that this is a LIFETIME investment for true audiophiles that will last you forever and will be a purchase you will not regret. The highs, mids, lows, all come in at a PERFECT, heartrending range and just about anything you choose to play on this speaker will sound like it was piped down directly from the heavens. Bang & Olufsen is known for their high end sound systems so if you are looking at this brand you already know what it is in terms of price. Is it worth it or are you paying for the name? It is WORTH it.

This case is the ABSOLUTE one, the only one, you want to protect your precious, expensive, GINORMOUS iPad Pro. It might as well be made of titanium! The price point is on par with its durability and flawless design; you can take your iPad anywhere and not worry about anything happening to it. It is a worthy investment in keeping your device and everything therein safe and sound. Just secure it inside and off you go! I wouldn't recommend dropping it to test it, but know that if you do, you won't have anything to worry about. LOL

This extender is the stuff that nerd and techie dreams are made of. Use your network to max out power and productivity with a quick set up and easy way to control your equipment securely and with confidence. Potential buyers may balk at the price but once received will not regret the purchase as the product is durable, reliable and CAPABLE.

This is such an awesome, small speaker that delivers clear, crisp sound and bass. That it is waterproof is simply the icing on the cake! Ready to go out of the box and easy to charge and use. You can enjoy it in the wild outdoors or in the home while cooking, cleaning or entertaining and it will fill your space with powerful sound. I absolutely love it and highly recommend!

This is a VERY nice sound system for the price. Quick setup and clear sound, easy to use and hang in an outdoor setting or to enjoy in the home. I love that it has a remote so you can adjust volume/change tracks, etc without having to move though I do want to caution the buyer about being TOO far from the speakers as the sound will warp some. Depending on your setup it is a great buy, though not advisable for a large outdoor party. Picnic, beach or even pool at home, excellent! I recommend this with that in mind. Appears the company took the older model's issues and improved upon them vastly, as I was wary about selecting this item based on them. But so far, so GREAT!

Quality and affordable headphones with a nice sound and bass. I got these for my son and he loves them; they are a great pair without the expense of the higher brands and also fit comfortably on the ears. The Bluetooth makes them easy to run and exercise with also! Sleek design and color, overall a great buy!

When you get a pair of these headphones, you will not EVER take them off. That is how comfortable they feel; that is how ABSOLUTELY PHENOMENAL the sound is; that is how DEEP AND POUNDING the bass is, especially if you are a househead! They are super durable and I cannot stop raving about them. If you are a music fan of any kind, these will be the best investment and purchase and gift you could ever give to yourself, or receive. They also double as earmuffs in the winter! LOL Whenever people compliment me on them, I offer to have them listen and see for themselves just how SICK they are. Oh man. I love them whether I am listen to music or spiritual lectures. I wear them on my walking meditations and am in total bliss. They are on the pricier side since they are wireless but the other model is just as good and they were the first things I bought for myself two years ago. Now is the perfect time to get them because Amazon usually does have them as the deal of the day so BE ON THE LOOKOUT and get your LIFE!!!!!!!!!!!!!

I cannot get over how much PUNCH it packs for it to be so small. I use it to listen to music and audiobooks while I am cooking and love how easy it is to use. Just turn the thing on, pair it and rock out! It is also super portable so it would also be nice to take on a little picnic or anywhere with you in case of an emergency. LOL You will NOT be disappointed in this awesome speaker.

The sound quality on these headphones is amazing and they are also very, very comfortable to wear. If you spend as much time listening to music as I do, then you know how important that is. I also love the design - nothing gaudy or flashy stamped onto the side of your head, since what is coming OUT of the headphones is most important. LOL  Recommended!

I love this surge protector; you know how easy it is to pile up on gadgets and have nowhere to plug them in! This has plenty of outlets but is smart enough to conserve the power/energy for what you use and need the most - AND protects your expensive equipment from shorting! I am getting one for my boyfriend's home office too!

This LP& NO1 record player with speakers works like I remember. I am very careful with the arm, to protect the needle, in it. The sound quality is ok but, when I can, I may put bigger, stronger sound, on it. Have had no problems with records skipping and the design on the outside is pretty and looks great in my living room. I replaced another record player with this one and the difference is very noticeable...this new record player was so worth it. Please, don't get me wrong, the speakers are great. I just like stronger, louder speakers. I am very pleased with this product. Great product found on Amazon.

This Portable CD Player is easy to operate and very light weight. My CD's sound fantastic, on it. Because it is so light weight, it is easy to carry with me and use ear buds. I think this Portable CD player would make a wonderful Christmas or Birthday present for the music lover in your life. It was packaged very well. Well worth it's price, in my opinion. I am very happy with this product. Great product found on Amazon.

I ordered this little Bluetooth speaker to pair up with our 2nd Alexa in our bedroom. I had no problem, at all, getting it hooked up and the sound is great...really clear. Battery lasts about a day with minimal use. I'm sure it would need a charge more often if used for listening to music, etc. Overall, we are very pleased with this product.

Use them almost every day have been working out even better than I thought they would. I use them with a Sony Walkman am fm radio and they actually make the radio sound better. I use them while walking through the city and while at work and they block out interfering noise very well.

We have used the Boostaroo multiple times now mainly on trips with the car. I have a laptop and the sound it put out while watching a DVD movie wasn't enough to be heard over the noise encountered in the back seat of our car while going down the highway, even with earbuds. The boostaroo not only raised the sound level high enough to be heard, but the sound quality is greatly improved and both my sons are able to listen at the same time with headphones since boostaroo also offers three outlets for headphones and since each outlet has it's own amp the sound quality remains the same for each listener (doesn't diminish with each  additional listener) very pleased.
This works perfectly in the bedroom. A smaller space fills quickly with sound, bluetooth connectivity is seamless.

I honestly did not have high expectations for these as usually when I purchase headphones without a big name the quality doesn't seem to be there. These totally shocked me. I actually got them for my daughter so I didn't have to hear her youtube and these were perfect. They fit her big which is expected since she's 2 but they still fit. This sleeping bag is designed to keep you warm in temperatures as low as 14 degrees Fahrenheit, yet still be comfortable to sleep in without becoming too hot at temperatures up to 50 degrees, so it's a cold weather bag not intended for 0 degrees or below. Weighing slightly under five pounds, it comes in a compression bag that could be lashed onto a pack and comfortably fits an average adult.

The bag has a water shedding nylon shell, soft flannel lining, and cotton fiber filling that provides comfortable padding. The lowest temperature we had to try the bag in was 36 degrees Fahrenheit early this morning, so we tried it on our back patio and can safely say that the flannel is soft and cozy feeling and it definitely helps to retain warmth. I didn't have any trouble rolling it back up and getting it back into it's case when we finished with it either. Just be sure to fold the bag over lengthwise then roll from feet towards the head compressing as you go, and then work the edge of the bag around the bag before starting to pull it up over the bag.

This bag feels very comfortable without feeling too hot inside, but I can't say how well it would do in under 30 degree temperatures since we had no way to test that. Here in South Texas this sleeping bag will be perfectly adequate for the weather we get however, and the inflatable travel pillow that comes with it is a nice touch. It really is comfortable so we will definitely be using it for camping, but if you are looking for a zero degree or extreme weather bag this probably won't be the right one for you.

I purchased this sleeping bag at a reduced price for testing, evaluation, and review purposes.

This notebook lock and security cable works with laptops that have a Kensington security slot (about 99% of them on the market do), so it will work for most notebooks except the MacBook Pro. Be sure to check to make sure your laptop has the security port which looks like a small slot usually found in the upper right outside corner.

To use this cable run the end of the cable around a fixed object that can't be moved without effort or drawing attention, such as the leg of a heavy table or a post, then loop the locking end through the loop and attach it to your laptop. The locking mechanism has a built in bar that fits into the Kensington slot, so just insert it into the port, then turn the key 90 degrees to lock it in place. You'll need the key to unlock it when you're ready to take the laptop so be sure to bring it along. When you want to remove your laptop just rotate the key in the opposite direction to unlock it. This set comes with a spare key as well in case you misplace one.

The cable that comes with this is 6.2" long which wasn't long enough to go over the top of my desk and come back up to secure my laptop to the desk that way, but it was adequate to secure it around one of the desk's legs, so this cable isn't intended to permanently affix your laptop to a desk top, and it's thin enough to cut with bold cutters, but it's long enough and strong enough to deter someone from being able to snatch and run off with your laptop when you're at the library or coffee shop and want to leave it unattended long enough to go use the copy machine or go get a refill!

I like how the T-bar mechanism works to secure the lock to the laptop but still allow complete cable movement and rotation without dislodging the lock from the laptop, and I also like the fact that the cable is coated to prevent damage to your laptop & whatever the cable is secured around. This laptop lock and security cable is going to be perfect for my daughter when she studies in the campus library.

I received this notebook lock and security cable for testing and review. It works a lot easier than I expected!

[[VIDEOID:413906e1ac04fb2e066baa4adca5a20a]] This Bluetooth Shower Speaker with LCD Display by Abco Tech is the first shower speaker I've ever tried, so I can't compare it to any other one. I can share my impression of it from the perspective of one who hasn't used this sort of product before though and I hope that will be helpful to some of you who also haven't tried one before.

First of all, it measures 5 x 5 x 5 inches, and needs to be charged by USB after you receive it. Once it's charged you can attach it to a non-porous surface via three large suction cups in the rear of the speaker. We weren't able to get it to stick to our tile but it did attach firmly to the inside of the glass shower door and has held for three days so far without slipping or falling despite opening and closing the door.

The control buttons are easy to understand and operate. When you turn it on it makes a fairly loud beep, then the LCD display turns on and displays the time. I find having the clock very useful when trying to get kids out of the shower in time for school by the way! It has an integrated FM radio and you can preset up to 10 of your favorite stations and switch between them easily using the rewind and fast forward buttons. If you want to find different stations it will also do seek. When you select the radio mode it beeps loudly once again and then plays the station. Reception varies depending on signal strength, weather conditions and all the usual reasons. The default sound level is high but it's easy to adjust using the control buttons on the speaker.

Bluetooth: We had no problem pairing it to my daughter's iPhone 4S and streaming Pandora. In fact, the sound quality is excellent we thought! Once again the default sound level is high, but you can adjust that with the control buttons. ** It seemed as though we had problems getting it to switch to Bluetooth in the video, but that was because my daughter forgot to turn her phone back on for a moment. Once she did you can hear how good it sounded.** When you get a phone call while listening to the speaker it displays the calling phone number so you can decide whether to take the call or not, and if you decide to take it the speaker acts as a speakerphone.

Charge: So far it's been up for three days and we haven't had to charge it again, but then again we're only using it when in the shower or bathroom for longer periods of time so length of time it will hold the charge will vary depending on your usage. The rubber charging port cover doesn't want to stay covering the port up though, but it doesn't appear to have an effect on the speaker working.

We're very pleased by the quality, sound quality, and the features offered by this Bluetooth shower speaker so far. If anything changes I will update this review. I did receive a retail sample provided for evaluation and review consideration. I hope being able to see the actual speaker in position and working helps you to make a better informed buying decision. If you have any questions feel free to ask them in the comments section below and I'll try to respond as soon as I can. :)

The headphones are carefully packed so that the sensitive headphones are in foam and the additional fittings, sports ear hooks and sports fins are protected in the case. It comes with a small, attractive, durable portable pouch. The cord is "anti-tangle" - though unlike some of the other reviewers I haven't tried to tangle them up.
